title: Modern Higher-Order Cycloadditions
source: Chemical Reviews: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Higher-order cycloadditions, defined as pericyclic reactions involving more than 6π-electrons, have emerged as powerful and mechanistically diverse reactions that allow for the construction of larger and more complex polycyclic ring systems beyond the classical Diels–Alder reaction. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the development, scope, and fundamental principles governing higher-order cycloadditions involving 8π–18π-electrons. Key advances in transition-metal-, Lewis-acid-, organo-, and enzyme-catalyzed higher-order cycloadditions are highlighted with emphasis on how modern catalyst design enables control over periselectivity and stereoselectivity. Mechanistic insights from density functional theory, molecular dynamics, and experimental reaction designs are discussed to illustrate how higher-order cycloadditions challenge and refine modern pericyclic theory. Together, these developments showcase the growing synthetic and conceptual significance of higher-order cycloadditions in modern chemistry.
title_zh: 现代高阶环加法
abstract_zh: 摘要 高阶环加成被定义为涉及超过 6 个π 电子的周环反应，已成为强大且机制多样的反应，允许构建超出经典 Diels-Alder 反应的更大、更复杂的多环系统。这篇综述全面概述了涉及 8π–18π-电子的高阶环加成的发展、范围和基本原理。重点介绍了过渡金属、路易斯酸、有机和酶催化的高阶环加成的关键进展，重点介绍了现代催化剂设计如何能够控制近选择性和立体选择性。讨论了密度泛函理论、分子动力学和实验反应设计的机理见解，以说明高阶环加成如何挑战和完善现代周环理论。总之，这些进展展示了现代化学中高阶环加成日益增长的合成和概念意义。

title: Electrocatalytic Hydrogenation with Nanoparticles Derived from a Cobalt Metal–Organic Framework
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Electrocatalytic hydrogenation (e -H) provides a sustainable route for converting unsaturated organic substrates under mild conditions using renewable electricity as the driving force. Here, we report an MOF-derived cobalt catalyst for the e -H of acetone and pyridine. A new two-dimensional cobalt metal–organic framework, Co-L0-NS, composed of Co(II) nodes and polyaromatic carboxylate linkers, was synthesized as nanosheets and used as a precursor to generate the active catalyst under cathodic bias. Electrochemical pretreatment induces controlled framework reconstruction to form MD-Cat, a highly dispersed, structurally disordered, Co(OH)2-rich nanocluster material. MD-Cat catalyzes the e -H of acetone to isopropanol with nearly quantitative Faradaic efficiency at optimized potentials and promotes pyridine hydrogenation to piperidine with up to 50% Faradaic efficiency. Comparative studies with electrodeposited cobalt, commercial cobalt nanoparticles, and bulk Co(OH)2 show that the MOF-derived catalyst exhibits superior current densities and product selectivity, which we attribute to its nanoscale morphology and hydroxylated cobalt environment. In situ Co K-edge XAS, XPS, PXRD, ATR-SEIRAS, and STEM analyses indicate that Co remains predominantly in the +2 oxidation state during catalysis while undergoing structural reorganization. Tafel analysis supports a PCET-type mechanism for acetone hydrogenation; while DFT calculations suggest that the Co/Co(OH)2 interface suppresses HER by weakening H* binding while preserving organic-substrate activation. These results highlight MOF-templated electrochemical reconstruction as a promising approach for designing selective e -H catalysts, not only by increasing catalyst accessibility through nanostructuring but also by enabling the formation of unique catalytic motifs that would otherwise be difficult to access using traditional methods.
title_zh: 钴金属有机骨架纳米颗粒的电催化氢化
abstract_zh: 摘要 电催化氢化（e -H）为在温和条件下使用可再生电力作为驱动力转化不饱和有机底物提供了一条可持续的途径。在这里，我们报道了一种用于丙酮和吡啶 e-H 的 MOF 衍生的钴催化剂。一种新的二维钴金属有机骨架 Co-L0-NS，由 Co(II) 节点和聚芳族羧酸酯连接体组成，被合成为纳米片，并用作在阴极偏压下生成活性催化剂的前驱体。电化学预处理诱导受控框架重建，形成 MD-Cat，一种高度分散、结构无序、富含 Co(OH)2 的纳米团簇材料。 MD-Cat 在优化电位下以近乎定量的法拉第效率催化丙酮的 e-H 生成异丙醇，并以高达 50% 的法拉第效率促进吡啶氢化为哌啶。与电沉积钴、商业钴纳米颗粒和块状 Co(OH)2 的比较研究表明，MOF 衍生的催化剂表现出优异的电流密度和产物选择性，我们将其归因于其纳米级形态和羟基化钴环境。原位 Co K-edge XAS、XPS、PXRD、ATR-SEIRAS 和 STEM 分析表明，Co 在催化过程中主要保持 +2 氧化态，同时进行结构重组。 Tafel 分析支持丙酮氢化的 PCET 型机制；而 DFT 计算表明，Co/Co(OH)2 界面通过削弱 H* 结合来抑制 HER，同时保持有机底物活化。这些结果凸显

title: Vestibular nucleus stimulation for ameliorating locomotor dynamics in a Parkinsonian mouse model
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Postural and locomotor dysfunction represent axial symptoms of Parkinson’s disease (PD), which remain poorly treated by medication and deep brain stimulation. Whilst non-invasive neuromodulation of the vestibular system via the vestibular nucleus complex (VNC) offers a novel therapeutic avenue, the underlying circuits are still poorly characterized. Here we show that the mouse VNC feeds extensive Vglut2-defined projections into striato-thalamo-subthalamic and caudal medulla motor hubs and receives substantial input from the sensorimotor cortex. Optogenetic activation of excitatory VNC neurons at sub-symptomatic intensities increased cFos-based activity in basal ganglia-associated and brainstem motor targets. Unbiased pose dynamics and motion analysis respectively showed enhancement of behavioural modularity and locomotion with threshold-level stimulation. In a mouse model of PD, the latter further favored naturalistic gait patterns through improved motor coordination. Our data identify excitatory VNC processes as candidates for therapeutic targeting of axial motor dysfunction in the context of PD.
title_zh: 前庭核刺激可改善帕金森小鼠模型的运动动力学
abstract_zh: 姿势和运动功能障碍是帕金森病 (PD) 的中轴症状，但药物和深部脑刺激治疗效果不佳。虽然通过前庭核复合体（VNC）对前庭系统进行非侵入性神经调节提供了一种新的治疗途径，但其潜在的回路仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们展示了小鼠 VNC 将广泛的 Vglut2 定义的投射馈送到纹状体-丘脑-底丘脑和尾髓运动中枢，并接收来自感觉运动皮层的大量输入。在亚症状强度下兴奋性 VNC 神经元的光遗传学激活增加了基底神经节相关和脑干运动靶标中基于 cFos 的活动。无偏姿态动力学和运动分析分别显示了阈值刺激下行为模块化和运动的增强。在 PD 小鼠模型中，后者通过改善运动协调性进一步支持自然步态模式。我们的数据将兴奋性 VNC 过程确定为 PD 背景下轴向运动功能障碍治疗目标的候选者。

title: Vibrio cholerae-synthesized tryptophan activates innate immune signaling in enteroendocrine cells via phosphorylation of the nuclear receptor ultraspiracle
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The Gram-negative rod Vibrio cholerae causes profuse diarrhea in humans and is found in close association with both terrestrial and aquatic arthropods in the environment. Here we show that tryptophan produced by V. cholerae in the arthropod intestine activates expression of the host colonization factor Peritrophin-15a (Peri-15a). V. cholerae-derived tryptophan is used by host enterocytes to synthesize serotonin, which signals to enteroendocrine cells (EECs) to activate the TNF-like immune deficiency pathway IMD. We define the EEC serotonin signaling pathway, which involves a subset of serotonin G protein-coupled receptors, Gαq, phospholipase C, and protein kinase C. This pathway culminates in phosphorylation and potentiation of the nuclear receptor ultraspiracle, which binds the sex hormone ecdysone to activate IMD signaling. IMD signaling in EECs uniquely activates expression of the enteroendocrine peptide Tachykinin, which increases expression of Peri-15a. We propose that, because V. cholerae-synthesized tryptophan increases host Peri-15a expression, it has evolved to exploit the arthropod intestinal innate immune response to maximize intestinal adhesion.
title_zh: 霍乱弧菌合成的色氨酸通过核受体超气门的磷酸化激活肠内分泌细胞中的先天免疫信号
abstract_zh: 革兰氏阴性杆状霍乱弧菌会引起人类严重腹泻，并且被发现与环境中的陆生和水生节肢动物密切相关。在这里，我们发现霍乱弧菌在节肢动物肠道中产生的色氨酸激活宿主定植因子 Peritropin-15a (Peri-15a) 的表达。霍乱弧菌衍生的色氨酸被宿主肠细胞用来合成血清素，该血清素向肠内分泌细胞（EEC）发出信号以激活 TNF 样免疫缺陷途径 IMD。我们定义了 EEC 血清素信号通路，该通路涉及血清素 G 蛋白偶联受体的子集、Gαq、磷脂酶 C 和蛋白激酶 C。该通路最终导致核受体 ultraspiracle 的磷酸化和增强，该受体结合性激素蜕皮激素以激活 IMD 信号传导。 EEC 中的 IMD 信号传导独特地激活肠内分泌肽速激肽的表达，从而增加 Peri-15a 的表达。我们认为，由于霍乱弧菌合成的色氨酸增加了宿主 Peri-15a 的表达，因此它已经进化到利用节肢动物肠道先天免疫反应来最大化肠道粘附。

title: Multi-omics integration unravels four molecular subgroups of corticotroph pituitary neuroendocrine tumours with distinct clinicopathological features
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Corticotroph pituitary neuroendocrine tumours (PitNETs)/adenomas are heterogeneous sellar neoplasms. Currently established histopathological classification approaches are often considered limited in fully capturing the clinical and biological complexity of these tumours. Thus far, a molecular-based classification has not been established in corticotroph PitNETs. We compile molecular data of 270 corticotroph PitNETs (111 internal, 159 external), encompassing epigenome, transcriptome, and proteome profiles. Comprehensive integrative analyses are performed to identify, validate and characterise definitive molecular subgroups. Corticotroph PitNETs separate into four robust and clinicopathologically distinct molecular subgroups, which are broadly distinguishable by microscopy using SSTR1, GATA3 and SSTR5 immunohistochemistry. An integrated stratification model incorporating these molecular subgroups demonstrates significant prognostic utility. Our findings support the establishment of a refined molecular-based corticotroph PitNET classification, the full clinical value of which will require validation in prospective studies. To facilitate future research, we provide an easy-to-use epigenomic classifier for corticotroph PitNETs.
title_zh: 多组学整合揭示了具有不同临床病理特征的促肾上腺皮质激素垂体神经内分泌肿瘤的四个分子亚组
abstract_zh: 促肾上腺皮质激素垂体神经内分泌肿瘤（PitNET）/腺瘤是异质性鞍区肿瘤。目前建立的组织病理学分类方法通常被认为在充分捕捉这些肿瘤的临床和生物学复杂性方面有限。迄今为止，促肾上腺皮质激素细胞 PitNET 尚未建立基于分子的分类。我们编译了 270 个促肾上腺皮质激素 PitNET（111 个内部，159 个外部）的分子数据，包括表观基因组、转录组和蛋白质组谱。进行全面的综合分析来识别、验证和表征明确的分子亚组。促皮质激素 PitNET 分为四个强大且临床病理学不同的分子亚组，使用 SSTR1、GATA3 和 SSTR5 免疫组织化学通过显微镜可大致区分这些亚组。包含这些分子亚组的综合分层模型显示出显着的预后效用。我们的研究结果支持建立基于分子的精细促肾上腺皮质激素 PitNET 分类，其完整的临床价值需要在前瞻性研究中进行验证。为了促进未来的研究，我们为促肾上腺皮质激素细胞 PitNET 提供了一个易于使用的表观基因组分类器。

title: Peri-weaning, diet-induced activation of an IFNγ-mediated regulatory circuit promotes cDC1 maturation and CD8+ T cell differentiation
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Maintaining a balanced immunity between pathogen defense and tolerance to environmental antigens in neonates is essential for survival and the establishment of life-long immune homeostasis. Instructed by environmental signals, type 1 conventional dendritic cells (cDC1) contribute to both processes but how the balance may be achieved is unclear. Here, we uncover an interferon (IFN)γ-driven regulatory circuit in early life that relays dietary cues to spleen cDC1. IFNγ-mediated STAT1-signaling induces an immunogenic maturation program in spleen cDC1 that enables them to shape the effector differentiation of antigen-experienced effector memory CD8⁺ T cells. This cDC1 program emerges during the transition from breastfeeding to solid food at weaning, occurs in germ-free mice, and remains operative to dietary intervention in adult mice. At weaning, this IFNγ signal enables spleen cDC1 to shape the effector phenotype of food-antigen-specific CD8+ T cells in a feedforward manner, thereby recalibrating the developing T cell pool. Our findings identify diet as a modifiable cue that can tune systemic cDC1-mediated immunity, opening new opportunities to steer immune responses during early life and beyond.
title_zh: 围断奶期间，饮食诱导的 IFNγ 介导的调节回路激活促进 cDC1 成熟和 CD8+ T 细胞分化
abstract_zh: 在新生儿的病原体防御和对环境抗原的耐受性之间保持平衡的免疫对于生存和建立终生免疫稳态至关重要。在环境信号的指导下，1 型传统树突状细胞 (cDC1) 对这两个过程都有贡献，但如何实现平衡尚不清楚。在这里，我们发现了生命早期的干扰素 (IFN)γ 驱动的调节回路，该回路将饮食线索传递给脾脏 cDC1。 IFNγ介导的 STAT1 信号传导在脾 cDC1 中诱导免疫原性成熟程序，使它们能够塑造经历过抗原的效应记忆 CD8+ T 细胞的效应分化。这个cDC1程序在断奶时从母乳喂养到固体食物的过渡过程中出现，发生在无菌小鼠中，并且对成年小鼠的饮食干预仍然有效。断奶时，这种 IFNγ 信号使脾 cDC1 以前馈方式塑造食物抗原特异性 CD8+ T 细胞的效应表型，从而重新校准正在发育的 T 细胞库。我们的研究结果表明，饮食是一种可调节的线索，可以调节 cDC1 介导的全身免疫，为生命早期及以后引导免疫反应提供新的机会。

title: Translational control by RPL22L1-specific ribosomes enhances DNA repair and chemoresistance
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ribosome heterogeneity has emerged as a regulatory layer in gene expression, yet its biological roles in cancers remain poorly characterized. Here, we identify RPL22L1, a paralog of the ribosomal protein RPL22, as a key modulator of DNA damage response (DDR) in colorectal cancer cells. DNA damage induces RPL22L1 upregulation and ribosomal incorporation, forming RPL22L1-specific ribosomes. Ribosome profiling reveals that RPL22L1-containing ribosomes preferentially translate mRNAs with highly structured 5’ untranslated region (5’UTR). In particular, RPL22L1 enhances the translation of ATRX through a cap-independent mechanism. ATRX subsequently recruits DNA-PKcs to DNA damage sites, thereby enhancing the DNA repair capacity. RPL22L1 loss creates exploitable DDR vulnerabilities, sensitizing cancer cells to cisplatin and PARP inhibitors in vitro and in vivo. Collectively, these findings uncover a specialized ribosome-mediated translational program in DDR and highlight RPL22L1 as a potential therapeutic target in DDR-based cancer therapy.
title_zh: RPL22L1 特异性核糖体的翻译控制增强 DNA 修复和化疗耐药性
abstract_zh: 核糖体异质性已成为基因表达的调节层，但其在癌症中的生物学作用仍知之甚少。在这里，我们确定 RPL22L1（核糖体蛋白 RPL22 的旁系同源物）是结直肠癌细胞中 DNA 损伤反应 (DDR) 的关键调节剂。 DNA 损伤诱导 RPL22L1 上调和核糖体掺入，形成 RPL22L1 特异性核糖体。核糖体分析表明，含有 RPL22L1 的核糖体优先翻译具有高度结构化 5' 非翻译区 (5'UTR) 的 mRNA。特别是，RPL22L1 通过帽独立机制增强 ATRX 的翻译。 ATRX 随后将 DNA-PKcs 招募到 DNA 损伤位点，从而增强 DNA 修复能力。 RPL22L1 缺失会产生可利用的 DDR 漏洞，使癌细胞在体外和体内对顺铂和 PARP 抑制剂敏感。总的来说，这些发现揭示了 DDR 中专门的核糖体介导的翻译程序，并强调 RPL22L1 作为基于 DDR 的癌症治疗的潜在治疗靶点。

title: Nanobody regulation of C-type inactivation in Kv1.3 channels
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Nanobodies are powerful tools for modulating ion channels for mechanistic investigations and developing new therapeutics. The Kv1.3 channel is highly expressed in T-lymphocytes where it promotes sustained T-cell activation, its expression is elevated in autoimmune disorders and inhibitory nanobodies are immunosuppressive. The A019400G09 nanobody (NB1.3) binds to the external surface of Kv1.3 and inhibits the channel by promoting slow C-type inactivation of the ion selectivity filter. Here we explore the mechanism by which NB1.3 promotes inactivation by determining a series of cryo-EM structures of Kv1.3 and mutating the interface between NB1.3 and the channel. Our results reveal that interaction of NB1.3 with both the S1-S4 voltage-sensing domain and the turret within the pore domain are required to promote inactivation. We also identify a network of interacting hydrophobic residues linking the turret to the ion selectivity filter that stabilizes the conducting state and mediate the actions of NB1.3. These findings provide a foundation for developing therapeutics targeting Kv1.3 channels and exploring how nanobodies can interact with other tetrameric cation channels to modulate their activity.
title_zh: 纳米抗体对 Kv1.3 通道 C 型失活的调控
abstract_zh: 纳米抗体是调节离子通道以进行机械研究和开发新疗法的强大工具。 Kv1.3 通道在 T 淋巴细胞中高度表达，促进 T 细胞持续激活，其表达在自身免疫性疾病中升高，并且抑制性纳米抗体具有免疫抑制作用。 A019400G09 纳米抗体 (NB1.3) 与 Kv1.3 的外表面结合，并通过促进离子选择性过滤器的缓慢 C 型失活来抑制通道。在这里，我们通过确定Kv1.3的一系列冷冻电镜结构并突变NB1.3与通道之间的界面来探讨NB1.3促进失活的机制。我们的结果表明，NB1.3 与 S1-S4 电压传感域和孔域内的转塔相互作用是促进失活所必需的。我们还确定了一个相互作用的疏水残基网络，将转塔连接到离子选择性过滤器，稳定导电状态并介导 NB1.3 的作用。这些发现为开发针对 Kv1.3 通道的疗法以及探索纳米抗体如何与其他四聚体阳离子通道相互作用以调节其活性奠定了基础。

title: ATP13A4 gates extracellular polyamine levels to control excitatory synaptogenesis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Polyamines, such as spermidine, are essential regulators of brain development, yet how cells control their uptake and extracellular levels remains unclear. Here we show that ATP13A4, a transport protein enriched in glia and prominently expressed in astrocytes, governs brain polyamine balance. Using biochemical, cellular, and animal models, we find that ATP13A4 imports polyamines into cells and thereby limits their availability outside cells. Loss of ATP13A4 simplifies astrocyte morphology and increases the excitatory connections, or synapses, that astrocytes promote between neurons; adding spermidine reproduces these effects, identifying extracellular spermidine as a synapse-promoting signal. In mice lacking Atp13a4, brain polyamines are redistributed, with reduced levels in the cortex and accumulation in cerebrospinal fluid. This is accompanied by excess excitatory synapses, delayed early development, and mild, female-biased behavioral changes in adulthood. Rare ATP13A4 variants linked to neurodevelopmental disorders disrupt its function. Thus, astrocytic polyamine clearance via ATP13A4 tunes extracellular spermidine to shape synapse formation during development.
title_zh: ATP13A4 控制细胞外多胺水平以控制兴奋性突触发生
abstract_zh: 多胺，如亚精胺，是大脑发育的重要调节剂，但细胞如何控制其摄取和细胞外水平仍不清楚。在这里，我们发现 ATP13A4（一种富含于神经胶质细胞并在星形胶质细胞中显着表达的转运蛋白）控制着大脑多胺平衡。利用生化、细胞和动物模型，我们发现 ATP13A4 将多胺导入细胞，从而限制其在细胞外的可用性。 ATP13A4 的缺失会简化星形胶质细胞的形态并增加星形胶质细胞在神经元之间促进的兴奋性连接或突触；添加亚精胺会重现这些效应，将细胞外亚精胺识别为突触促进信号。在缺乏 Atp13a4 的小鼠中，大脑中的多胺会重新分布，皮质中的水平降低，并在脑脊液中积聚。伴随着过度的兴奋性突触、早期发育延迟以及成年后轻微的、女性偏向的行为变化。与神经发育障碍相关的罕见 ATP13A4 变异会破坏其功能。因此，星形胶质细胞通过 ATP13A4 清除多胺，调节细胞外亚精胺以塑造发育过程中的突触形成。

title: Positional grammar of transcription factor binding partitions developmental and stress-response regulation in plants
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Understanding how transcription factor binding site (TFBS) position influences gene regulation remains a fundamental challenge in plants. Here, we integrate conserved multiDAP TFBS maps for 244 transcription factors (TFs) with single-nucleus chromatin accessibility, cell type-resolved gene expression, and hormone-response datasets across Brassicaceae species to determine how TFBS position relates to regulatory function. Although conserved TFBSs are enriched near transcription start sites (TSSs), TSS-proximal accessibility poorly predicts cell type-specific expression. Instead, cell type-specific expression correlates best with conserved TFBSs embedded in cell type-restricted chromatin, with TF family-specific distributions across distal promoters and introns. In contrast, TSS-proximal TFBSs in broadly accessible chromatin are associated with rapid transcriptional responses to abiotic and biotic stress hormones. Coding sequence TFBSs mark a distinct regulatory context in which the same DNA sequence encodes both amino acid sequence and TF motifs, including evidence that CDS-localized ABR1 binding may contribute to repression during hormone response. Finally, distal upstream regions contain conserved multi-family TF clusters with enhancer-like features overlapping rare cell type-specific accessible chromatin and enriched near genes controlling embryonic, meristematic, and hormone-dependent developmental patterning. Together, these results support a positional grammar in which TFBS position and chromatin context jointly partition developmental, stress-responsive, and repressive regulatory output in plants.
title_zh: 转录因子结合的位置语法划分植物的发育和应激反应调节
abstract_zh: 了解转录因子结合位点 (TFBS) 位置如何影响基因调控仍然是植物中的一个基本挑战。在这里，我们将 244 个转录因子 (TF) 的保守 multiDAP TFBS 图谱与十字花科物种的单核染色质可及性、细胞类型解析的基因表达和激素反应数据集进行整合，以确定 TFBS 位置与调节功能的关系。尽管保守的 TFBS 在转录起始位点 (TSS) 附近富集，但 TSS 近端可及性很难预测细胞类型特异性表达。相反，细胞类型特异性表达与嵌入细胞类型限制性染色质中的保守 TFBS 具有最佳相关性，并且具有跨远端启动子和内含子的 TF 家族特异性分布。相比之下，广泛可及染色质中的 TSS 近端 TFBS 与非生物和生物应激激素的快速转录反应相关。编码序列 TFBS 标志着一个独特的调控环境，其中相同的 DNA 序列编码氨基酸序列和 TF 基序，包括 CDS 定位的 ABR1 结合可能有助于激素反应期间抑制的证据。最后，远端上游区域包含保守的多家族 TF 簇，具有类似增强子的特征，与稀有细胞类型特异性可及染色质重叠，并富集控制胚胎、分生组织和激素依赖性发育模式的近基因。总之，这些结果支持了一种位置语法，其中 TFBS 位置和染色质背景共同划分发育、应激反应和抑制性

title: Single-cell profiling decodes patagium development in gliding mammal
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The gliding patagium represents a key adaptation for mammalian flight, but its cellular development remains unexplored. Using single-nucleus RNA sequencing of embryonic flying squirrel patagium and dorsal skin, we construct a single-cell atlas of patagium development and identify two distinct fibroblast subpopulations (Fp2 and Fr) highly enriched in the patagium. These fibroblasts are characterized by the patagium upregulation of Wnt5a, Fgf7, and Fgf10, and are associated with patagium morphogenesis through dermal-epidermal putative communication interactions between dermal fibroblasts (Fp2 and Fr) and epithelial basal keratinocytes. Specifically, Fp2 fibroblasts are potentially involved in distal dermal condensation and epithelial thickening together with elevated Wnt5a expression, while both Fp2 and Fr fibroblasts could play a role in epithelial polarization and thickening through Fgf7 and Fgf10, as suggested by ex vivo assays. Our data suggest that gliding patagium development results from the co-option of conserved WNT and FGF signaling pathways within a specialized fibroblast-epithelial context, illustrating how modifications of conserved developmental programs give rise to derived morphological traits.
title_zh: 单细胞分析解码滑翔哺乳动物的翼状体发育
abstract_zh: 滑翔翼代表了哺乳动物飞行的关键适应能力，但其细胞发育仍未被探索。利用胚胎飞鼠翼状体和背部皮肤的单核RNA测序，我们构建了翼状体发育的单细胞图谱，并鉴定了翼状体中高度富集的两种不同的成纤维细胞亚群（Fp2和Fr）。这些成纤维细胞的特征是 Wnt5a、Fgf7 和 Fgf10 的翼膜上调，并且通过真皮成纤维细胞（Fp2 和 Fr）与上皮基底角质形成细胞之间的真皮-表皮假定通讯相互作用与翼膜形态发生相关。具体而言，Fp2 成纤维细胞可能与 Wnt5a 表达升高一起参与远端真皮凝结和上皮增厚，而 Fp2 和 Fr 成纤维细胞都可以通过 Fgf7 和 Fgf10 在上皮极化和增厚中发挥作用，如离体测定所示。我们的数据表明，滑动翼状体发育是由于在特定的成纤维细胞-上皮环境中保守的 WNT 和 FGF 信号通路共同选择的结果，这说明了保守发育程序的修改如何产生衍生的形态特征。

title: A Lactate–H4K12la–HDAC1 epigenetic axis governs microglial state transitions during experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis in female mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Microglial functional plasticity is shaped by metabolic and epigenetic reprogramming, but how these processes regulate central nervous system autoimmunity remains unclear. We find that cerebrospinal fluid lactate levels correlate with multiple sclerosis severity. Using female mouse models of experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, spinal lactate accumulation drives persistent microglial histone lactylation, coupling to glycolytic activation. Microglia-specific deletion of lactate dehydrogenase A reduces this lactylation and exacerbates disease severity. Exogenous lactate ameliorates pathology without altering peripheral immune infiltration by suppressing inflammatory states and promoting reparative programs. Epigenomic profiling demonstrates direct lactylation enrichment at promoters of neurotrophic genes, linking metabolic flux to transcriptional activation. Histone deacetylase 1 acts as an epigenetic brake by erasing this modification; its inhibition restores neurotrophic signaling and mitigates pathology. In this work, we show that a lactate-driven epigenetic axis governs microglial state transitions, highlighting a tractable therapeutic target for metabolic intervention in neuroinflammatory diseases.
title_zh: 乳酸-H4K12la-HDAC1表观遗传轴在雌性小鼠实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎期间控制小胶质细胞状态转变
abstract_zh: 小胶质细胞的功能可塑性是由代谢和表观遗传重编程形成的，但这些过程如何调节中枢神经系统自身免疫仍不清楚。我们发现脑脊液乳酸水平与多发性硬化症的严重程度相关。使用实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎的雌性小鼠模型，脊髓乳酸积累驱动持续的小胶质细胞组蛋白乳酰化，与糖酵解激活耦合。小胶质细胞特异性删除乳酸脱氢酶 A 会减少这种乳酸化并加剧疾病的严重程度。外源性乳酸通过抑制炎症状态和促进修复程序来改善病理，而不改变外周免疫浸润。表观基因组分析表明神经营养基因启动子处的直接乳酰化富集，将代谢流与转录激活联系起来。组蛋白脱乙酰酶 1 通过消除这种修饰来充当表观遗传制动器；它的抑制可恢复神经营养信号并减轻病理。在这项工作中，我们表明乳酸驱动的表观遗传轴控制小胶质细胞状态转变，突出了神经炎症疾病代谢干预的易于处理的治疗靶点。

title: Trimeric autotransporter adhesins driving chain-like adhesion diversify surface colonization strategies in Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Bacteria frequently colonize host and environmental surfaces under fluid flow. Chain-like adherence pattern (CLAP) is an EibG-mediated surface colonization phenotype of certain Shiga toxin-producing Escherichia coli (STEC) that lack the locus of enterocyte effacement (LEE). EibG, an immunoglobulin-binding trimeric autotransporter adhesin, drives CLAP, but the temporal dynamics and genetic diversity underlying chain formation remain unclear. Here, we use live-cell time-lapse imaging to show that chains arise from single cells that elongate and divide without separation. Under flow, chains resist detachment and undergo shear-dependent fragmentation at cell-cell junctions, releasing viable clonal units that disperse downstream. Comparative genomics reveals diversity among EibG-related adhesins and identifies distinct lineages, including chain-like adhesins (Cla) that mediate CLAP while lacking IgG binding. Screening of 1,354 genomes from England shows that claB is present in 95.6% of strains from major LEE-negative STEC serotypes, highlighting its epidemiological prevalence. Targeted mutagenesis demonstrates that chain formation and IgG binding are mediated by distinct structural domains, revealing the modular functional architecture of these adhesins. Furthermore, we show that EibG, ClaA, and ClaB confer robust resistance to complement-mediated killing. Collectively, these findings establish CLAP as a dynamic, surface-associated strategy of LEE-negative STEC and reveal diversification among adhesins that drive this behavior.
title_zh: 三聚体自转运蛋白粘附素驱动链状粘附，使产志贺毒素大肠杆菌的表面定植策略多样化
abstract_zh: 细菌经常在流体流动下定植于宿主和环境表面。链状粘附模式 (CLAP) 是某些产志贺毒素大肠杆菌 (STEC) 的 EibG 介导的表面定植表型，该大肠杆菌缺乏肠细胞消失位点 (LEE)。 EibG 是一种免疫球蛋白结合三聚体自转运蛋白粘附素，可驱动 CLAP，但链形成背后的时间动态和遗传多样性仍不清楚。在这里，我们使用活细胞延时成像来显示链是由单个细胞产生的，这些细胞在不分离的情况下伸长和分裂。在流动下，链抵抗分离并在细胞与细胞连接处经历剪切依赖性断裂，释放出分散在下游的可行克隆单元。比较基因组学揭示了 EibG 相关粘附素的多样性，并鉴定了不同的谱系，包括介导 CLAP 但缺乏 IgG 结合的链状粘附素 (Cla)。对英格兰 1,354 个基因组的筛查表明，95.6% 的主要 LEE 阴性 STEC 血清型菌株中存在 claB，这凸显了其流行病学患病率。靶向诱变表明链形成和 IgG 结合是由不同的结构域介导的，揭示了这些粘附素的模块化功能结构。此外，我们还发现 EibG、ClaA 和 ClaB 对补体介导的杀伤具有强大的抵抗力。总的来说，这些发现将 CLAP 确立为 LEE 阴性 STEC 的一种动态、表面相关策略，并揭示了驱动这种行为的粘附素的多样性。

title: Neonatal inflammation disrupts a temporally restricted postnatal Numb-enriched microglial state in mice
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Early-life microglia are diverse and support brain development beyond immune surveillance, but the transient states associated with postnatal maturation remain poorly understood. Here we show, using a time-resolved single-cell atlas of neonatal mouse brain immune cells, that a postnatal Numb-enriched microglial state emerges during early postnatal development, expands during the second postnatal week and subsequently declines. This state is characterized by neurodevelopment-related gene expression programs and distinct metabolic features. Trajectory inference, cross-atlas mapping and RNAscope validation support its temporal pattern. During the period when this state expands, microglial depletion preserves gross myelination but alters synaptic protein composition and disrupts dendritic and cortical layer maturation, particularly in the primary somatosensory cortex. Neonatal lipopolysaccharide challenge impairs the establishment of the Numb-enriched state and induces an early glycolytic response followed by recovery-phase inflammatory states. These findings identify a developmentally timed microglial state associated with cortical maturation and vulnerable to neonatal inflammation in mice.
title_zh: 新生儿炎症破坏小鼠出生后暂时受限的麻木富集小胶质细胞状态
abstract_zh: 生命早期的小胶质细胞是多种多样的，并且支持免疫监视之外的大脑发育，但与出生后成熟相关的短暂状态仍然知之甚少。在这里，我们使用新生小鼠脑免疫细胞的时间分辨单细胞图谱表明，出生后早期发育期间出现了出生后 Numb 富集的小胶质细胞状态，在出生后第二周期间扩张，随后下降。这种状态的特点是神经发育相关的基因表达程序和独特的代谢特征。轨迹推断、跨图谱映射和 RNAscope 验证支持其时间模式。在这种状态扩展期间，小胶质细胞的消耗保留了总髓鞘形成，但改变了突触蛋白组成并破坏了树突和皮质层的成熟，特别是在初级体感皮层中。新生儿脂多糖挑战损害了 Numb 富集状态的建立，并诱导早期糖酵解反应，随后是恢复期炎症状态。这些发现确定了小鼠中与皮质成熟相关且易受新生炎症影响的发育定时小胶质细胞状态。

title: Fluorinated Phenethylammonium and Pre-Annealing Static Stage Enable Intermediate-Mediated Stepwise Crystallization in Tin Perovskite Solar Cells
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Tin-based perovskite solar cells (Sn-PSCs) are fundamentally limited by rapid crystallization, which induces defective morphologies and severe Sn2+ oxidation. Here, we report a combination of 4-fluorophenethylammonium (FPEA) and a pre-annealing static stage (PASS) for Sn-PSCs. While excessive FPEA generates a significant trade-off between grain growth and film compactness, our systematic optimization reveals that an optimal low concentration of FPEA combined with PASS simultaneously mitigates this trade-off. In situ optical spectroscopy reveals an intermediate-mediated stepwise crystallization process, in which a gradual and partial transition from the intermediate to the perovskite phase occurs during PASS, accompanied by effective crystal growth. Subsequent thermal annealing promotes grain reconstruction and healing together with completion of the phase transition. X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy confirms that the electron-withdrawing fluorine atoms modulate the [SnI6]4− electronic landscape and dramatically suppress Sn2+ oxidation. Consequently, the optimized FPEA0.04FA0.96SnI3 films exhibit improved crystalline quality, enlarged grains, and reduced energetic disorder (FA: formamidinium). Their devices deliver a power conversion efficiency of 9.29% (reference: 7.99%) with markedly improved operational stability. This work establishes a clear mechanistic framework and provides a robust design principle for high-performance tin-based perovskites.
title_zh: 氟化苯乙铵和预退火静态阶段可实现锡钙钛矿太阳能电池的中间介导逐步结晶
abstract_zh: 摘要 锡基钙钛矿太阳能电池（Sn-PSC）从根本上受到快速结晶的限制，这会导致缺陷形貌和严重的 Sn2+ 氧化。在这里，我们报告了 Sn-PSC 的 4-氟苯乙基铵 (FPEA) 和预退火静态阶段 (PASS) 的组合。虽然过多的 FPEA 会在晶粒生长和薄膜致密性之间产生显着的权衡，但我们的系统优化表明，最佳低浓度 FPEA 与 PASS 相结合可同时减轻这种权衡。原位光谱揭示了中间体介导的逐步结晶过程，其中在 PASS 过程中发生从中间体到钙钛矿相的逐渐部分转变，并伴随着有效的晶体生长。随后的热退火促进晶粒重建和愈合以及相变的完成。 X 射线光电子能谱证实吸电子氟原子调节 [SnI6]4− 电子景观并显着抑制 Sn2+ 氧化。因此，优化后的 FPEA0.04FA0.96SnI3 薄膜表现出改善的结晶质量、增大的晶粒和减少的能量无序（FA：甲脒）。他们的器件功率转换效率达到9.29%（参考：7.99%），运行稳定性显着提高。这项工作建立了清晰的机制框架，并为高性能锡基钙钛矿提供了稳健的设计原理。

title: In vivo CRISPR screening identifies metastasis suppressors in triple-negative breast cancer
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Metastatic cancer remains the leading cause of cancer-related mortality, yet tumor cell–intrinsic mechanisms restraining metastatic dissemination remain incompletely defined. Here, we perform an unbiased in vivo genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 loss-of-function screen in a breast cancer xenograft model to identify regulators of metastatic progression. This approach uncovers clinically relevant metastasis suppressor genes (MSGs), including VPS45, CMTR2, RBSN, and NF2, whose loss enhances lung colonization. Functional validation demonstrates that depletion of these genes promotes epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, migration, invasion, intravasation, and angiogenesis, whereas CRISPR-mediated activation suppresses metastatic spread. Integration with patient datasets reveals reduced expression in tumors and associations with advanced disease, with higher expression trending toward improved outcomes. Notably, CMTR2 loss induces vascular remodeling and intratumoral heterogeneity, supporting a role in tumor–vascular interactions. Collectively, this study identifies a network of MSGs that constrain tumor dissemination and highlights the power of in vivo CRISPR functional genomics to uncover regulators of metastatic disease.
title_zh: 体内 CRISPR 筛选鉴定出三阴性乳腺癌的转移抑制因子
abstract_zh: 转移性癌症仍然是癌症相关死亡的主要原因，但抑制转移性扩散的肿瘤细胞内在机制仍未完全确定。在这里，我们在乳腺癌异种移植模型中进行了无偏倚的体内全基因组 CRISPR/Cas9 功能丧失筛查，以确定转移进展的调节因子。这种方法揭示了临床相关的转移抑制基因 (MSG)，包括 VPS45、CMTR2、RBSN 和 NF2，这些基因的丢失会增强肺部定植。功能验证表明，这些基因的缺失促进上皮间质转化、迁移、侵袭、内渗和血管生成，而 CRISPR 介导的激活则抑制转移扩散。与患者数据集的整合揭示了肿瘤中表达的减少以及与晚期疾病的关联，较高的表达倾向于改善结果。值得注意的是，CMTR2 缺失会诱导血管重塑和瘤内异质性，支持肿瘤与血管相互作用中的作用。总的来说，这项研究确定了一个限制肿瘤扩散的 MSG 网络，并强调了体内 CRISPR 功能基因组学揭示转移性疾病调节因子的力量。

title: A Beetle-Inspired Condensation Interface for Efficient Exhaled Breath Condensate Collection in an Externally Integrated Mask-Based Prototype
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Exhaled breath and exhaled breath condensate (EBC) contain physiologically relevant gaseous and ionic biomarkers and provide a noninvasive route for respiratory-state assessment. However, practical mask-based proof-of-concept readout remains limited by inefficient condensate harvesting and the lack of coordinated multichannel readout. Here, we present an externally integrated, beetle-inspired mask-based prototype that couples a heterogeneous-wettability condensation interface with time-aligned multichannel respiratory readout. The condensation interface consists of hydrophilic nucleation sites on micropillar tops and a superhydrophobic background on the pillar sidewalls and substrate, enabling preferential droplet nucleation and rapid droplet removal. Under matched test conditions, this biomimetic surface achieves a substantially higher EBC collection rate per unit area than smooth, nanocoated, and single-structure control surfaces while maintaining a stable advantage across variations in temperature, humidity, and inclination angle. An externally integrated acquisition module is further used to record real-time gas-phase CO2 and acetone signals together with a time-aligned condensate-derived EBC pH readout under a standardized workflow. The three-channel system shows good repeatability, acceptable environmental robustness, and long-term stability in bench-level evaluation. In a small pilot cohort, human monitoring further suggested state-associated temporal differences among resting, postprandial, post-exercise, febrile, and smoking-related conditions, although these observations should be interpreted as proof-of-concept evidence rather than subject-independent or clinically validated classification. This work establishes a proof-of-concept route that combines biomimetic EBC collection, multichannel respiratory readout, and temporal data fusion in a mask-based prototype.
title_zh: 受甲虫启发的冷凝接口，用于在外部集成的基于面罩的原型中有效收集呼出的呼吸冷凝水
abstract_zh: 摘要 呼出气和呼出气冷凝物 (EBC) 含有生理相关的气体和离子生物标志物，为呼吸状态评估提供了一种无创途径。然而，实用的基于掩模的概念验证读数仍然受到效率低下的冷凝液收集和缺乏协调的多通道读数的限制。在这里，我们提出了一种外部集成的、受甲虫启发的基于面罩的原型，它将异质润湿性冷凝界面与时间对齐的多通道呼吸读数相结合。冷凝界面由微柱顶部的亲水成核位点和柱侧壁和基底上的超疏水背景组成，从而实现优先液滴成核和快速液滴去除。在匹配的测试条件下，这种仿生表面比光滑、纳米涂层和单一结构的控制表面实现了更高的每单位面积 EBC 收集率，同时在温度、湿度和倾斜角度的变化中保持稳定的优势。外部集成采集模块进一步用于在标准化工作流程下记录实时气相 CO2 和丙酮信号以及时间对齐的冷凝液衍生的 EBC pH 读数。三通道系统在实验室级评估中表现出良好的重复性、可接受的环境鲁棒性和长期稳定性。在一个小型试点队列中，人体监测进一步表明静息、餐后、运动后、发热和吸烟相关状况之间存在与状态相关的时间差异，尽管

title: Supercritical CO2-Directed Exposure of {111} Crystal Facets in ZnSn(OH)6 for Enhanced Quantum Spin Exchange and Photocatalytic CO2 Reduction
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The enhancement of photocatalytic efficiency is limited by exciton dynamics, where photogenerated electrons and holes rapidly recombine due to strong Coulomb attraction. The manipulation of electron spin, involving the control of electron spin and spin states, has emerged as a promising strategy to improve photocatalytic performance via spin-polarization-facilitated charge separation. In this work, we demonstrate a spin-polarization effect achieved by treating ZnSn(OH)6 (ZHS) with supercritical CO2 (SC CO2), which accelerates exciton dissociation and spin-dependent electron migration, thereby enhancing the efficiency of photocatalytic CO2 reduction to CO. Mechanistic investigations reveal that SC CO2 treatment induces oxygen vacancies in ZHS, generates spin-polarized electrons, and selectively exposes highly active {111} crystal facets. Experimentally, it reveals that the oxygen vacancies, together with adjacent hydroxyl groups, construct frustrated Lewis pairs (FLPs). Through enhanced quantum spin exchange interactions (QSEIs), the recombination of photogenerated charge carriers is significantly suppressed, and then their lifetime is prolonged, and CO2 adsorption and activation are simultaneously enhanced. It was found that, under treatment at 16 MPa of SC CO2, the CO production rate of ZHS reaches 144.82 μmol·g–1·h–1, which is 29.37 times that of the untreated sample. Therefore, this study demonstrates that manipulating spin-polarized electrons in photocatalytic semiconductors is an effective strategy to boost CO2RR efficiency, offering new insights for the design of efficient spin-dependent photocatalysts toward solar energy conversion.
title_zh: 超临界 CO2 定向暴露 ZnSn(OH)6 中的 {111} 晶面，以增强量子自旋交换和光催化 CO2 还原
abstract_zh: 摘要 光催化效率的提高受到激子动力学的限制，其中光生电子和空穴由于强库仑吸引力而快速复合。电子自旋的操纵，涉及电子自旋和自旋态的控制，已成为通过自旋极化促进电荷分离来提高光催化性能的有前途的策略。在这项工作中，我们证明了通过用超临界CO2 (SC CO2)处理ZnSn(OH)6 (ZHS)实现了自旋极化效应，加速了激子解离和自旋相关电子迁移，从而提高了光催化CO2还原为CO的效率。机理研究表明，SC CO2处理在ZHS中诱导氧空位，产生自旋极化电子，并选择性地暴露高活性的{111}晶面。实验表明，氧空位与相邻的羟基一起构建了受挫路易斯对（FLP）。通过增强的量子自旋交换相互作用（QSEI），显着抑制光生电荷载流子的复合，从而延长其寿命，同时增强CO2吸附和活化。结果发现，在16 MPa SC CO2处理下，ZHS的CO产率达到144.82 μmol·g–1·h–1，是未处理样品的29.37倍。因此，本研究表明，操纵光催化半导体中的自旋极化电子是提高CO2RR效率的有效策略，为设计提供了新的见解。

title: Polarized Metal Nitride Solid Solutions as Electrocatalysts Enabling Ampere-Level Selective Formic Acid Synthesis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Formic acid (FA) is an important value-added product in biomass electrooxidation and an effective liquid fuel and hydrogen carrier. However, achieving its efficient industrial-scale synthesis with durable hydrogen evolution remains challenging. Here, we report a single-phase NiCoN solid-solution metal nitride catalyst, in which atomic-level Co incorporation induces symmetry-breaking Ni–N–Co coordination environments with electronically polarized active sites. This structural modulation drives the interfacial transformation into metal oxy(hydro)xide species and optimizes the adsorption energies of relevant intermediates. These changes accelerate dehydrogenation kinetics and lower the energy barrier for C–C bond cleavage, thereby directing the reaction pathway toward selective stepwise oxidation to FA. The optimal NiCoN catalyst achieves a FA Faradaic efficiency of 97.2% and sustains over 3,600 h of operation at 1 A cm–2 in an anion-exchange membrane (AEM) electrolyzer, representing one of the longest reported lifetimes for a glycerol-assisted coupled system. This work establishes atomic-scale solid-solution engineering as an effective approach to regulate catalytic pathways and long-term interfacial stability for biomass electrochemical conversion.
title_zh: 极化金属氮化物固溶体作为电催化剂实现安培级选择性甲酸合成
abstract_zh: 摘要 甲酸（FA）是生物质电氧化过程中重要的增值产品，也是一种有效的液体燃料和氢载体。然而，实现高效的工业规模合成和持久的析氢仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们报道了一种单相 NiCoN 固溶体金属氮化物催化剂，其中原子级 Co 的掺入诱导了具有电子极化活性位点的对称性破坏的 Ni-N-Co 配位环境。这种结构调节驱动界面转变为金属氧（氢）氧化物物质，并优化相关中间体的吸附能。这些变化加速了脱氢动力学并降低了 C-C 键断裂的能垒，从而引导反应途径选择性逐步氧化为 FA。最佳的 NiCoN 催化剂可实现 97.2% 的 FA 法拉第效率，并在阴离子交换膜 (AEM) 电解槽中以 1 A cm-2 的电流维持超过 3,600 小时的运行，这是甘油辅助耦合系统报道的最长寿命之一。这项工作将原子级固溶体工程确立为调节生物质电化学转化催化途径和长期界面稳定性的有效方法。

title: MOF/Hydrophobic Polymer Composites for Toluene Capture
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract We present a comprehensive computational study of DUT-4(Al)-based composites incorporating hydrophobic polymers, polystyrene (PS), polypropylene (PP), poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF), and polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS), to evaluate their potential for selective toluene capture under humidity. Using a multiscale approach combining density functional theory (DFT), grand canonical Monte Carlo (GCMC), molecular dynamics (MD) simulations, and graph theory tools, we establish structure−property relationships linking polymer infiltration behavior to MOF porosity, toluene sorption capacity, and transport. Our results reveal a clear hierarchy of polymer penetration within DUT-4(Al), ranging from strong channel disruption in PP to largely surface-confined PS, with PVDF and PDMS exhibiting intermediate infiltration while preserving continuous pore pathways in the MOF channels. These structural differences directly govern adsorption performance, with DUT-4(Al)/PS retaining the highest relative toluene uptake and DUT-4(Al)/PP the lowest. Among the composites studied, DUT-4(Al)/PVDF emerges as the most balanced system, combining substantial toluene accessibility with favorable dynamics. Importantly, MD simulations show that PVDF promotes rapid toluene diffusion into MOF channels while effectively hindering water penetration, thereby enhancing selective uptake under humid conditions. Overall, this work demonstrates that rational polymer selection is a powerful strategy to tune adsorption and transport properties in MOF/polymer composites. The insights provided here establish a general computational framework for the design of robust, humidity-resistant composites for VOC capture applications.
title_zh: 用于甲苯捕获的 MOF/疏水聚合物复合材料
abstract_zh: 摘要：我们对包含疏水性聚合物、聚苯乙烯 (PS)、聚丙烯 (PP)、聚偏二氟乙烯 (PVDF) 和聚二甲基硅氧烷 (PDMS) 的 DUT-4(Al) 基复合材料进行了全面的计算研究，以评估它们在湿度下选择性捕获甲苯的潜力。使用结合密度泛函理论 (DFT)、大正则蒙特卡罗 (GCMC)、分子动力学 (MD) 模拟和图论工具的多尺度方法，我们建立了将聚合物渗透行为与 MOF 孔隙率、甲苯吸附能力和传输联系起来的结构-性能关系。我们的结果揭示了 DUT-4(Al) 内聚合物渗透的清晰层次，从 PP 中的强烈通道破坏到很大程度上表面限制的 PS，PVDF 和 PDMS 表现出中间渗透，同时保留 MOF 通道中的连续孔道。这些结构差异直接决定吸附性能，DUT-4(Al)/PS 保持最高的相对甲苯吸收量，DUT-4(Al)/PP 最低。在所研究的复合材料中，DUT-4(Al)/PVDF 成为最平衡的系统，将大量的甲苯可及性与良好的动力学相结合。重要的是，MD 模拟表明，PVDF 促进甲苯快速扩散到 MOF 通道中，同时有效阻碍水渗透，从而增强潮湿条件下的选择性吸收。总的来说，这项工作表明，合理的聚合物选择是调整 MOF/聚合物复合材料吸附和传输性能的有效策略。这里提供的见解建立了一个基因

title: Laporte-Rule-Guided Molecular Symmetry Control of NIR-Selective Organic Semiconductors for Colorless and Transparent Photovoltaics
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Near-infrared (NIR)-selective organic photovoltaics (OPVs), which harvest NIR photons while remaining transparent in the visible region, offer a promising platform for colorless and transparent solar cells. However, it remains difficult to design molecules that simultaneously possess NIR-selective absorption and the semiconductor characteristics required for OPV operation. Here, we combine Laporte-rule-guided control of molecular symmetry with intramolecular charge-transfer engineering using a strongly electron-donating indacenodipyrrole unit to develop an acceptor–donor–acceptor molecule P1 with absorption extending into the NIR region. Theoretical calculations predict that the dominant allowed transition of P1 is to the first excited state, whereas transitions to higher excited states are largely suppressed. Consistent with this, P1 selectively absorbs in the NIR region with negligible visible absorption, yielding a colorless and transparent appearance. The frontier-orbital energetics and excitonic parameters of P1 are suitable for NIR-selective photoelectric conversion. Notably, single-component OPVs based on P1 achieve external quantum efficiencies exceeding 15% in the NIR region while retaining high visible transparency. Time-resolved measurements further confirm effective carrier generation and charge transport under NIR photoexcitation. These results demonstrate that orbital-symmetry control can suppress visible absorption while charge-transfer-induced bandgap narrowing enables NIR photoresponse, offering a molecular design principle for colorless wavelength-selective organic optoelectronic devices.
title_zh: 用于无色透明光伏的近红外选择性有机半导体的拉波尔特规则引导分子对称控制
abstract_zh: 摘要 近红外（NIR）选择性有机光伏（OPV）可收集近红外光子，同时在可见光区域保持透明，为无色透明太阳能电池提供了一个有前途的平台。然而，设计同时具有近红外选择性吸收和 OPV 操作所需的半导体特性的分子仍然很困难。在这里，我们将拉波尔特规则引导的分子对称性控制与分子内电荷转移工程相结合，使用强给电子茚并二吡咯单元来开发吸收延伸至近红外区域的受体-供体-受体分子 P1。理论计算预测，P1 的主要允许跃迁是向第一激发态的跃迁，而向更高激发态的跃迁在很大程度上受到抑制。与此一致的是，P1 在近红外区域选择性吸收，可见光吸收可以忽略不计，从而产生无色透明的外观。 P1的前沿轨道能量学和激子参数适合近红外选择性光电转换。值得注意的是，基于 P1 的单组分 OPV 在近红外区域实现了超过 15% 的外量子效率，同时保持了高可见光透明度。时间分辨测量进一步证实了近红外光激发下有效的载流子生成和电荷传输。这些结果表明，轨道对称控制可以抑制可见光吸收，而电荷转移引起的带隙变窄可以实现近红外光响应，为无色波长提供分子设计原理

title: Spin-State Engineering of Manganese Boosts the Electrochemical Performance of LiFe0.2Mn0.8PO4 Cathodes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Olivine-type lithium manganese iron phosphates (LMFPs) have been regarded as promising cathodes for high-energy-density lithium-ion batteries owing to an additional potential plateau at 4 V; however, the poor cycle stability arising from the Jahn–Teller distortion of Mn3+ hinders their practical applications. In this work, high-entropy doping has been proposed to reduce the spin state of Mn2+ in LMFP from a high-spin to an intermediate-spin configuration. The spin-state reduction not only eliminates the intrinsic driving force for Jahn–Teller distortion but also strengthens the stability of the Mn–O bond. Additionally, experimental data and theoretical calculations demonstrate that the reduced spin state of Mn2+ can narrow the bandgap, optimize ion transport pathways, and accelerate Li+ extraction-insertion kinetics within the high-entropy-doped LMFP. The refined LiMn0.65Mg0.03Ca0.03Zn0.03Cu0.03Nb0.03Fe0.2PO4 (HE-LMFP) cathode can demonstrate a remarkable capacity retention of 96.2% after 10,000 cycles at 10 C, along with outstanding rate performance (64.7 mAh g–1 at 50 C) and great commercial application potential (82.5% retention over 1000 cycles at 0.5 C in a 1.5 Ah pouch cell). Our spin-modulation strategy provides a general design principle for suppressing the Jahn–Teller distortion in manganese-based cathodes, thereby promoting the development of next-generation high-energy-density lithium-ion batteries.
title_zh: 锰的自旋态工程提高了 LiFe0.2Mn0.8PO4 阴极的电化学性能
abstract_zh: 摘要：橄榄石型磷酸锰铁锂（LMFP）由于在 4 V 处具有额外的电位平台，被认为是高能量密度锂离子电池的有前途的正极。然而，Mn3+的Jahn-Teller变形导致的较差的循环稳定性阻碍了它们的实际应用。在这项工作中，提出了高熵掺杂来将 LMFP 中 Mn2+ 的自旋态从高自旋配置降低到中自旋配置。自旋态的减少不仅消除了Jahn-Teller畸变的内在驱动力，而且增强了Mn-O键的稳定性。此外，实验数据和理论计算表明，Mn2+自旋态的降低可以缩小带隙，优化离子传输路径，并加速高熵掺杂LMFP内的Li+提取-插入动力学。精制的 LiMn0.65Mg0.03Ca0.03Zn0.03Cu0.03Nb0.03Fe0.2PO4 (HE-LMFP) 正极在 10 C 下循环 10,000 次后容量保持率高达 96.2%，同时具有出色的倍率性能（50 C 时为 64.7 mAh g–1）和巨大的商业应用潜力（在 10 C 下循环 1000 次后容量保持率为 82.5%）。 1.5 Ah 软包电池中为 0.5 C）。我们的自旋调制策略为抑制锰基阴极中的Jahn-Teller畸变提供了通用设计原理，从而促进了下一代高能量密度锂离子电池的发展。

title: Rational Design of Light-Driven Molecular Motors Enabled by a Data-Efficient Machine Learning Framework for Nonadiabatic Dynamics
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Light-driven molecular rotary motors convert photon energy into mechanical motion, but designing systems that combine high rotational speed with robust unidirectionality remains a fundamental challenge. Conventional four-stroke motors rely on thermally activated steps that often slow complete rotary cycles to microsecond-to-second or even longer time scales, whereas emerging bioinspired designs may achieve much faster photoinduced rotation. However, the computational study of both classes is limited by the prohibitive cost of quantum-chemical nonadiabatic dynamics over the extended time scales required to resolve productive rotary motion. Here, we introduce N2ZND, a Neural Network Zhu–Nakamura Dynamics framework that combines hierarchical sampling with E(3)-equivariant deep learning to enable data-efficient simulations of excited-state molecular motor dynamics. Trained on sparse, chemically targeted high-level ab initio data, N2ZND achieves chemical accuracy and enables extensive nonadiabatic simulations of light-driven motors across relevant time scales. Application of N2ZND to a complex bioinspired motor reveals a two-stroke operating mechanism that bypasses the thermally activated barriers characteristic of conventional four-stroke motors, enabling complete rotary motion on a picosecond time scale. We further identify an intrinsic speed-directionality trade-off: removal of thermal gating accelerates rotation but can reduce directional fidelity through excited-state wavepacket bifurcation. Guided by this mechanistic insight, we rationally designed a structurally modified motor in which steric tuning reshapes the excited-state topology, restoring robust room-temperature unidirectionality while preserving picosecond rotary operation. These results establish N2ZND as a scalable platform for mechanistic discovery and rational design of light-driven molecular machines, providing a foundation for future high-throughput screening across traditional and bioinspired motor architectures.
title_zh: 通过非绝热动力学的数据高效机器学习框架实现光驱动分子电机的合理设计
abstract_zh: 摘要：光驱动分子旋转电机将光子能量转化为机械运动，但设计将高旋转速度与强大的单向性相结合的系统仍然是一个基本挑战。传统的四冲程电机依赖于热激活步骤，通常将整个旋转周期减慢到微秒到秒甚至更长的时间尺度，而新兴的仿生设计可以实现更快的光诱导旋转。然而，这两类的计算研究都受到解决有效旋转运动所需的长时间尺度内量子化学非绝热动力学成本过高的限制。在这里，我们介绍 N2ZND，这是一种神经网络 Zhu-Nakamura 动力学框架，它将分层采样与 E(3) 等变深度学习相结合，以实现激发态分子运动动力学的数据高效模拟。 N2ZND 经过稀疏的、化学靶向的高级从头计算数据的训练，实现了化学准确性，并能够在相关时间尺度上对光驱动电机进行广泛的非绝热模拟。 N2ZND 在复杂仿生电机中的应用揭示了一种二冲程操作机制，该机制绕过了传统四冲程电机的热激活屏障特性，从而能够在皮秒时间尺度上实现完整的旋转运动。我们进一步确定了内在的速度与方向性权衡：去除热门控可以加速旋转，但可以通过激发态波包分叉降低方向保真度。在这种机制洞察的指导下，我们合理地设计了一个结构

title: An Adaptable Porous Metal–Organic Framework for Structural Visualization of Beyond Rule of 5 Molecules on the Microgram Scale
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Beyond rule of 5 (bRo5) pharmaceutical compounds represent major structural challenges due to their large size and complexity. Here, we show that a metal–organic framework, APF-40, enables encapsulation and structural visualization of bRo5 molecules. It comprises a new benzoate-substituted hexaazaphenalene ligand and Zn8 clusters forming a doubly interpenetrated framework. The dynamic movement of the two nets facilitates adaptive behavior, efficiently immobilizing molecules along with their solvation spheres. Structures of 12 guests, including eight bRo5 compounds with subtly differing substituent modifications─ methyl-to-ethyl, methoxy-to-hydroxy, and alkane-to-alkene─were precisely elucidated. Significantly, one compound, isolated from a commercially available sample, was identified as a novel ivermectin derivative. This work demonstrates μg-order structure determination of molecules larger than 500 Da, offering new possibilities for characterizing compounds previously intractable for established analytical techniques.
title_zh: 一种适应性强的多孔金属有机框架，用于微克级超规则 5 分子的结构可视化
abstract_zh: 摘要 超 5 规则 (bRo5) 药物化合物由于其尺寸大且复杂，因此面临着重大的结构挑战。在这里，我们展示了金属有机框架 APF-40 能够实现 bRo5 分子的封装和结构可视化。它包含一个新的苯甲酸酯取代的六氮杂苯配体和形成双互穿框架的 Zn8 簇。两个网络的动态运动促进了适应性行为，有效地固定分子及其溶剂化球。精确阐明了 12 种客体的结构，其中包括 8 种 bRo5 化合物，其取代基修饰略有不同（甲基到乙基、甲氧基到羟基和烷烃到烯烃）。值得注意的是，从市售样品中分离出的一种化合物被鉴定为一种新型伊维菌素衍生物。这项工作展示了大于 500 Da 分子的 μg 级结构测定，为表征以前用现有分析技术难以处理的化合物提供了新的可能性。

title: Tuning and Characterizing the Structure of Peptide Core-Shell Multiphasic Condensates by the Blue Fluorescent Amino Acid 4-Cyanotryptophan
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Biomolecular condensates formed via liquid–liquid phase separation (LLPS) play crucial roles in cellular organization and offer a versatile platform for designing synthetic organelles. Recently, extremely short peptides have been shown to assemble into highly organized core-shell multiphasic condensates, where tryptophan (Trp) residues play an indispensable role (Zhou, L.; et al.J. Am. Chem. Soc.2025, 147, 31290–31299.). Here, we rationally reprogram the architecture of these short-peptide condensates by substituting native Trp with the unnatural amino acid 4-cyanotryptophan (4CN-Trp). Using the intrinsic fluorescence and infrared reporting capabilities of 4CN-Trp, we monitor the LLPS behavior of a targeted library of 4CN-Trp-substituted peptides. We reveal that a single atomic-level substitution from Trp to 4CN-Trp fundamentally inverts the condensate architecture. In contrast to the solid-core/liquid-shell droplets formed by native Trp-containing peptides, the 4CN-Trp-containing peptides assemble into core-shell condensates featuring a dynamic, highly hydrated, liquid-like inner core enveloped by a dense, solid-like outer shell. Our findings highlight how subtle modifications to aromatic residues can dramatically modulate the macroscopic physical properties of multiphasic condensates, offering a new strategy for the precise engineering of peptide-based synthetic organelles and smart biomaterials.
title_zh: 利用蓝色荧光氨基酸 4-氰基色氨酸调节和表征肽核壳多相缩合物的结构
abstract_zh: 摘要：通过液-液相分离（LLPS）形成的生物分子缩合物在细胞组织中发挥着至关重要的作用，并为设计合成细胞器提供了一个多功能平台。最近，极短的肽已被证明可以组装成高度组织的核-壳多相缩合物，其中色氨酸 (Trp) 残基起着不可或缺的作用 (Zhou, L.; et al.J. Am. Chem. Soc.2025, 147, 31290–31299.)。在这里，我们通过用非天然氨基酸 4-氰基色氨酸 (4CN-Trp) 取代天然色氨酸，合理地重新编程了这些短肽缩合物的结构。利用 4CN-Trp 的固有荧光和红外报告功能，我们监测 4CN-Trp 取代肽的目标库的 LLPS 行为。我们揭示了从 Trp 到 4CN-Trp 的单原子级替代从根本上颠倒了凝聚态结构。与天然含色氨酸肽形成的固核/液壳液滴相比，含4CN-Trp的肽组装成核壳缩合物，其特征是动态的、高度水合的、液体状的内核被致密的、固体状的外壳包裹。我们的研究结果强调了对芳香残基的细微修饰如何能够显着调节多相冷凝物的宏观物理性质，为基于肽的合成细胞器和智能生物材料的精确工程提供了新策略。

title: Lowering the δ-to-α Phase-Transition Barrier via a Transient Vapor Mediator in Perovskite Formation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Hybrid sequential deposition (HSD) remains a practical pathway for the scalable fabrication of perovskite photovoltaics, though it is frequently constrained by the formation of dense evaporated precursor frameworks and the associated kinetic limitations of the subsequent solid interdiffusion. These constraints often manifest as incomplete conversion and vertical inhomogeneity in the resulting perovskite film. Herein, we report a transient vapor-deposited mediator (TVM) strategy that translates the principles of liquid-phase mediator engineering to a vapor-phase process. By incorporating Pb(SCN)2 during the coevaporation of inorganic precursors, the resulting framework exhibits modified porosity that facilitates the infiltration of organic salts and lowers the activation energy for the solid-state δ-to-α phase transition. The elimination of the mediator under ambient humidity is accompanied by the egress of FASCN-related volatile species, promoting more complete and uniform conversion through the full film thickness with reduced residual PbI2 and lower trap density. This TVM process enables solar cells’ power-conversion efficiency to increase from 22.3% to 25.2% and yields enhanced operational robustness, retaining 91% of initial performance after 1200 h of thermal aging at 85 °C and 95% after 1600 h of continuous maximum power point tracking under illumination.
title_zh: 通过钙钛矿形成中的瞬态蒸气介体降低 δ 到 α 相变势垒
abstract_zh: 摘要 混合顺序沉积（HSD）仍然是钙钛矿光伏电池可扩展制造的实用途径，尽管它经常受到致密蒸发前驱体框架的形成以及随后固体相互扩散的相关动力学限制的限制。这些限制通常表现为所得钙钛矿薄膜的不完全转化和垂直不均匀性。在此，我们报告了一种瞬态气相沉积介体（TVM）策略，该策略将液相介体工程的原理转化为气相过程。通过在无机前体共蒸发过程中掺入 Pb(SCN)2，所得框架表现出改进的孔隙率，有利于有机盐的渗透并降低固态 δ 到 α 相变的活化能。在环境湿度下介质的消除伴随着与 FASCN 相关的挥发性物质的逸出，促进整个膜厚度的更完全和均匀的转化，同时减少残留 PbI2 和降低陷阱密度。这种TVM工艺使太阳能电池的功率转换效率从22.3%提高到25.2%，并增强了运行鲁棒性，在85°C下热老化1200小时后保留了91%的初始性能，在光照下连续最大功率点跟踪1600小时后保留了95%的初始性能。

title: Photoacoustic-Raman Imageable Embolic Microspheres for Depth-Dependent Laser-Dosage Guidance of Photothermal Therapy of Hepatocellular Carcinoma
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Transarterial embolization in combination with photothermal therapy (PTT) represents a promising strategy for unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). However, its clinical application is hindered by the lack of accurate laser-dosage guidance regimens, which results in tumor recurrence from insufficient irradiation or complications from excessive ablation. Here, we develop a depth-dependent laser-dosage guidance strategy for photothermal therapy via dual photoacoustic (PA)-Raman imaging using BBTPPRO-loaded poly(lactic-co-glycolic acid) microspheres (BBTPPRO MPs) as a theranostic embolic platform. The BBTPPRO MPs have a uniform spherical morphology (53.21 μm average diameter) with a drug loading of 4.73% and an encapsulation efficiency of 99.23%. The aggregated state of BBTPPRO through microsphere encapsulation offers substrate-free Raman signals via the stacking-induced intermolecular charge transfer-enhanced Raman scattering effect and enhances PA signals and photothermal conversion efficiency (29.7%) through the aggregation-caused quenching effect. By calibrating the required irradiation time to reach the temperature threshold required for complete thermal ablation under a fixed laser power density at various tissue depths, we establish a depth-dependent laser-dosage guidance strategy. In the orthotopic N1S1 rat liver tumor model after hepatic arterial embolization of BBTPPRO MPs, the PA imaging noninvasively assesses tumor depth to guide laser dosage, while the intraoperative Raman imaging provides tumor localization and delineation for the laser irradiation field. This dual-modal strategy has exhibited superior antitumor efficacy evidenced by a significantly lower maximum standardized uptake value via 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose positron emission tomography-computed tomography (1.68 ± 0.30) at 14 days post-treatment compared to conventional PTT group (6.92 ± 3.63). Overall, this PA-Raman image-guided strategy integrates pretreatment laser-dosage guidance with intraoperative spatial targeting, highlighting its potential to improve the safety and efficacy of HCC ablation.
title_zh: 光声拉曼成像栓塞微球用于肝细胞癌光热治疗的深度依赖性激光剂量指导
abstract_zh: 摘要 经动脉栓塞联合光热疗法（PTT）是治疗不可切除的肝细胞癌（HCC）的一种有前景的策略。然而，由于缺乏准确的激光剂量指导方案，其临床应用受到阻碍，导致肿瘤因照射不足而复发或因过度消融而出现并发症。在这里，我们使用装载 BBTPPRO 的聚（乳酸-乙醇酸）微球（BBTPPRO MP）作为治疗诊断栓塞平台，通过双光声（PA）-拉曼成像开发了一种深度依赖的激光剂量指导策略，用于光热治疗。 BBTPPRO MPs 具有均匀的球形形态（平均直径 53.21 μm），载药量为 4.73%，包封率为 99.23%。 BBTPPRO通过微球封装的聚集态通过堆叠引起的分子间电荷转移增强拉曼散射效应提供无基质拉曼信号，并通过聚集引起的猝灭效应增强PA信号和光热转换效率（29.7%）。通过校准所需的照射时间以达到在不同组织深度的固定激光功率密度下完全热消融所需的温度阈值，我们建立了一种与深度相关的激光剂量指导策略。在 BBTPPRO MP 肝动脉栓塞后的原位 N1S1 大鼠肝脏肿瘤模型中，PA 成像无创评估肿瘤深度以指导激光剂量，而术中拉曼成像为激光照射提供肿瘤定位和勾画。

title: Operation-Induced BiVO4 Surface Reconstruction Modulates Photoelectrochemical Glycerol Photooxidation Stability and Activity
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Operation-induced surface reconstruction of photoelectrodes is underexplored as a path to control stability and performance. We show how adaptive junctions form via surface reconstruction of BiVO4 during glycerol photooxidation and how these surfaces affect electrolyte-dependent kinetics and durability. Preferential V dissolution in both acidic and alkaline media forms a Bi-rich layer. In situ measurements through a dual-working-electrode platform quantify the changes in photovoltage and charge-transfer resistance derived from adaptive junction formation, while enabling quantitative separation of the driving forces for charge separation and interfacial catalysis. The reconstructed surface in acidic media improves hole-transfer kinetics, functions as a glycerol-oxidation catalyst, and imparts photostability. Surface reconstruction in alkaline media exhibits the opposite behavior, impeding hole injection. This instability is mitigated by trace Ni2+ ions, which drive in situ surface activation without cocatalyst pre-deposition. This study shows the significance of surface reconstruction in the design of durable photoelectrodes for applications targeting organic electro-oxidation.
title_zh: 操作诱导的 BiVO4 表面重建调节光电化学甘油光氧化稳定性和活性
abstract_zh: 摘要：操作引起的光电极表面重构作为控制稳定性和性能的途径尚未得到充分探索。我们展示了甘油光氧化过程中如何通过 BiVO4 的表面重建形成自适应连接，以及这些表面如何影响电解质依赖性动力学和耐久性。 V 在酸性和碱性介质中优先溶解，形成富 Bi 层。通过双工作电极平台进行原位测量，量化自适应结形成产生的光电压和电荷转移电阻的变化，同时实现电荷分离和界面催化驱动力的定量分离。酸性介质中的重构表面改善了空穴转移动力学，充当甘油氧化催化剂，并赋予光稳定性。碱性介质中的表面重构表现出相反的行为，阻碍空穴注入。这种不稳定性可以通过微量 Ni2+ 离子来缓解，这些离子可在无需助催化剂预沉积的情况下驱动原位表面活化。这项研究表明了表面重构在针对有机电氧化应用的耐用光电极设计中的重要性。

title: Electrode Engineering for Advanced Organic Semiconductor Devices
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Electrodes are fundamental determinants of performance in semiconductor devices, governing the critical processes of charge injection, extraction, and interfacial transport. As device architectures transition from rigid, large-scale systems toward miniaturized, flexible, and biointegrated platforms, the requirements for electrode design have evolved into a complex, multiobjective optimization challenge. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the recent advances in electrode materials and engineering strategies using organic field-effect transistors (OFETs) as a primary model system to illustrate broader semiconductor design principles that are universally applicable to organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs), organic photovoltaics (OPVs), and other organic semiconductor electronics. We first establish a multidimensional framework for ideal electrode evaluation, encompassing electrical properties, fabrication processability, environmental stability, and the burgeoning demands for mechanical and biological compatibility. A systematic comparison is provided between traditional metallic electrodes and emerging alternatives, including conducting polymers, carbon-based nanomaterials, and doped organic electrodes (DOEs). Special attention is given to the “conductivity threshold” in organic electronics, suggesting that interfacial compatibility often outweighs bulk conductivity in determining device efficacy. Finally, by outlining a roadmap toward multifunctional, green, and biocompatible electrode technologies, this review aims to provide a cornerstone for the next generation of ubiquitous and human-centric semiconductor electronics.
title_zh: 先进有机半导体器件的电极工程
abstract_zh: 摘要 电极是半导体器件性能的基本决定因素，控制着电荷注入、提取和界面传输的关键过程。随着设备架构从刚性、大规模系统过渡到小型化、柔性和生物集成平台，电极设计的要求已演变成复杂的、多目标优化挑战。本综述全面概述了电极材料和工程策略的最新进展，使用有机场效应晶体管 (OFET) 作为主要模型系统，以说明普遍适用于有机发光二极管 (OLED)、有机光伏 (OPV) 和其他有机半导体电子器件的更广泛的半导体设计原理。我们首先建立了理想电极评估的多维框架，包括电性能、制造加工性、环境稳定性以及对机械和生物兼容性的新兴需求。对传统金属电极和新兴替代品（包括导电聚合物、碳基纳米材料和掺杂有机电极（DOE））进行了系统比较。特别关注有机电子学中的“电导率阈值”，这表明在决定器件功效时界面相容性通常超过体电导率。最后，通过概述多功能、绿色和生物相容性电极技术的路线图，本次审查旨在为下一步的发展奠定基础。

title: Distinct Microstructural Evolution of Li- and Mn-Rich Oxide Cathodes during Calendar and Cycle Aging of Lithium-Ion Batteries
source: ACS Energy Letters: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The respective microstructural impacts of calendar and cycle aging of Li-ion battery cathodes remain difficult to distinguish because both processes often occur simultaneously. Here, we isolate the microstructural evolution of these aging modes on a Li- and Mn-rich (LMR) layered oxide cathode using aberration-corrected scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (STEM-EDS), and electron energy-loss spectroscopy (STEM-EELS). Both aging modes induce similar near-surface degradation, including surface reconstruction, cation mixing, and activation of a (003)-facet phase transformation. However, notable differences emerge in the cathode–electrolyte interphase, indicating distinct electrolyte decomposition pathways under static and dynamic conditions. More significantly, nanovoid formation is exclusively observed in cycle-aged particles but is absent after calendar aging, suggesting that repeated Li transport promotes irreversible migration and loss of oxygen and transition-metal species, thus leading to vacancy condensation within the bulk lattice. These findings shed light on improving the long-term stability of LMR cathodes.
title_zh: 锂离子电池日历和循环老化过程中富锂和富锰氧化物正极的独特微观结构演变
abstract_zh: 摘要 锂离子电池正极的日历老化和循环老化各自的微观结构影响仍然难以区分，因为这两个过程通常同时发生。在这里，我们使用像差校正扫描透射电子显微镜 (STEM)、能量色散 X 射线光谱 (STEM-EDS) 和电子能量损失光谱 (STEM-EELS) 分离出富锂和富锰 (LMR) 层状氧化物阴极上这些老化模式的微观结构演变。两种老化模式都会引起类似的近表面退化，包括表面重建、阳离子混合和 (003) 面相变的激活。然而，阴极-电解质界面出现显着差异，表明静态和动态条件下电解质分解途径不同。更重要的是，纳米空隙的形成仅在循环老化的颗粒中观察到，但在日历老化后不存在，这表明重复的锂传输促进了氧和过渡金属物种的不可逆迁移和损失，从而导致块体晶格内的空位凝结。这些发现为提高 LMR 阴极的长期稳定性提供了线索。

title: Acid-/Base- and Site-Hindrance-Induced Cage Transformation and Hierarchical Self-Assembly of Regular Nanoaggregates
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Regulating the topology redistribution of coordination cages through acid-/base-responsive ligand conversion remains challenging, especially when cage topology is further directed by substituent steric effects and spatial orientation. Herein, we report a supramolecular cage system showing substituent-directed topology redistribution and fluorescence modulation under acid/base regulation. Acid- and base-induced ring-closing and ring-opening reactions provide a covalent structural switch in bisimidazolium ligands, and the resulting ligands self-assemble with Zn2+ ions into cage assemblies assigned to cuboctahedral, octahedral, square-prismatic, and triangular-prismatic cage architectures. The steric hindrance and spatial orientation of the substituents modulate the apparent cage topology distribution, while coordination-induced cage rigidity and substituent-dependent local steric restriction jointly give rise to fluorescence modulation with quantum yields varying by more than two orders of magnitude. Furthermore, the hierarchical self-assembly of cuboctahedral cages into hexagonal nanoaggregates or lyotropic nanostructures was observed by TEM, depending on the electrostatics and geometry-induced packing forces. This study demonstrates how substituent-directed ligand design couples acid-/base-responsive cage topology redistribution with optical and aggregation behaviors.
title_zh: 酸/碱和位阻诱导的笼转化和规则纳米聚集体的分层自组装
abstract_zh: 摘要：通过酸/碱响应性配体转换来调节配位笼的拓扑重新分布仍然具有挑战性，特别是当笼拓扑进一步受到取代基空间效应和空间取向的指导时。在此，我们报道了一种超分子笼系统，显示出酸/碱调节下取代基导向的拓扑重新分布和荧光调制。酸和碱诱导的闭环和开环反应在双咪唑配体中提供了共价结构转换，所得配体与 Zn2+ 离子自组装成笼组件，指定为立方八面体、八面体、方棱柱和三棱柱笼结构。取代基的空间位阻和空间取向调节表观笼拓扑分布，而配位引起的笼刚性和取代基依赖的局部空间限制共同引起荧光调制，量子产率变化超过两个数量级。此外，通过 TEM 观察到立方八面体笼分层自组装成六方纳米聚集体或溶致纳米结构，这取决于静电和几何诱导的堆积力。这项研究展示了取代基导向的配体设计如何将酸/碱响应笼拓扑重新分布与光学和聚集行为结合起来。

title: Electron-Withdrawing Ligand Modulation of Pt Sites in a Covalent Organic Framework for Photocatalytic CO2-to-CH4 Conversion
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Photocatalytic CO2-to-CH4 conversion in water remains challenging because selective multielectron proton-coupled reduction requires efficient charge separation and controlled intermediate hydrogenation. Herein, we report an electron-withdrawing-ligand-regulated Pt-site covalent organic framework, Pt−LEW/TBCOF, for selective CO2-to-CH4 photoconversion in CO2-saturated pure water without sacrificial reagents. The donor−acceptor TBCOF scaffold, constructed from tris(4-aminophenyl)benzene-derived donor units and bipyridine acceptor units, provides visible-light absorption and well-defined N-coordination sites for Pt immobilization. A preformed Pt complex bearing an electron-withdrawing fluorinated ligand was incorporated into the bipyridine-containing framework to generate highly dispersed Pt coordination sites with a regulated local electronic structure. TBCOF mainly produces CO with negligible CH4 formation, while ligand-free Pt/TBCOF exhibits only limited CH4 generation and low selectivity. In contrast, Pt−LEW/TBCOF shows a markedly enhanced CH4/CO ratio at the same Pt loading. Increasing the Pt loading to 8.1 wt % affords a CH4 production rate of 53.9 μmol g−1 h−1 with 89% CH4 selectivity among gaseous carbon products under visible-light irradiation. Spectroscopic, photoelectrochemical, and theoretical analyses suggest that the donor−acceptor COF backbone facilitates charge separation, whereas the electron-withdrawing ligand environment modulates the electronic structure and intermediate conversion behavior of Pt sites, favoring further hydrogenation toward CH4. This work suggests that electron-withdrawing ligand modulation of Pt sites may provide a useful approach for regulating product selectivity in the present COF-based photocatalytic system.
title_zh: 共价有机框架中 Pt 位点的吸电子配体调制用于光催化 CO2 转化为 CH4
abstract_zh: 摘要 水中的光催化 CO2 转化为 CH4 仍然具有挑战性，因为选择性多电子质子耦合还原需要有效的电荷分离和受控的中间氢化。在此，我们报道了一种吸电子配体调节的 Pt 位点共价有机框架 Pt−LEW/TBCOF，用于在 CO2 饱和纯水中选择性地将 CO2 光转化为 CH4，无需牺牲试剂。供体-受体 TBCOF 支架由三（4-氨基苯基）苯衍生的供体单元和联吡啶受体单元构建，为 Pt 固定提供可见光吸收和明确的 N 配位位点。将带有吸电子氟化配体的预制 Pt 配合物纳入含联吡啶的骨架中，以产生具有受调节局部电子结构的高度分散的 Pt 配位位点。 TBCOF 主要产生 CO，CH4 的形成可以忽略不计，而无配体的 Pt/TBCOF 仅产生有限的 CH4 且选择性较低。相比之下，Pt−LEW/TBCOF 在相同的 Pt 负载量下显示出显着提高的 CH4/CO 比率。将 Pt 负载量增加到 8.1 wt%，在可见光照射下，CH4 生产率为 53.9 μmol g−1 h−1，气态碳产物中 CH4 选择性为 89%。光谱、光电化学和理论分析表明，供体-受体COF主链有利于电荷分离，而吸电子配体环境调节Pt位点的电子结构和中间转化行为，有利于进一步氢化为CH4。钍

title: Understanding global social acceptance of hydrogen technologies: trust, adoption barriers, and policy insights from an international survey
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: Hydrogen is increasingly recognized as a key energy carrier with potential to support energy security and climate mitigation. While techno-economic and environmental aspects are well studied, the social dimension of hydrogen deployment remains comparatively underexplored. This study addresses this gap through an international survey of more than 1000 respondents, providing global insights into the factors shaping public acceptance of hydrogen technologies. The survey covers demographic characteristics, general awareness, and perceptions of specific hydrogen applications. The results show that universities and research centers are the most trusted sources of information, emphasizing the critical role of scientific institutions in shaping public understanding. Hydrogen technologies are generally perceived as safe; however, acceptance is strongly influenced by access to reliable information and public awareness. Economic factors emerge as a key driver, with respondents indicating that financial incentives would significantly increase adoption willingness. Applications such as hydrogen use as a chemical feedstock and for renewable energy storage are viewed most favorably, reflecting their higher technological maturity and policy support. Overall, the findings demonstrate that trust and economic considerations, rather than safety concerns, are the main determinants of hydrogen acceptance. This highlights the need to integrate social-perception indicators into energy planning and to align hydrogen policies with effective communication strategies and targeted economic support.
title_zh: 了解氢技术的全球社会接受度：来自国际调查的信任、采用障碍和政策见解
abstract_zh: 氢越来越被认为是一种重要的能源载体，具有支持能源安全和减缓气候变化的潜力。尽管技术经济和环境方面得到了充分研究，但氢部署的社会层面仍然相对不足。本研究通过对 1000 多名受访者进行的国际调查来解决这一差距，提供有关影响公众接受氢技术的因素的全球见解。该调查涵盖人口特征、一般意识以及对特定氢应用的看法。结果表明，大学和研究中心是最值得信赖的信息来源，强调了科研机构在塑造公众理解方面的关键作用。氢技术通常被认为是安全的；然而，接受程度很大程度上受到可靠信息和公众意识的影响。经济因素成为关键驱动因素，受访者表示经济激励将显着提高采用意愿。氢作为化学原料和可再生能源储存等应用最受青睐，这反映了它们更高的技术成熟度和政策支持。总体而言，研究结果表明，信任和经济考虑，而不是安全问题，是氢接受的主要决定因素。这凸显了将社会认知指标纳入能源规划的必要性，并使氢能政策与有效的沟通策略和有针对性的经济支持保持一致。

title: Counterfactual load forecasting with LLM-structured events and representation learning
source: ScienceDirect Publication: Applied Energy
abstract: News-reported social, environmental, and grid events can substantially reshape electricity demand, yet quantifying how such events perturb forecasted load trajectories remains largely unaddressed. Existing news-augmented forecasting studies use news as auxiliary features to reduce prediction error but cannot answer counterfactual questions about demand under alternative event conditions. Counterfactual forecasting naturally formulates this problem by comparing the factual trajectory under observed news with counterfactual trajectories under alternative treatments, such as removing events or injecting hypothetical scenarios. However, counterfactual outcomes are inherently unobservable, so the prediction error cannot be directly minimized from data. This challenge is compounded by confounding: news occurrence is entangled with weather, calendar, and historical load conditions that independently affect demand. Guided by a generalization bound for continuous treatments that decomposes the unobservable counterfactual error into weighted factual loss and representation balance, this paper proposes the News-Aware Counterfactual Load Analysis Framework (NACF) to control this error upper bound through observable training objectives. NACF converts unstructured news into structured event streams via an offline large language model, encodes these as continuous semantic treatments with a no-news baseline, and estimates treatment-dependent load trajectories through a varying-coefficient response network with learned sample reweighting and Integral Probability Metric (IPM)-based representation balance regularization. Experiments on an Australian electricity-demand dataset show that NACF remains competitive in factual forecasting while providing evidence of treatment-intensity structure, improved representation balance, and interpretable demand perturbations in synthetic interventions and real event case studies.
title_zh: 利用 LLM 结构化事件和表示学习进行反事实负载预测
abstract_zh: 新闻报道的社会、环境和电网事件可以极大地重塑电力需求，但量化此类事件如何扰乱预测的负荷轨迹在很大程度上仍未得到解决。现有的新闻增强预测研究使用新闻作为辅助特征来减少预测误差，但无法回答替代事件条件下的需求反事实问题。反事实预测通过将观察到的新闻下的事实轨迹与替代处理（例如删除事件或注入假设场景）下的反事实轨迹进行比较，自然地提出了这个问题。然而，反事实结果本质上是不可观察的，因此不能直接从数据中最小化预测误差。这一挑战因混杂因素而变得更加复杂：新闻的发生与独立影响需求的天气、日历和历史负载条件纠缠在一起。在连续处理的泛化界限的指导下，将不可观察的反事实误差分解为加权事实损失和表示平衡，本文提出了新闻感知反事实负载分析框架（NACF），通过可观察的训练目标来控制该误差上限。 NACF 通过离线大语言模型将非结构化新闻转换为结构化事件流，将其编码为具有无新闻基线的连续语义处理，并通过具有学习样本重新加权和基于积分概率度量 (IPM) 的表示的变系数响应网络来估计依赖于处理的负载轨迹

title: Tuning Carbonate Solvation via Electrolyte Engineering Toward Robust Low-Temperature Lithium Metal Batteries
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Conventional ethylene carbonate (EC)-based electrolytes are dominated by strong Li+-solvent coordination, which leads to sluggish reaction kinetics at low-temperature and severe interfacial side reactions under high-voltage operation. Herein, a ternary electrolyte with weak-solvation characteristics based on lithium difluoroxalate borate (LiDFOB) salt and synergistic propylene carbonate (PC)/ methyl difluoroacetate (MDFA)/ fluoroethylene carbonate (FEC) (4:4:2, v/v/v) solvent system is developed. MDFA serves as the primary weakly coordinating component to reconstruct the Li+ solvation environment by weakening Li+−PC coordination, while FEC complements this process by promoting the formation of robust inorganic-rich interphases on both electrodes. The reconstructed solvation structure facilitates Li+ desolvation, whereas the stabilized interphases effectively suppress electrolyte decomposition and transition-metal dissolution, leading to a thin and homogeneous cathode electrolyte interphase (∼7 nm) and a low-resistance LiF-rich solid electrolyte interphase. Benefiting from the synergistic regulation of bulk solvation and interfacial chemistry, Li||Li symmetric cells achieve stable cycling over 1000 h at −30 °C, outperforming EC-based electrolytes by ∼400 h. Moreover, Li||NCM811 full cells retain 98.16% capacity after 110 cycles at −30 °C (3.0−4.3 V). This work provides a feasible solvation modulation strategy for high-performance low-temperature lithium metal batteries.
title_zh: 通过电解质工程调节碳酸盐溶剂化以实现稳健的低温锂金属电池
abstract_zh: 摘要 传统的碳酸乙烯酯（EC）基电解质以强Li+-溶剂配位为主，导致低温下反应动力学缓慢，高电压运行下界面副反应严重。在此，开发了一种基于二氟草酸硼酸锂（LiDFOB）盐和协同碳酸丙烯酯（PC）/二氟乙酸甲酯（MDFA）/氟代碳酸乙烯酯（FEC）（4:4:2，v/v/v）溶剂体系的具有弱溶剂化特性的三元电解质。 MDFA 作为主要的弱配位成分，通过削弱 Li+−PC 配位来重建 Li+ 溶剂化环境，而 FEC 通过促进两个电极上坚固的富含无机界面的形成来补充这一过程。重构的溶剂化结构有利于Li+去溶剂化，而稳定的界面有效地抑制电解质分解和过渡金属溶解，从而形成薄且均匀的阴极电解质界面（~7 nm）和低电阻的富含LiF的固体电解质界面。受益于本体溶剂化和界面化学的协同调节，Li||Li对称电池在-30°C下实现了超过1000小时的稳定循环，比基于EC的电解质高约400小时。此外，Li||NCM811全电池在-30℃（3.0−4.3V）下循环110次后仍保留98.16%的容量。这项工作为高性能低温锂金属电池提供了一种可行的溶剂化调制策略。

title: Wood-Inspired Bioadaptable Material with Neurite Outgrowth Guidance Structures, Superior Cell Microenvironment, and Long-Term Structural Stability
source: ACS Applied Materials & Interfaces: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Nerve injuries present serious clinical challenges worldwide. Autologous nerve transplantation is recognized as the gold standard to treat long-gap peripheral nerve defects, but its application has inherent limitations. This situation highlights the need for innovative repair strategies. Promoting and guiding neurite outgrowth is a key step in nerve regeneration, as directional neurite extension facilitates the reconstruction of neural networks. Inspired by the oriented microstructure and biological properties of natural wood, we developed a structurally stable wood hydrogel by integrating a mechanically robust wood-derived cellulose framework with a soft gelatin methacrylate (GelMA) hydrogel matrix. This biomimetic composite demonstrated enhanced capacity to induce directional neurite outgrowth in vitro, long-term structural stability, and significantly altered gene expression profiles associated with cytoskeletal reorganization and cellular motility. Mechanistic investigations revealed that the synergistic effects of topographical guidance cues and mechanical properties were associated with suppression of the RhoA/ROCK1 pathway. The developed wood hydrogel combines oriented architecture, mechanical compatibility, high water absorbency, and long-term structural stability without sacrificing the intrinsic advantages of hydrogel systems. These findings suggest that this hard–soft hybrid biomimetic strategy provides an effective platform for guiding aligned neurite outgrowth and offers a promising design concept for future nerve tissue engineering applications.
title_zh: 具有神经突生长引导结构、优越的细胞微环境和长期结构稳定性的受木材启发的生物适应性材料
abstract_zh: 摘要 神经损伤在全世界范围内提出了严峻的临床挑战。自体神经移植被公认为治疗长间隙周围神经缺损的金标准，但其应用存在固有的局限性。这种情况凸显了创新修复策略的必要性。促进和引导神经突生长是神经再生的关键步骤，因为定向神经突延伸有利于神经网络的重建。受天然木材的定向微观结构和生物特性的启发，我们通过将机械坚固的木材衍生纤维素框架与软明胶甲基丙烯酸酯（GelMA）水凝胶基质相结合，开发了一种结构稳定的木材水凝胶。这种仿生复合材料表现出增强的体外诱导定向神经突生长的能力、长期结构稳定性以及显着改变与细胞骨架重组和细胞运动相关的基因表达谱。机理研究表明，地形引导信号和机械特性的协同效应与 RhoA/ROCK1 通路的抑制有关。所开发的木质水凝胶结合了定向结构、机械相容性、高吸水性和长期结构稳定性，而不牺牲水凝胶系统的固有优势。这些发现表明，这种软硬混合仿生策略为引导对齐的神经突生长提供了一个有效的平台，并为未来的神经组织工程应用提供了一个有前景的设计概念。
