title: Promoter identity shapes splicing outcomes and fidelity
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Gene expression is a complex process subject to regulation at multiple functionally interconnected levels. One prominent example is the crosstalk between transcription and splicing regulation. Past work has shown that transcription can influence splicing in multiple ways, but a systematic investigation of this complex interplay is lacking. Here we employ massively parallel reporter assays of large combinatorial promoter-splice site libraries to dissect how promoter identity and transcription dynamics affect alternative splicing in human cells. We find that promoter identity, rather than expression level, exerts strong and highly context-specific effects on cassette exon inclusion, exceeding the effect of pharmacological inhibitors of transcription initiation or elongation. Groups of exons display coordinated promoter-dependent splicing behavior, and we identified predictive sequence and structural features underlying this sensitivity. Promoter and gene architecture also shape isoform diversity by modulating cryptic splice site usage. These findings present promoters as central regulators of splicing outcomes and fidelity.
title_zh: 启动子身份塑造剪接结果和保真度
abstract_zh: 基因表达是一个复杂的过程，受到多个功能上相互关联的水平的调节。一个突出的例子是转录和剪接调控之间的串扰。过去的工作表明转录可以通过多种方式影响剪接，但缺乏对这种复杂相互作用的系统研究。在这里，我们采用大型组合启动子剪接位点文库的大规模并行报告分析来剖析启动子身份和转录动态如何影响人类细胞中的选择性剪接。我们发现启动子身份，而不是表达水平，对盒式外显子包含产生强烈且高度特定的影响，超过了转录起始或延伸的药理学抑制剂的作用。外显子组表现出协调的启动子依赖性剪接行为，我们确定了这种敏感性背后的预测序列和结构特征。启动子和基因结构还通过调节隐性剪接位点的使用来塑造同种型多样性。这些发现表明启动子是剪接结果和保真度的中央调节器。

title: A Quantitative Examination of Catalyst Component Impacts on Hydrogen Adsorption and Spillover
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Hydrogen spillover is a widely recognized but poorly understood surface phenomenon. We coupled volumetric chemisorption with Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, thermogravimetric analysis, and acid–base titrations to quantify the roles of metal (Pt, Au) and support chemistry (anatase, rutile, P25 titania) on spillover. We show that metal identity has little to no impact on the amount of spillover hydrogen. Spillover pressure dependence is essentially the same on Au/TiO2 and Pt/TiO2, indicating H2 adsorption is equilibrated across both the metal and support. Conversely, spillover is highly sensitive to support surface chemistry, as rutile TiO2 stabilizes ∼5× more surface hydrogen than anatase TiO2. This change is due to a combination of factors, including the rutile surface’s higher proton affinity, stabilized surface electronic states, and larger surface entropy. This work highlights the utility of Au/MOx catalysts as control materials for spillover, as they enable quantitative evaluation of H2 adsorption on active metals and spillover onto the support.
title_zh: 催化剂组分对氢吸附和溢出影响的定量检验
abstract_zh: 摘要 氢溢出是一种被广泛认可但了解甚少的表面现象。我们将体积化学吸附与傅里叶变换红外光谱、热重分析和酸碱滴定结合起来，量化金属（Pt、Au）和载体化学（锐钛矿、金红石、P25 二氧化钛）对溢出的作用。我们表明金属特性对溢出氢气的量几乎没有影响。 Au/TiO2 和 Pt/TiO2 的溢出压力依赖性基本相同，表明金属和载体上的 H2 吸附是平衡的。相反，溢出对载体表面化学高度敏感，因为金红石 TiO2 比锐钛矿 TiO2 稳定的表面氢多约 5 倍。这种变化是多种因素造成的，包括金红石表面较高的质子亲和力、稳定的表面电子态和较大的表面熵。这项工作强调了 Au/MOx 催化剂作为溢出控制材料的实用性，因为它们能够定量评估活性金属上的 H2 吸附和溢出到载体上。

title: Identification of carnivory in the flowering plant Saxifraga via multidisciplinary evidence
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The transformation from prey to predator is a striking adaptive innovation shared by all carnivorous plants, which capture and digest diverse animal prey for nutrients (nitrogen, N). Here, we report carnivory in the alpine flowering plant Saxifraga candelabrum (Saxifragaceae; Saxifragales). Field experiments and herbarium surveys reveal that this plant actively attracts and captures insect prey via glandular hairs. Enzymatic analyses further confirm the ability of plants to digest prey, and isotope labelling experiments using ¹⁵N-labelled insects demonstrate the transfer of nitrogen from prey to plant tissues, thus verifying the presence of carnivory. Genomic comparisons reveal a significant genome-wide convergence in genes related to carnivory (e.g., leaf morphogenesis, digestion and nutrition) across six independent origins of carnivory in diverse flowering plant lineages. Our findings provide definitive evidence of carnivory in Saxifraga, addressing Charles Darwin’s long-standing hypothesis that some Saxifraga species may be capable of carnivory, and further suggest that carnivory may be more widespread among angiosperms than previously recognized.
title_zh: 通过多学科证据鉴定开花植物虎耳草中的食肉性
abstract_zh: 从猎物到捕食者的转变是所有食肉植物共有的惊人的适应性创新，它们捕获并消化不同的动物猎物以获取营养（氮，N）。在这里，我们报道了高山开花植物虎耳草（虎耳草科；虎耳草目）的食肉性。田间实验和植物标本室调查表明，这种植物通过腺毛主动吸引和捕获昆虫猎物。酶分析进一步证实了植物消化猎物的能力，并且使用 15N 标记昆虫进行的同位素标记实验证明了氮从猎物到植物组织的转移，从而验证了肉食动物的存在。基因组比较揭示了不同开花植物谱系中六个独立肉食起源的与肉食相关的基因（例如，叶子形态发生、消化和营养）在全基因组范围内的显着趋同。我们的研究结果为虎耳草属的肉食性提供了明确的证据，解决了查尔斯·达尔文长期以来的假设，即某些虎耳草物种可能具有肉食性，并进一步表明肉食性在被子植物中可能比之前认识的更为普遍。

title: Biomimetic diffusion metamaterials enabled by physical-geometric duality
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Structural design typically faces a fundamental trade-off between advanced functionality and practical manufacturability, a challenge that is especially acute in freeform metamaterials, where omnidirectional performance often demands intricate fabrication. Inspired by the angle-preserving growth of leaves, we address this long-standing challenge by establishing a physical-geometric duality for metamaterial design. This duality enables geometric transformations to be derived directly from material parameters and fields obtained via physical equivalence. The resulting diffusion metamaterials exhibit a distinctive behavior: despite strong anisotropy and heterogeneity in thermal conductivity, isotherms and heat streamlines remain mutually orthogonal. This property effectively reduces the realization of complex thermal conductivity tensors to the direct alignment of laminated composites along local field lines without optimization. We experimentally demonstrate a freeform thermal cloak that achieves omnidirectional invisibility. Our work establishes a biomimetic design paradigm that reconciles functionality with manufacturability, with broad implications for thermal management and diffusive transport.
title_zh: 物理几何二元性实现的仿生扩散超材料
abstract_zh: 结构设计通常面临先进功能和实际可制造性之间的基本权衡，这一挑战在自由形式超材料中尤其严峻，其中全向性能通常需要复杂的制造。受到叶子保角生长的启发，我们通过建立超材料设计的物理几何二元性来解决这一长期存在的挑战。这种二元性使得几何变换能够直接从通过物理等效获得的材料参数和场导出。由此产生的扩散超材料表现出独特的行为：尽管导热系数具有很强的各向异性和异质性，但等温线和热流线仍然相互正交。这一特性有效地将复杂的热导率张量的实现简化为层压复合材料沿局部场线的直接对准，而无需优化。我们通过实验展示了一种自由形状的热斗篷，可以实现全向隐形。我们的工作建立了一种仿生设计范式，可以协调功能性与可制造性，对热管理和扩散传输具有广泛的影响。

title: Enhancing the longevity of lithium-manganese-rich layered oxides by promoting oxygen redox reversibility
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: To enable widespread adoption of electric vehicles, positive-electrode materials must fulfill high energy, long-term stability, and earth-abundant composition within large-format architectures. Lithium-manganese-rich layered oxides show promise through high energy enabled by oxygen redox chemistry and abundant manganese content while minimizing cobalt content. However, oxygen redox irreversibility and gas evolution present challenges in its adoption to large-format cells. Here, we reveal how applied voltage window governs oxygen redox reversibility through integrated X-ray spectroscopy and microscopy, electron microscopy, and in-situ mass spectrometry. An optimized potential window of 4.3-2.0 V vs. graphite confines oxygen redox to reversible regimes while ensuring complete reduction, minimizing electron deficiency and suppressing gas evolution and structural degradation. Building on these insights, our formation and cycling protocol achieves specific energy of 663 Wh/kg based on the mass of the positive electrode active material with 92.2% retention after 883 cycles in 40 Ah cells using cobalt-lean lithium-manganese-rich layered oxides (0.27 wt% cobalt), demonstrating viability for scalable and affordable electric-vehicle batteries.
title_zh: 通过促进氧氧化还原可逆性来延长富锂锰层状氧化物的寿命
abstract_zh: 为了实现电动汽车的广泛采用，正极材料必须在大型结构中满足高能量、长期稳定性和地球丰富的成分。富含锂锰的层状氧化物通过氧氧化还原化学实现的高能量和丰富的锰含量同时最大限度地减少钴含量而显示出前景。然而，氧氧化还原不可逆性和气体逸出对其在大型电池中的采用提出了挑战。在这里，我们通过集成 X 射线光谱和显微镜、电子显微镜和原位质谱揭示了施加的电压窗口如何控制氧氧化还原可逆性。与石墨相比，优化的电位窗口为 4.3-2.0 V，将氧氧化还原限制在可逆状态，同时确保完全还原、最大限度地减少电子缺陷并抑制气体逸出和结构降解。基于这些见解，我们的化成和循环方案基于正极活性材料的质量，使用贫钴锂锰富集层状氧化物（0.27 wt% 钴）在 40 Ah 电池中进行 883 次循环后，比能量达到 663 Wh/kg，保留率为 92.2%，这证明了可扩展且经济实惠的电动汽车电池的可行性。

title: All-fiber random Kerr optical frequency combs
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Optical frequency combs (OFCs) unite the electromagnetic spectrum coherently, and they can be realized in a number of different techniques, e.g., OFCs based on mode-locked lasers, electro-optic modulation of continuous-wave (CW) lasers, CW-pumped ring cavities such as micro-resonators, soliton formation and compression through modulation instability induced by dual-laser pumping, etc. Here, we introduce a different approach, achieving the first random Kerr OFC, the spectral-synthesized analog of a random laser. Based on modulation instability for simultaneous parametric amplification and temporal amplitude compression assisted by the distributed random feedback through Rayleigh scattering within a half-open cavity, trains of solitons are formed and further compressed leading to OFCs with spectral bandwidth over ~ 100 nm, wide comb spacing of ~ 1 nm, and minimum soliton duration of ~ 390 fs. The random Kerr OFC can operate continuously as a robust and flexible device, offering adjustable comb spacing, tunable soliton repetition rate, and tunable gate rate.
title_zh: 全光纤随机克尔光频率梳
abstract_zh: 光频率梳（OFC）将电磁频谱相干地结合在一起，并且可以通过多种不同的技术来实现，例如基于锁模激光器的OFC、连续波（CW）激光器的电光调制、CW泵浦环形腔（例如微谐振器）、通过双激光泵浦引起的调制不稳定性来形成孤子和压缩等。在这里，我们介绍一种不同的方法，实现了第一个随机Kerr OFC，即随机激光的光谱合成模拟。基于半开腔内瑞利散射的分布式随机反馈辅助的同步参量放大和时间幅度压缩的调制不稳定性，形成孤子串并进一步压缩，从而产生光谱带宽超过约 100 nm、宽梳间距约 1 nm 和最小孤子持续时间约 390 fs 的 OFC。随机 Kerr OFC 可以作为坚固且灵活的设备连续运行，提供可调节的梳间距、可调节的孤子重复率和可调节的门速率。

title: Technoeconomic competitiveness of small modular reactors across U.S. power and industrial sectors
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) are next-generation nuclear reactors proposed for United States deployment, but pathways for early scale-up remain uncertain. We present a large-scale, site-level quantitative assessment of SMR deployment potential across electricity, industrial heat, and hydrogen applications, evaluating economic performance, decarbonization potential, and sensitivity to capital-cost uncertainty. Deployment before the Inflation Reduction Act Hydrogen Production Tax Credit expires in 2033 is most attractive for industrial hydrogen production in ammonia, steel, and refining. At first-of-a-kind capital costs with the credit, 91 gigawatts electric of SMRs could be deployed at high internal rates of return, whereas dedicated power production is uneconomic. Profitable deployment is highly dependent on the credit which could expand future industrial process heat opportunities and maintain viability under doubled capital costs, consistent with recent large nuclear generation projects. These findings challenge the industry’s wholesale-electricity focus and underscore the urgency of evaluating these opportunities.
title_zh: 美国电力和工业部门小型模块化反应堆的技术经济竞争力
abstract_zh: 小型模块化反应堆（SMR）是美国提议部署的下一代核反应堆，但早期扩大规模的途径仍不确定。我们对 SMR 在电力、工业热能和氢气应用中的部署潜力进行了大规模、现场定量评估，评估了经济绩效、脱碳潜力以及对资本成本不确定性的敏感性。在《通货膨胀减少法案》氢生产税收抵免于 2033 年到期之前部署对于合成氨、钢铁和炼油领域的工业氢生产最具吸引力。以首创的信贷资本成本，可以以高内部回报率部署 91 吉瓦的 SMR 电力，而专用电力生产是不经济的。有利可图的部署高度依赖于信贷，信贷可以扩大未来工业过程热机会并在资本成本加倍的情​​况下保持生存能力，与最近的大型核发电项目一致。这些发现对行业的批发电力重点提出了挑战，并强调了评估这些机会的紧迫性。

title: Spatial and mechanistic elucidation of distance tunable Ru dual atom catalysts for efficient CO hydrogenation to ethanol
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Syngas-to-ethanol conversion is economically attractive yet remains challenging due to limited activity and selectivity under practical conditions. Achieving selective C-C coupling and directing *CHO hydrogenation to ethanol require precise control of active-site geometry and electronics. Here we use a coordination–precursor–mediated strategy to construct Ru dual-atom catalysts on N-coordinated carbon supports with tunable local architectures, where the Ru-Ru separation serves as a primary descriptor—together with coordination environment and intersite electronic coupling—governing cooperative CO/H2 activation and C-C bond formation. Varying the interatomic distance modulates geometric confinement and electronic interactions, improving ethanol formation. Within the optimal reaction window, the catalyst with the shortest Ru-Ru distance exhibits high CO conversion, high ethanol selectivity among oxygenated products, with oxygen-free hydrocarbon products excluded from the selectivity normalization, and stable operation at 1.0 MPa. In situ spectroscopy and DFT reveal that short Ru-Ru spacing enhances d-orbital hybridization and confinement, facilitating synergistic back-donation that lowers the C-C coupling barrier; Bader/charge-density analyses indicate preferential stabilization of hydroxylated intermediates toward ethanol. This work highlights distance-tuned dual-atom cooperativity as a key lever for selective syngas-to-ethanol catalysis.
title_zh: 距离可调 Ru 双原子催化剂的空间和机理阐明，用于高效 CO 加氢生成乙醇
abstract_zh: 合成气到乙醇的转化在经济上具有吸引力，但由于实际条件下的活性和选择性有限，仍然具有挑战性。实现选择性 C-C 偶联并引导 *CHO 加氢生成乙醇需要精确控制活性位点几何结构和电子学。在这里，我们使用配位前驱体介导的策略在具有可调节局部结构的N配位碳载体上构建Ru双原子催化剂，其中Ru-Ru分离作为主要描述符，与配位环境和位点间电子耦合一起控制CO/H2协同活化和C-C键形成。改变原子间距离可以调节几何限制和电子相互作用，从而改善乙醇的形成。在最佳反应窗口内，Ru-Ru距离最短的催化剂表现出高CO转化率、含氧产物中乙醇的高选择性、无氧烃产物排除在选择性归一化之外，并且在1.0 MPa下稳定运行。原位光谱和DFT表明，短Ru-Ru间距增强了d轨道杂化和限制，促进协同回馈，降低C-C耦合势垒； Bader/电荷密度分析表明羟基化中间体对乙醇具有优先稳定作用。这项工作强调了距离调节的双原子协同性作为选择性合成气到乙醇催化的关键杠杆。

title: Linking long-range surface-induced mobility enhancement and intrinsic fragility of polymer glasses
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Surface-induced mobility enhancement propagates into polymer glasses over distances from nanometers to micrometers. The discovery of a mobile surface “bilayer” structure—comprising a nanoscale outer layer and a microscale sublayer—provides insight into this significant variability in propagation length. However, the origin of the extensive microscale sublayer (ht" role="presentation">ht{h}_{{\rm{t}}}) remains elusive. Using dynamic mechanical analysis (DMA), we establish a strong correspondence between nanolayer mobility enhancement and ht" role="presentation">ht{h}_{{\rm{t}}}, both of which increase with the intrinsic fragility of polymer glass. Coarse-grained simulations confirm our experimental findings, revealing that enhanced molecular velocity at the surface initiates long-range shear-like excitation modes that penetrate deeper into the bulk as polymer fragility increases. This combination of experiment and simulation provides a unified framework that reconciles historical discrepancies regarding the free surface effect, establishing fragility as a critical parameter for predicting the relative sizes of surface-enhanced mobility and its propagation length across different polymers.
title_zh: 将长程表面诱导的迁移率增强与聚合物玻璃的固有脆性联系起来
abstract_zh: 表面诱导的迁移率增强在纳米到微米的距离内传播到聚合物玻璃中。移动表面“双层”结构（包括纳米级外层和微米级子层）的发现提供了对传播长度的显着变化的深入了解。然而，广泛的微米级子层 (ht" role="presentation">ht{h}_{{\rm{t}}}) 的起源仍然难以捉摸。利用动态力学分析 (DMA)，我们在纳米层迁移率增强和 ht" role="presentation">ht{h}_{{\rm{t}}} 之间建立了很强的对应关系，两者都随着聚合物玻璃固有的脆性而增加。粗粒度模拟证实了我们的实验结果，表明表面分子速度的增强会引发长程剪切式激发模式，随着聚合物脆性的增加，这种模式会更深地渗透到本体中。实验和模拟的结合提供了一个统一的框架，可以协调有关自由表面效应的历史差异，将脆性确立为预测表面增强迁移率的相对大小及其在不同聚合物中的传播长度的关键参数。

title: Photocatalytic Activation of Fluoroform for Radical Trifluoromethylation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Fluoroform is an ideal trifluoromethyl source in synthetic chemistry due to its low cost, low toxicity, and high potential for greenhouse-gas valorization. However, the use of fluoroform has been largely limited to the generation of trifluoromethyl anions or metal-bound species; direct access to the trifluoromethyl radical remains elusive, despite the broad applicability of radical trifluoromethylation for preparing medicinally important compounds. Here, we report a method for radical trifluoromethylation using fluoroform by leveraging the reactivity of ketones in combination with a Brønsted base under photoirradiation. The ketone-mediated photochemical activation provides access to the trifluoromethyl radical from fluoroform via a photoexcited alkoxide intermediate without exogenous redox reagents, enabling radical trifluoromethylation of alkenes and arenes under mild conditions. The developed system is amenable to a photocatalytic protocol, late-stage trifluoromethylation of complex molecules, and upgrading bulk chemicals into high-value trifluoromethylated compounds.
title_zh: 光催化活化氟仿进行自由基三氟甲基化
abstract_zh: 摘要 氟仿因其低成本、低毒和温室气体增值潜力大而成为合成化学中理想的三氟甲基来源。然而，氟仿的使用很大程度上仅限于产生三氟甲基阴离子或金属结合物质；尽管自由基三氟甲基化在制备医学上重要的化合物方面具有广泛的适用性，但直接获得三氟甲基自由基仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们报告了一种利用氟仿在光照射下利用酮与布朗斯台德碱结合的反应性进行自由基三氟甲基化的方法。酮介导的光化学活化提供了通过光激发的醇盐中间体从氟仿中获得三氟甲基自由基的途径，无需外源氧化还原试剂，从而能够在温和条件下实现烯烃和芳烃的自由基三氟甲基化。开发的系统适用于光催化方案、复杂分子的后期三氟甲基化以及将大宗化学品升级为高价值的三氟甲基化化合物。

title: Programmable radio-frequency calculations in electromagnetic-wave domain
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Information metasurfaces have emerged as pivotal components in next-generation electronic systems. However, current research is mainly focused on the physical structures and system functions, while radio-frequency signal processing and calculation remain constrained to digital-domain operations. The reliance on digital conversion inherently increases the hardware complexity and power consumption. To address this challenge, we propose a programmable radio-frequency calculation system based on a space-time-coding metasurface, which controls the wave-matter interactions to achieve radio-frequency calculations in the electromagnetic space in a reprogrammable way. Particularly, the fundamental signal operations - Fourier transform and convolution - are implemented in the electromagnetic-wave domain successfully. We validate the calculation capabilities in radar scenarios, facilitating the accurate detection of target velocity and range. In this work, theoretical analysis, numerical simulations, and experimental results collectively demonstrate that the radio-frequency calculation system exhibits superior precision and notable cost-effectiveness, highlighting its significant potential for next-generation electronic system deployments.
title_zh: 电磁波域的可编程射频计算
abstract_zh: 信息超表面已成为下一代电子系统的关键组件。然而，目前的研究主要集中在物理结构和系统功能上，而射频信号处理和计算仍然局限于数字域操作。对数字转换的依赖本质上增加了硬件复杂性和功耗。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种基于时空编码超表面的可编程射频计算系统，该系统控制波与物质的相互作用，以可重新编程的方式实现电磁空间中的射频计算。特别是，基本信号运算——傅里叶变换和卷积——在电磁波域中成功实现。我们验证了雷达场景中的计算能力，有助于准确检测目标速度和距离。在这项工作中，理论分析、数值模拟和实验结果共同证明了射频计算系统具有卓越的精度和显着的成本效益，凸显了其在下一代电子系统部署中的巨大潜力。

title: Anisotropy-mediated stress regulation in Mn-substituted VOPO4 enables aqueous zinc batteries with long cycle life
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The structural integrity of layered VOPO4 frameworks critically determines their electrochemical performance in aqueous zinc-ion batteries, yet the highly ordered stacking of VOPO4 renders it susceptible to lattice stress accumulation and chemo-mechanical degradation during cycling, causing rapid capacity fading and a shortened battery lifespan. Herein, we show a strategy to alleviate these limitations through partial metal substitution in the VOPO4 lattice, enabling the modulation of local coordination environments and mitigating lattice and cycling induced stress. As a proof-of-concept, theoretical calculations and experimental validation on Mn-substituted VOPO4 reveal shortened M–O bond along the c-axis and the formation of Mn–O–P–O–V delocalized structure. These modifications introduce subtle lattice distortions and generate percolation channels that enable more facile, ordered Zn2+ migration, facilitating uniform lattice stress distribution. Real-time monitoring of interfacial stress during cycling identifies that Mn incorporation induces electronic redistribution and lattice anisotropy, promoting balanced intra-layer (a/b-axis) stress accommodation. Therefore, Mn-substituted VOPO4 exhibits higher specific capacity and cycling stability, with 91.0% capacity retention over 2000 cycles at 1 A g−1. This intra-layer anisotropy engineering strategy offers a practical route for mitigating dissolution and strain effects during cycling, paving ways for the development of high-energy-density positive electrodes with cycling durability.
title_zh: Mn取代VOPO4中各向异性介导的应力调节使水性锌电池具有长循环寿命
abstract_zh: 层状VOPO4框架的结构完整性关键决定了它们在水性锌离子电池中的电化学性能，但VOPO4的高度有序堆叠使其在循环过程中容易受到晶格应力积累和化学机械降解的影响，导致容量快速衰减和电池寿命缩短。在此，我们展示了一种通过 VOPO4 晶格中的部分金属替代来缓解这些限制的策略，从而能够调节局部配位环境并减轻晶格和循环引起的应力。作为概念验证，Mn 取代的 VOPO4 的理论计算和实验验证揭示了沿 c 轴缩短的 M-O 键以及 Mn-O-P-O-V 离域结构的形成。这些修饰引入了微妙的晶格畸变并产生渗滤通道，使 Zn2+ 迁移更加容易、有序，从而促进均匀的晶格应力分布。循环过程中界面应力的实时监测表明，Mn 的掺入会引起电子重新分布和晶格各向异性，从而促进平衡的层内（a/b 轴）应力调节。因此，Mn取代的VOPO4表现出更高的比容量和循环稳定性，在1 A g−1下2000次循环后容量保持率为91.0%。这种层内各向异性工程策略为减轻循环过程中的溶解和应变影响提供了一条实用途径，为开发具有循环耐久性的高能量密度正极铺平了道路。

title: Lipid Bilayer-Confined J-Aggregation Transduces Cell Membrane Mechanics into Photoacoustic Signals
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Membrane tension, defined as the in-plane mechanical stress of the lipid bilayer, encodes membrane stretch and lipid packing density. Despite its central role in regulating cellular behavior, measuring membrane tension in a direct and noninvasive way in deeper tissue (beyond microscopy) remains a major challenge. Here, we report a supramolecular strategy that transduces membrane mechanics into a spectrally resolved photoacoustic signal through lipid bilayer-confined J-aggregation. We employ two complementary probes: a fluorescence-active system to report aggregation behavior in the lipid bilayer of LUVs and an optimized analogue to enable cellular photoacoustic readout. We found that amphipathic BODIPY-based probes are inserted into lipid membranes and exist as either monomers or slip-stacked J-aggregates with aggregate populations dictated by lipid packing density, which is in turn influenced by membrane tension or lipid composition. Only ordered J-aggregates formed under membrane-confined conditions enable efficient conversion of absorbed light into PA805 signals. Kinetically driven large aggregates spectrally observable via absorption experiments in protein-rich environments are inactive in photoacoustic mode. This decoupling between optical absorption and photoacoustic output reveals aggregate geometry as a critical determinant of photothermal efficiency. Furthermore, the bilayer-confined PA805 on/off behavior minimizes background signals from uninserted probes, enabling wash-free photoacoustic imaging. In model membranes and live cells, PA805 inversely correlates with lipid packing density, enabling noninvasive readout of membrane tension-associated changes.
title_zh: 脂质双层限制的 J 聚集将细胞膜力学转化为光声信号
abstract_zh: 摘要 膜张力定义为脂质双层的面内机械应力，编码膜拉伸和脂质堆积密度。尽管其在调节细胞行为中发挥着核心作用，但以直接和非侵入性的方式测量深层组织中的膜张力（超越显微镜）仍然是一个重大挑战。在这里，我们报告了一种超分子策略，通过脂质双层限制的 J 聚集将膜力学转换为光谱解析的光声信号。我们采用两种互补的探针：一种荧光活性系统，用于报告 LUV 脂质双层中的聚集行为；另一种是优化的类似物，用于实现细胞光声读出。我们发现，基于 BODIPY 的两亲性探针插入脂质膜中，并以单体或滑堆积 J 聚集体的形式存在，其聚集体数量由脂质堆积密度决定，而脂质堆积密度又受膜张力或脂质组成的影响。只有在膜限制条件下形成的有序 J 聚集体才能将吸收的光有效转换为 PA805 信号。通过在富含蛋白质的环境中的吸收实验可观察到的动力学驱动的大聚集体在光声模式下是不活跃的。光吸收和光声输出之间的这种解耦揭示了聚集体几何形状是光热效率的关键决定因素。此外，双层限制的 PA805 开/关行为最大限度地减少了未插入探针的背景信号，从而实现免清洗光声成像。在模型膜和活细胞中，PA805 呈反相关

title: Coupled air–sea interactions drove and sustained the 2013–2016 North Pacific marine heatwave
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: The 2013–2016 marine heatwave (MHW) in the Northeastern Pacific ranks among the most intense extratropical ocean warming events on record. Its intricate evolution has complicated efforts to understand the underlying dynamics crucial for predicting future MHWs. Here, we track the MHW using a closed, three-dimensional Lagrangian heat budget that quantifies the processes driving its evolution. Three-dimensional particle trajectories separate the MHW into northern and southern components and reveal that they are of distinct kinematic origin. We quantitatively demonstrate through a closed budget that advection, rather than surface forcing, plays the dominant role in sustaining the MHW’s heat content. The northern component was maintained by a weakening of Ekman heat transport across the North Pacific Current, combined with reduced wintertime surface heat loss. The southern component was driven by weakened Ekman upwelling caused by reduced alongshore winds over the California Current. We further identify a persistent low sea-level pressure anomaly over the central Pacific that altered wind patterns, redistributing heat and moisture poleward to ultimately force both parts of the MHW. Elevated surface temperatures, in turn, amplified this pressure anomaly, completing a positive feedback loop that sustained the event across multiple years.
title_zh: 海气耦合相互作用驱动并维持了 2013-2016 年北太平洋海洋热浪
abstract_zh: 2013年至2016年东北太平洋的海洋热浪（MHW）是有记录以来最强烈的温带海洋变暖事件之一。其复杂的演变使得理解对于预测未来 MHW 至关重要的潜在动态的努力变得复杂。在这里，我们使用封闭的三维拉格朗日热收支来跟踪 MHW，该热收支量化了驱动其演化的过程。三维粒子轨迹将 MHW 分为北部和南部部分，并揭示它们具有不同的运动学起源。我们通过封闭预算定量证明，平流而不是表面强迫在维持 MHW 的热含量方面发挥着主导作用。北半球的维持是由于北太平洋洋流埃克曼热传输减弱，加上冬季地表热损失减少。南部部分是由加州洋流沿岸风减弱导致的埃克曼上升流减弱驱动的。我们进一步确定了太平洋中部上空持续存在的低海平面气压异常，该异常改变了风型，将热量和湿气重新分配到极地，最终迫使MHW的两个部分。地表温度升高反过来放大了这种压力异常，完成了一个正反馈循环，使该事件持续了多年。

title: Multifunctional metal-organic frameworks for direct photosynthesis of cyclic carbonates from gaseous olefins
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Ethylene carbonate (EC) and propylene carbonate (PC) are important feedstocks in the production of commercial battery electrolytes and green solvents. However, their conventional industrial synthetic pathways rely heavily on energy-intensive thermocatalytic processes with costly epoxide reactants. Here, we report a class of multifunctional metal-organic framework photocatalysts (RE-BTTD-AC) that integrate oxygen (O2) activation, C-H bond activation, photothermal conversion and Lewis acid reactivity. They enable photosynthesis of EC and PC under ambient conditions with a sustainable, cheap and safe method using ethylene (C2H4)/propylene (C3H6), CO2, and O2. Experimental results combined with theoretical calculations demonstrate that the multifunctional nature of RE-BTTD-AC permits the occurrence of tandem reaction of photoredox and cycloaddition, leading to a relay conversion of C2H4/C3H6-to-epoxide-to-EC/PC. The catalytic system exhibits high product yields (EC of 96.02 μmol/g/h with 95% selectivity, PC of 640.03 μmol/g/h with 93% selectivity) in 48 hours and has a long-term production capacity of at least 720 hours.
title_zh: 用于气态烯烃直接光合作用环状碳酸酯的多功能金属有机骨架
abstract_zh: 碳酸乙烯酯（EC）和碳酸丙烯酯（PC）是生产商用电池电解质和绿色溶剂的重要原料。然而，他们的传统工业合成途径严重依赖于使用昂贵的环氧化物反应物的能源密集型热催化过程。在这里，我们报道了一类集氧（O2）活化、C-H键活化、光热转化和路易斯酸反应性于一体的多功能金属有机框架光催化剂（RE-BTTD-AC）。它们使用乙烯 (C2H4)/丙烯 (C3H6)、CO2 和 O2，以可持续、廉价且安全的方法在环境条件下实现 EC 和 PC 的光合作用。实验结果与理论计算相结合表明，RE-BTTD-AC的多功能性质允许光氧化还原和环加成的串联反应发生，从而导致C2H4/C3H6-环氧化物-EC/PC的中继转化。该催化系统在48小时内表现出较高的产品收率（EC为96.02 μmol/g/h，选择性为95%，PC为640.03 μmol/g/h，选择性为93%），并具有至少720小时的长期生产能力。

title: Quantum-memory-assisted on-demand microwave-optical transduction
source: Physical sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Microwave-optical transducers and quantum memories are essential for quantum repeaters enabling a quantum internet. Despite advances in both technologies, integrating these functionalities remains challenging. Here, we theoretically propose and experimentally demonstrate an on-demand microwave-optical quantum transducer based on a Rydberg ensemble. Using cascaded electromagnetically induced transparency, we store microwave photons in a highly excited collective state and convert them into optical photons during retrieval. Leveraging an optical depth of millions for microwave photons and minimal single-photon-level dephasing, our transducer achieves around 90% area-normalized storage efficiency, 2.3 MHz bandwidth, and noise-equivalent temperature of 26 K under cavity-free conditions. Furthermore, our system is cryogenically compatible and extendable for high single-photon conversion efficiency without requiring optical cavity coupling. These findings advance practical on-demand quantum interfaces with broad applications across atomic and solid-state platforms.
title_zh: 量子记忆辅助按需微波光转换
abstract_zh: 微波光学传感器和量子存储器对于实现量子互联网的量子中继器至关重要。尽管这两种技术都取得了进步，但集成这些功能仍然具有挑战性。在这里，我们从理论上提出并通过实验证明了一种基于里德伯系综的按需微波光量子换能器。利用级联电磁感应透明，我们将微波光子存储在高度激发的集体状态下，并在检索过程中将它们转换为光学光子。利用微波光子数百万的光学深度和最小的单光子级相移，我们的传感器在无腔条件下实现了约 90% 的面积归一化存储效率、2.3 MHz 带宽和 26 K 的噪声等效温度。此外，我们的系统具有低温兼容性和可扩展性，可实现高单光子转换效率，无需光腔耦合。这些发现推进了实用的按需量子接口在原子和固态平台上的广泛应用。

title: Transitions between persistent climate–carbon regimes coincide with elevated Phanerozoic biosphere vulnerability
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Linking abiotic forcing to coherent biotic responses over Phanerozoic time remains difficult to quantify because both environmental drivers and biological dynamics are heterogeneous, irregularly sampled, and affected by proxy and geochronological uncertainty. Here we introduce a regime-based description of the climate–carbon system in which Phanerozoic evolution is organized into a small number of recurring, long-lived mega-climate states separated by relatively sharp transitions. Using recurrence diagnostics on paired carbon and oxygen stable isotope records, together with complementary early-warning indicators, we identify five persistent regimes and their boundaries. We interpret the resulting structure with a conceptual climate–carbon cycle model that admits multiple coexisting equilibria, providing a mechanistic basis for state changes that switch between stable attractors under changing environmental forcings and perturbations. We connect these results to a biosphere vulnerability metric that incorporates biotic turnover with sample-standardized global diversity to show that vulnerability is systematically elevated near major regime transitions. These results suggest that transitions between persistent climate–carbon attractors provide a dynamical context for why some perturbation intervals coincide with heightened biospheric stress, beyond what is expected from more gradual background environmental changes alone.
title_zh: 持续气候-碳状态之间的转变与显生宙生物圈脆弱性的升高相一致
abstract_zh: 将显生宙时期的非生物强迫与连贯的生物反应联系起来仍然很难量化，因为环境驱动因素和生物动力学都是异质的、不规则采样的，并且受到代理和地质年代不确定性的影响。在这里，我们介绍了一种基于制度的气候-碳系统描述，其中显生宙演化被组织成少数反复出现的、长期存在的大气候状态，并由相对急剧的转变分隔开。利用对碳和氧稳定同位素配对记录的重复诊断，以及补充的预警指标，我们确定了五种持久状态及其边界。我们用概念性的气候-碳循环模型解释了所得的结构，该模型承认多种共存的平衡，为在不断变化的环境强迫和扰动下在稳定吸引子之间切换的状态变化提供了机械基础。我们将这些结果与生物圈脆弱性指标联系起来，该指标将生物周转率与样本标准化的全球多样性相结合，以表明脆弱性在主要政权转变附近系统性地升高。这些结果表明，持久性气候-碳吸引子之间的转变提供了一个动态背景，解释了为什么某些扰动间隔与生物圈压力加剧相一致，超出了仅从更渐进的背景环境变化中所预期的范围。

title: A prolonged hydrothermal past at Santorini Caldera revealed by sedimentary trace metal and microbial signatures
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Hydrothermal systems in volcanic calderas are critical in signalling volcanic unrest, forming ore deposits, and sustaining chemosynthetic microorganisms. Analysis of a ~3500-year sequence of sediments collected from the Santorini caldera, Greece, during International Ocean Discovery Program (IODP) Expedition 398 reveals the behaviour of a prolonged paleo-hydrothermal system. Sediment geochemical and metagenomic data record vigorous hydrothermal activity and metal fluxes for ~1100 years, within a 2270-year window between two major eruptions. Sediment hydrothermally-derived trace metals are significantly enriched over background (~200-fold for As and Hg, and 10–50-fold for Mn, Sb, Mo, and V), with long-term metal fluxes (9 t yr−1 As, 2.5 t yr−1 Cu, 7 kg yr−1 Ag) comparable to fluxes from present-day geothermal fields in the Taupo Volcanic Zone. Metagenomic analysis identifies elevated metal resistance genes—signals of microbial adaptation to heightened hydrothermal stressors. Here we integrate geological and genomic evidence to decipher the paleoenvironmental and biogeochemical history of the past hydrothermal system at Santorini caldera.
title_zh: 沉积痕量金属和微生物特征揭示了圣托里尼火山口长期的热液历史
abstract_zh: 火山口的热液系统对于发出火山动荡信号、形成矿床和维持化学合成微生物至关重要。对国际海洋发现计划 (IODP) 第 398 次探险期间从希腊圣托里尼火山口收集的约 3500 年沉积物序列进行的分析揭示了长期古热液系统的行为。沉积物地球化学和宏基因组数据记录了大约 1100 年的剧烈热液活动和金属通量，两次大喷发之间的时间间隔为 2270 年。沉积物热液衍生的微量金属在背景上显着富集（砷和汞约为 200 倍，锰、锑、钼和钒为 10-50 倍），长期金属通量（9 t yr−1 As、2.5 t yr−1 Cu、7 kg yr−1 Ag）与陶波火山区当今地热田的通量相当。宏基因组分析确定了金属抗性基因升高——微生物适应升高的热液应激源的信号。在这里，我们整合地质和基因组证据来破译圣托里尼火山口过去热液系统的古环境和生物地球化学历史。

title: A potassium-based single-atom catalyst enables acute lung injury immunotherapy in mice by inhibiting macrophage pyroptosis
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Acute lung injury (ALI), which can have a mortality rate approaching 40%, lacks effective therapies. Macrophage pyroptosis represents a pro-inflammatory event and a potential therapeutic target. Here, we report a single-atom immunomodulator, a potassium-based single-atom catalyst (K-SAC) with K–N4 sites, that suppresses macrophage pyroptosis for ALI therapy through antioxidant catalysis. Constructed from biocompatible potassium, the most abundant intracellular metal in humans, K-SAC displays potent superoxide dismutase- and catalase-like activities, with the underlying mechanisms revealed by density functional theory simulations. Following preferential macrophage uptake, K-SAC scavenges reactive oxygen species, downregulates gasdermin D and its N-terminal fragment, activates endosomal sorting complexes required for transport-mediated membrane repair, and promotes membrane phospholipid remodeling, thereby effectively inhibiting macrophage pyroptosis. Notably, this catalytic membrane repair mechanism offers a versatile strategy for restoring membrane integrity. Such catalytic inhibition of pyroptosis preserves pulmonary immune homeostasis and ameliorates lipopolysaccharide- or cecal ligation and puncture-induced ALI, establishing a catalytic immunotherapeutic approach using a physiologically abundant element for therapeutic applications.
title_zh: 钾基单原子催化剂通过抑制巨噬细胞焦亡实现小鼠急性肺损伤免疫治疗
abstract_zh: 急性肺损伤 (ALI) 的死亡率接近 40%，且缺乏有效的治疗方法。巨噬细胞焦亡代表一种促炎事件和潜在的治疗靶点。在此，我们报道了一种单原子免疫调节剂，一种具有 K-N4 位点的钾基单原子催化剂 (K-SAC)，可通过抗氧化催化抑制巨噬细胞焦亡，用于 ALI 治疗。 K-SAC 由生物相容性钾（人体最丰富的细胞内金属）构成，具有强大的超氧化物歧化酶和过氧化氢酶样活性，其潜在机制通过密度泛函理论模拟揭示。在巨噬细胞优先摄取后，K-SAC清除活性氧，下调gasdermin D及其N端片段，激活转运介导的膜修复所需的内体分选复合物，并促进膜磷脂重塑，从而有效抑制巨噬细胞焦亡。值得注意的是，这种催化膜修复机制提供了一种恢复膜完整性的通用策略。这种对细胞焦亡的催化抑制可保持肺部免疫稳态，并改善脂多糖或盲肠结扎和穿刺诱导的 ALI，从而建立一种利用生理丰富元素进行治疗应用的催化免疫治疗方法。

title: The recent enhancement of the surface melt over the Antarctic Peninsula dictated by thermodynamics
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds

Although a long-term decline in AP surface melt has been evident since the early 1990s, episodes of intense surface melt events have frequently been reported in recent years. title: Quantifying environmental co-benefits of nitrogen-based crop restructuring and its implications on India’s interstate trade network
source: Earth and environmental sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Addressing sustainability within food systems is challenging due to their multifaceted nature. Here, we evaluate crop-restructuring pathways for Indian agricultural system by integrating nutrient, water, greenhouse gas, economic, and interstate trade-network accounting. We show that the nitrogen-focused crop restructuring strategy reduces nitrogen surplus by 13.4% and water use by 18.6%. This approach maintains baseline calorie production, narrows the benchmarked cereal net-return deficit, and mitigates greenhouse gas emissions by 8.7%. Relative to water-focused restructuring, the nitrogen-focused strategy delivers larger reciprocal co-benefits by about 4.6-fold, resulting in a decrease in socio-environmental costs associated with nitrogen pollution of around $1.19 billion USD. The resulting agricultural restructuring substantially expands alternative-cereal trade in the interstate trade network. Overall, our analysis shows that integrating nutrient management into crop-restructuring strategies can support food-system sustainability in India and other resource-constrained agricultural systems.
title_zh: 量化氮基作物重组的环境协同效益及其对印度州际贸易网络的影响
abstract_zh: 由于粮食系统具有多方面的性质，解决粮食系统内的可持续性问题具有挑战性。在这里，我们通过整合养分、水、温室气体、经济和州际贸易网络核算来评估印度农业系统的作物重组路径。我们发现，以氮为主的作物结构调整策略将氮过剩减少了 13.4%，用水量减少了 18.6%。这种方法维持了基准卡路里产量，缩小了基准谷物净回报赤字，并将温室气体排放量减少了 8.7%。相对于以水为重点的重组，以氮为重点的战略可带来约 4.6 倍的互惠协同效益，从而使与氮污染相关的社会环境成本减少约 11.9 亿美元。由此产生的农业重组大大扩大了州际贸易网络中的替代谷物贸易。总体而言，我们的分析表明，将养分管理纳入作物重组战略可以支持印度和其他资源有限的农业系统的粮食系统可持续性。

title: Human wastewater contamination drives the emergence of multidrug-resistant bacteria in the Galápagos marine ecosystem
source: Biological sciences : Nature Communications subject feeds
abstract: Antimicrobial resistance poses a global threat to public health. Mobile microbiological laboratories can enable environmental monitoring of antimicrobial resistance, particularly in geographically remote and resource-limited locations, such as the Galápagos archipelago. Here, we report the development of a mobile laboratory for antimicrobial resistance surveillance of marine sites surrounding San Cristóbal, the archipelago’s second most populated island, which has experienced rapid urbanization and intense international tourism pressure. On-site metagenomic sequencing of wastewater-contaminated marine sites reveals a stark shift in microbial genera and a higher count of antimicrobial resistance genes compared to uncontaminated marine sites, mirroring metagenomic results of local untreated sewage. Over 40% of lactose-fermenting Enterobacteriaceae isolates collected directly from sewage or marine environments near sites of wastewater outfall exhibit multidrug resistance. Long-read sequencing and de novo assembly of bacterial genomes and plasmids from multidrug-resistant Escherichia coli reveal frequent and rapid reassortment of antimicrobial resistance genes on plasmids, generating a diverse and functional resistome on the island. This study not only provides a framework for conducting antimicrobial resistance research in low-resource settings but also underscores the impact of wastewater contamination on the environmental antimicrobial resistance landscape and highlights potential threats to human and animal health.
title_zh: 人类废水污染导致加拉帕戈斯海洋生态系统中出现多重耐药细菌
abstract_zh: 抗生素耐药性对公共健康构成全球威胁。移动微生物实验室可以对抗菌素耐药性进行环境监测，特别是在地理偏远和资源有限的地区，例如加拉帕戈斯群岛。在这里，我们报告了一个移动实验室的开发情况，用于对圣克里斯托瓦尔周围的海洋地点进行抗菌药物耐药性监测。圣克里斯托瓦尔是群岛上人口第二多的岛屿，经历了快速的城市化和巨大的国际旅游压力。对受废水污染的海洋地点进行的现场宏基因组测序显示，与未受污染的海洋地点相比，微生物属发生了明显的变化，并且抗菌素耐药性基因的数量更高，这反映了当地未经处理的污水的宏基因组结果。直接从废水排放口附近的污水或海洋环境中收集的乳糖发酵肠杆菌科菌株中，超过 40% 的菌株表现出多重耐药性。对多重耐药大肠杆菌的细菌基因组和质粒进行长读长测序和从头组装，揭示了质粒上抗菌素耐药基因频繁、快速的重排，从而在岛上产生了多样化的功能性耐药组。这项研究不仅为在资源匮乏的环境中进行抗菌素耐药性研究提供了一个框架，而且强调了废水污染对环境抗菌素耐药性景观的影响，并强调了对人类和动物健康的潜在威胁。

title: Spatial Deconstruction of the Plasma Membrane
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The plasma membrane of cells is known to be heterogeneous with regard to the spatial distribution of proteins and lipids, but the nature and origins of this heterogeneity are unclear. In this study, we perform fluorescence microscopy on plasma membrane sheets and find that most proteins occur in protein-rich domains separated by intervening protein-poor regions. We show that the protein-rich domains and protein-poor regions are at least partially preserved in plasma membrane-derived vesicles that lack cytoskeletal elements, permitting their separation and isolation by density centrifugation. Compositional analysis by nuclear magnetic resonance and mass spectrometry shows that different proteins and lipids exhibit distinct tendencies to partition into the protein-rich domains. This differential partitioning is correlated with the function of the different proteins, suggesting segregation based on cellular processes. Likewise, ordered lipids, including cholesterol and sphingomyelin, differentially segregate, being more abundant in the protein-rich domains. We propose that the collective assembly of certain proteins and lipids creates the heterogeneous distribution of membrane components and the emergence of protein-rich domains. These domains could create distinct environments for the function and segregation of various membrane processes.
title_zh: 质膜的空间解构
abstract_zh: 摘要 已知细胞质膜在蛋白质和脂质的空间分布方面是异质的，但这种异质性的性质和起源尚不清楚。在这项研究中，我们对质膜片进行荧光显微镜检查，发现大多数蛋白质出现在富含蛋白质的区域中，中间被蛋白质贫乏的区域隔开。我们表明，富含蛋白质的结构域和缺乏蛋白质的区域至少部分保留在缺乏细胞骨架元件的质膜来源的囊泡中，从而允许通过密度离心分离和分离它们。通过核磁共振和质谱进行的成分分析表明，不同的蛋白质和脂质表现出不同的倾向，以划分为富含蛋白质的结构域。这种差异分配与不同蛋白质的功能相关，表明基于细胞过程的分离。同样，有序脂质，包括胆固醇和鞘磷脂，也存在差异分离，在富含蛋白质的区域更为丰富。我们认为某些蛋白质和脂质的集体组装造成了膜成分的异质分布和富含蛋白质的结构域的出现。这些域可以为各种膜过程的功能和分离创造独特的环境。

title: Viscosity and Pore Accessibility Control of Type I Porous Liquids by Modifying Surface Functionality of Metal–Organic Polyhedra
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Viscosity of porous liquids (PLs) is a critical factor for their processability and transportation, yet controlling their viscosity without compromising pore volume remains a significant challenge. In this work, we present a strategy to modulate the viscosity of type I PLs by varying surface functionality. A series of star-shaped PLs was synthesized by coordinating 12 equiv of soft polymer chains to isostructural rhodium metal–organic polyhedra (RhMOPs) as central cores with different surface groups (nonsubstituted, hydroxy, tert-butyl, or dodecyloxy groups). The functional groups on the RhMOP surface were found to significantly affect the conformation of polymer chains, thereby resulting in different rheological behavior and pore accessibility. The use of RhMOPs with dodecyloxy surface groups yielded a closely compact conformation of polymer chains on the MOP surface. The obtained PLs have a viscosity as low as 1.8 × 101 Pa·s and exhibit a temperature-dependent gating effect; CO2 uptake increases with increasing temperature. By contrast, the hydroxyl group afforded PLs with a loosely stretched polymer conformation, resulting in a dramatically high viscosity of 3.0 × 109 Pa·s and high gas accessibility to the inner RhMOP pores. This work provides a feasible way to adjust PLs’ rheological properties without altering pore volume to meet the requirements of different practical applications.
title_zh: 通过修饰金属有机多面体的表面官能度控制 I 型多孔液体的粘度和孔隙可达性
abstract_zh: 摘要 多孔液体（PL）的粘度是其加工性和运输的关键因素，但在不影响孔体积的情况下控制其粘度仍然是一个重大挑战。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种通过改变表面功能来调节 I 型 PL 粘度的策略。通过将 12 当量的软聚合物链与同构铑金属有机多面体 (RhMOPs) 配位作为具有不同表面基团（未取代、羟基、叔丁基或十二烷氧基）的中心核，合成了一系列星形 PL。研究发现RhMOP表面的官能团显着影响聚合物链的构象，从而导致不同的流变行为和孔隙通达性。使用具有十二烷氧基表面基团的 RhMOP 在 MOP 表面上产生了紧密紧凑的聚合物链构象。所得PLs的粘度低至1.8×101 Pa·s，并表现出与温度相关的门控效应； CO2 吸收随着温度的升高而增加。相比之下，羟基为 PL 提供了松散拉伸的聚合物构象，从而导致 3.0 × 109 Pa·s 的极高粘度和内部 RhMOP 孔隙的高气体可及性。这项工作提供了一种在不改变孔体积的情况下调节PLs流变性能的可行方法，以满足不同实际应用的要求。

title: Chiral N-Heterocyclic Carbene On-Surface Induced Electronic Spin Filtration
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract It is well established that transport of electrons through chiral molecules can depend on their spins. However, it is not yet comprehensible how to relate molecular structure and size to spin selectivity. N-heterocyclic carbenes (NHCs) are a unique class of small organic molecules with electronic tunability generating huge structural and applicative diversity and covalently bind to metal surfaces to form a robust self-assembled monolayer (SAM). Here, we demonstrate that this family of molecules exhibits high spin selectivity, despite their small size, while being extremely stable on metal surfaces. We have fabricated chiral NHC thin films on the metal surfaces and utilized them as electron spin filters for the first time. The (S,S)-SINpEt and (R,R)-SINpEt thin films on Au–Ni surfaces showcase a high electronic spin polarization (SP) of up to 60%. The chiral NHC thin films exhibit electrochemical stability under continuous voltametric interrogation for 50 cycles (within a −0.3 to 0.3 V vs Ag/AgCl voltage window) in an aqueous solution (pH = 13), which enables the utilization of spin-polarized electrons to enhance the oxygen reduction reaction (ORR). The ORR with chiral SINpEt thin films of different thicknesses indicates the importance of the coherency of the electrons in the ORR reaction. The binding, orientation of the chiral SINpEt molecules, and their molecular coverage on the Au surface have also been investigated using quantum chemical calculations, which ensure a good agreement with the experimental observations. This finding introduces a new class of small chiral molecules as a useful source of electronic spin-polarization for various applications.

title: Activation of Inorganic Ligands by Interfacial Charge Transfer from a Complexation-Generated Valence Band at the Surface of a Metal Oxide Nanocrystal
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Incorporation of colloidal metal oxides into multicomponent solid-state materials gives rise to heterojunctions that, in photocatalysis, can obviate the need for sacrificial reagents. In principle, however, metal-oxide nanocrystals (NCs) could be functionalized by ligands that, while stabilizing the particles in solution, interact with the metal-oxide surface to provide self-contained analogs of multicomponent solid-state photocatalysts. We now report that simulated solar-light irradiation of 3.2 nm rutile-SnO2 NCs complexed by monolayers of approximately 50 hexaniobate anions, [Nb6O19]8– (1) leads to the selective reduction of CO2 to CO by water alone. Mott–Schottky analysis of 1 gives band energies typical of rutile SnO2, which, in relation to the HOMO and LUMO energies of hexaniobate, rule out Z-scheme or type-II heterojunction mechanisms. Ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy (UPS), however, revealed a new valence band (VB) nearly 2 eV higher in energy than the canonical VB energy of rutile SnO2. Topotactic mapping of Nb–O→Sn linkages from hexaniobate ligands to nearly all surface-accessible Sn atoms supports the generation of a network of electron-rich Sn-linked O atoms. Excitation of this surface-localized VB results in charge transfer (CT) conversion of the inorganic ligands into catalytic active sites. More generally, the findings introduce a new approach to interfacial engineering of metal-oxide NCs.
title_zh: 通过金属氧化物纳米晶体表面络合生成的价带的界面电荷转移活化无机配体
abstract_zh: 摘要：将胶体金属氧化物掺入多组分固态材料中会产生异质结，在光催化中可以消除对牺牲试剂的需要。然而，原则上，金属氧化物纳米晶体（NC）可以通过配体进行功能化，在稳定溶液中的颗粒的同时，与金属氧化物表面相互作用，以提供多组分固态光催化剂的独立类似物。我们现在报道，模拟太阳光照射由大约 50 个六铌酸阴离子单层复合的 3.2 nm 金红石-SnO2 NCs，[Nb6O19]8– (1) 导致仅用水选择性地将 CO2 还原为 CO。 1 的莫特-肖特基分析给出了金红石 SnO2 的典型能带能量，与己铌酸盐的 HOMO 和 LUMO 能量相关，排除了 Z 型或 II 型异质结机制。然而，紫外光电子能谱 (UPS) 揭示了一个新的价带 (VB)，其能量比金红石 SnO2 的标准 VB 能量高出近 2 eV。从己铌酸盐配体到几乎所有表面可及的 Sn 原子的 Nb-O→Sn 连接的拓扑映射支持富电子 Sn 连接的 O 原子网络的生成。这种表面局部 VB 的激发导致无机配体的电荷转移 (CT) 转化为催化活性位点。更广泛地说，这些发现引入了一种金属氧化物纳米颗粒界面工程的新方法。

title: Node-Assisted Photoredox Reactivity Enables MOF-Catalyzed Hydrogen/Deuterium Exchange in Aromatic Aldehydes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Light-driven isotopic labeling is currently dominated by homogeneous catalysis and largely relies on separate thiol-based hydrogen-atom-transfer catalysts. Metal–organic frameworks (MOFs), with their modular structures, confined pore environments, and tunable optoelectronic properties, offer an attractive but largely unexplored heterogeneous platform for controlled isotopic incorporation in chemicals. Herein, we report a systematic investigation of MOF-photocatalyzed hydrogen/deuterium (H/D) exchange, demonstrating that UiO-66-type materials uniquely enable thiol-free, formyl-selective deuteration of aromatic aldehydes using D2O as the sole deuterium source. Under UV irradiation, UiO-66 materials achieve up to 97% H/D incorporation over 3 h with 99% product selectivity, a level of control far surpassing that of catalyst-free photochemistry. Evaluation of the influence of linker functionalization shows that efficiency depends on multiple interdependent parameters, including radical generation, porosity, substrate binding and diffusion, and D2O accessibility, thereby establishing it as a key design handle for controlling reactivity in H/D exchange. Mechanistic investigations using electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy, controls using isotopically enriched UiO-66 and zirconium oxo clusters, and density functional theory analysis demonstrate that the Zr6O4(OH)4 nodes actively participate in catalysis, enabling deuterium transfer via proton-coupled electron-transfer mechanisms involving in situ-generated μ3-OD groups. Aldehyde confinement at the Zr6-cluster surface suppresses competing oxidation pathways and promotes a surface-confined radical mechanism that is inaccessible to homogeneous photocatalysts. Our findings establish UiO-66 as a single-component heterogeneous photocatalyst for selective isotopic labeling and mechanistically probe a previously unexplored mode of node-centered photoreactivity in MOFs. This work provides mechanistic insights into the use of MOFs for isotopic labeling and late-stage functionalization under mild conditions, highlighting the role of node-centered photochemistry.
