source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Affordable and stable organodisulfide anolytes are attractive for long‐duration aqueous redox flow batteries (ARFBs) for grid energy storage. However, the sluggish redox reactions involving the cleavage/formation of sulfur–sulfur (S─S) bonds cause severe polarization and limited capacity utilization, thus hindering the practical application of organodisulfide anolytes in ARFBs. Herein, we report a homogeneous catalysis strategy employing hydroxocobalamin (Vitamin B
                    12

                    −2

                    −2

                    −1
                    delivered capacity. This cobalamin(II) catalysis strategy addresses the kinetic bottlenecks inherent to organodisulfide‐based anolytes for ARFBs.

title: Lightweight All‐Solid‐State Pouch Cells Freed from High Stack Pressure
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Since 2011, ionic conductivity of some sulfide‐ and halide‐based solid‐state electrolytes (SSEs) have already reached a level comparable to that of liquid electrolytes. Numerous companies worldwide have proposed diverse technical pathways for commercializing electric vehicles with ultra‐long driving ranges. However, the practical vehicular application of all‐solid‐state batteries (ASSBs) remains highly challenging and uncertain. One of the major obstacles is the requirement for high stack pressure, which typically relies on heavy metallic plates and thereby reduces the overall energy density of the module battery. This perspective compares practical all‐solid‐state pouch cells (ASSPCs) with conventional liquid batteries to analyze the origins of stack pressure requirements. The analysis is conducted from material, interfacial, and structural viewpoints, revealing the critical factors underlying this limitation. Subsequently, strategies are proposed to mitigate stack pressure from the current 20 MPa to 5 MPa for the first stage and to 2 MPa as the final target. The effect of stack pressure on cell‐to‐module energy density efficiency is also calculated to quantitative analysis. These insights provide practical suggestion from ASSPCs design to module‐level pressure management.
title_zh: 摆脱高堆栈压力的轻质全固态软包电池
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  自2011年以来，一些硫化物和卤化物基固态电解质（SSE）的离子电导率已经达到与液体电解质相当的水平。全球许多公司提出了多种技术途径来实现超长行驶里程的电动汽车的商业化。然而，全固态电池（ASSB）的实际车辆应用仍然充满挑战和不确定性。主要障碍之一是对高堆压的要求，这通常依赖于重金属板，从而降低了模块电池的整体能量密度。该视角将实用的全固态软包电池（ASSPC）与传统液体电池进行比较，以分析电堆压力要求的根源。该分析从材料、界面和结构的角度进行，揭示了这一限制背后的关键因素。随后，提出了将第一阶段烟囱压力从目前的 20 MPa 降低到 5 MPa 的策略，并最终目标降低到 2 MPa。还计算了电堆压力对电池到模块能量密度效率的影响并进行定量分析。这些见解提供了从 ASSPC 设计到模块级压力管理的实用建议。

ABSTRACT
                  
                    Achieving selective molecular sieving, efficient particulate filtration, and passive signal acquisition into an integrated flexible membrane signifies a pivotal advancement toward interactive sensing‐protective application. Herein, we unravel cross‐scale mechanically interlocked poly(lactic acid) (CSMI‐PLA) nanofibrous membranes fabricated via primary hydrogen bonding through polydopamine adhesion and secondary coordinate bonding via heterogeneous metal‐organic frameworks entanglement. This hierarchically interlocked interface design establishes robust connectivity across dimensional scales, endowing CSMI‐PLA with exceptional mechanical resilience and long‐term sensing‐protective durability. Remarkably, the CSMI‐PLA membranes simultaneously achieve >99.45% removal of PM

                    2

Moreover, the CSMI‐PLA membranes retain high functional integrity under multicomponent conditions while offering intrisical electroactivity that enables passive intelligent sensing. This work establishes a generalizable platform for engendering sensing‐protective nanofibers, with promising implications for molecularly gated sieving and biodegradable self‐adaptive wearables.

title: Covalent Interfacial Anchoring of 1D‐2D Hybrid Nanofillers to Poly(Vinyl Alcohol) Networks Enables High‐Strength, High‐Stiffness Hydrogel Fibers
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Hydrogels with high strength, stiffness, and toughness under full hydration are essential for load‐transfer applications such as artificial tendons, ligaments, and soft robotics. Yet achieving such performance remains difficult because conventional polymer networks are intrinsically soft and transfer stress inefficiently. Here, a covalent interfacial anchoring (CIA) strategy is introduced to enable high‐strength, high‐stiffness hydrogel microfibers under full hydration by chemically anchoring carbon nanotubes (CNTs) and graphene oxide (GO) within poly(vinyl alcohol) networks. In this network, CNTs contribute to axial load transfer, whereas GO forms glutaraldehyde‐mediated PVA–GO acetal linkages that suppress nanofiller mobility during deformation and promote efficient stress transfer. The resulting hydrogel fibers achieve tensile strength of 132 MPa, modulus of 1.1 GPa and toughness of 25 MJ m
                    −3
                    under full hydration and maintain ∼88% displacement after 100 tendon‐mimetic loading cycles. These findings highlight covalent interfacial anchoring as an effective strategy for engineering strong and stiff hydrogel fibers for tendon‐like load‐transfer applications.
title_zh: 1D-2D 混合纳米填料与聚（乙烯醇）网络的共价界面锚定可实现高强度、高硬度水凝胶纤维
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    在完全水合下具有高强度、刚度和韧性的水凝胶对于人工肌腱、韧带和软机器人等负载转移应用至关重要。然而，实现这样的性能仍然很困难，因为传统的聚合物网络本质上是软的并且传递应力的效率低。在这里，引入了共价界面锚定（CIA）策略，通过将碳纳米管（CNT）和氧化石墨烯（GO）化学锚定在聚乙烯醇网络内，在完全水合下实现高强度、高硬度的水凝胶微纤维。在该网络中，CNT有助于轴向载荷传递，而GO形成戊二醛介导的PVA-GO缩醛键，抑制变形过程中纳米填料的流动性并促进有效的应力传递。所得水凝胶纤维的拉伸强度为 132 MPa，模量为 1.1 GPa，韧性为 25 MJ m
                    −3
                    在完全水合的情况下，在 100 个模拟肌腱加载循环后保持约 88% 的位移。这些发现强调了共价界面锚定是一种有效的策略，可以为肌腱样负载转移应用设计坚固且坚硬的水凝胶纤维。

title: Reducing Solvent Selectivity via Solid Additive‐Assisted Strategy Enables Organic Solar Cells With Approaching 21% Efficiency
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Currently, high‐performance organic solar cells (OSCs) are predominantly fabricated using chloroform (CF) to achieve an optimal active‐layer morphology. However, its rapid film formation results in a narrow processing window and severely limits industrial scalability. Therefore, reducing solvent selectivity during active‐layer processing is essential to facilitate scalable OSC manufacturing. Herein, this critical issue is finely addressed by a solid‐additive‐assisted strategy, in which 2,6‐dimethylnaphthalene (2,6‐DMN) is incorporated to modulate the film formation dynamic and molecular aggregation in different processing solvents. It is revealed that 2,6‐DMN enables stage‐specific control over the film formation process. Its mechanism involves suppressing acceptor aggregation during spin‐coating and then promoting ordered acceptor self‐assembly during annealing. This two‐stage modulation simplifies donor–acceptor interactions, mitigates excessive aggregation caused by slow solvent drying, and thereby prevents large‐scale phase separation. As a result, 2,6‐DMN induces a highly uniform and favorable active‐layer morphology across various processing solvents, thereby alleviating performance variations in devices caused by solvent effect. Consequently, the 2,6‐DMN‐based PM6:D18:L8‐BO‐X ternary device processed from
                    o
                    ‐xylene achieves a remarkable efficiency of 20.86%, setting a record for non‐halogenated solvent‐processed OSCs. This work provides a practical and efficient solid‐additive‐assisted strategy to mitigate the solvent selectivity in OSCs, demonstrating significant potential for achieving high‐performance OSCs with enhanced processing compatibility.
title_zh: 通过固体添加剂辅助策略降低溶剂选择性，使有机太阳能电池的效率接近 21%
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    目前，高性能有机太阳能电池（OSC）主要使用氯仿（CF）来制造，以实现最佳的活性层形态。然而，其快速成膜导致加工窗口狭窄，严重限制了工业可扩展性。因此，在有源层加工过程中降低溶剂选择性对于促进可扩展的 OSC 制造至关重要。在这里，这个关键问题通过固体添加剂辅助策略得到了很好的解决，其中加入2,6-二甲基萘（2,6-DMN）来调节不同加工溶剂中的成膜动态和分子聚集。据透露，2,6-DMN 能够对成膜过程进行阶段特定的控制。其机制涉及在旋涂过程中抑制受体聚集，然后在退火过程中促进有序受体自组装。这种两阶段调制简化了供体-受体相互作用，减轻了溶剂缓慢干燥引起的过度聚集，从而防止了大规模的相分离。因此，2,6-DMN 在各种加工溶剂中诱导出高度均匀且良好的活性层形态，从而减轻由溶剂效应引起的器件性能变化。因此，基于 2,6-DMN 的 PM6:D18:L8-BO-X 三元器件由
                    哦
                    ‐二甲苯实现了 20.86% 的惊人效率，创下了非卤化溶剂加工 OSC 的记录。这项工作提供了一种实用且有效的固体添加剂屁股

title: Scalable Synthesis of 3D Hierarchical MoS2 as a Durable, High‐Charge‐Retention Friction Layer for the Facile Fabrication of High‐Power Triboelectric Nanogenerators
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Given the increasing demand for sustainable energy and self‐powered devices, energy‐harvesting technologies, such as triboelectric nanogenerators (TENGs), are drawing attention. To address the short charge retention in conventional polymer materials, 2D materials with high surface areas and intrinsic charge‐trapping capabilities, such as MoS
                    2
                    , are being utilized as friction layers in TENGs. However, their power generation is too low for practical applications owing to their atomically thin nature, limiting their use as fillers in polymer‐based systems. We report a 2D‐material‐based high‐power TENG using 3D hierarchical MoS
                    2
                    (3DH‐MoS
                    2
                    ) as a primary friction material. The 3DH‐MoS
                    2
                    is synthesized via low‐temperature metal–organic chemical vapor deposition, enabling the direct growth of a uniform, large‐area, 3D‐nanostructured friction layer on a polymer substrate without additional processes. This 3D nanostructure increases the amount of charge‐trapping sites and significantly enhances the durability of the device. The 4 × 4 cm
                    2
                    3DH‐MoS
                    2
                    ‐based TENG produces a maximum output voltage of 320.1 V and a power density of 0.841 mW cm
                    −2
                    , proving it can effectively power light‐emitting diodes and a calculator, maintaining its performance over 10 000 cycles. In addition, the device can generate electricity from gas and water flow and human motion, highlighting the potential and versatility of 2D‐material‐based energy‐harvesting systems.

title: Homogenizing Vertical Strain Distribution Enables High‐Performance Tin‐Based Perovskite Solar Cells With Thicker Absorber via Two‐Step Deposition
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    Owing to typically restricted active layer thickness (∼200 nm), solution‐processed tin‐based perovskite solar cells (TPVSCs) suffer from incomplete photon‐to‐electron conversion, which fundamentally limits power conversion efficiency (PCE). Unfortunately, we uncover for the first time that increasing the active layer thickness induces detrimental vertical lattice strain gradient and faster crystallization rate, which exacerbate defect formation and ultimately cause a severe mismatch between electron diffusion length and absorber thickness in the tin‐based perovskite device. Concurrently, it retards crystallization kinetics, thus achieving an electron diffusion length commensurate with active layer thickness. Ultimately, the excellent PCEs of 15.02% (certified 14.78%) for rigid devices and 12.43% for flexible devices at 0.04 cm

title: Durable Seawater Electrolysis Enabled by Spherical Electrostatic Repulsion and Catalyst‐Support Interaction
source: Wiley: Advanced Materials: Table of Contents
abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  
                    The electrolysis of seawater driven by renewable energy for hydrogen production represents a promising strategy toward net‐zero emissions. The high concentration of chloride ions (Cl
                    −
                    ) in seawater not only competes with the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) at the anode but also causes corrosion of the catalyst material. The construction of electrostatic shielding via anions on the catalyst surface can repel Cl
                    −
                    . However, studies on regulating anion distribution through designed geometries to maximize such repulsion remain limited. Herein, a sphere‐like catalyst, constructed with a heterojunction of carbonate‐intercalated nickel‐iron layered double hydroxides in situ grown on malachite microspheres (MM), exhibits enhanced catalytic durability and activity. The spherical electrostatic field induced by carbonate anions protects the catalyst, and the catalyst‐support interaction (CSI) tunes the electronic structure of active sites to boost OER. Finally, the assembled electrolyzer demonstrates outstanding durability over 1000 h and a voltage of 1.83 V at a current density of 1 A per cm
                    2
                    . This spherical geometrical design of electrostatic protection offers insights into catalyst optimization for seawater electrolysis.

                    -

title: Direction-resolved synthetic DD neutron spectra based on arbitrary fast-ion distributions for the HL-3 tokamak
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: A spatially resolved and direction-resolved framework for computing fusion reaction rates and synthetic neutron energy spectra is implemented in the Particle Orbit Tracing Code (PTC). The model accepts arbitrary ion velocity distributions and explicitly separates thermal, beam–thermal, and beam–beam contributions, enabling calculations of local fusion sources and line-integrated neutron spectra for specified viewing geometries. The approach is applied to HL-3 tokamak plasmas with neutral beam injection. For core ion temperatures , the volume-integrated DD neutron production rate is dominated by beam–thermal reactions, accounting for approximately 70%–80% of the total. Increasing the beam injection energy enhances the beam–thermal contribution to the neutron production rate and leads to higher-energy and broader neutron spectra. The neutron spectral shape depends strongly on the viewing geometry: a mid-plane radial line-of-sight (LOS) exhibits a clear double-peaked beam–thermal spectrum, whereas a mid-plane chord LOS yields a smoother, single-peaked spectrum. The volume-integrated DD neutron production rate predicted by PTC is slightly higher than the TRANSP result, with a relative difference of when normalised to the PTC value. Compared with unfolded HL-3 DD neutron spectra from shots #6002 and #12260, the LOS-integrated synthetic spectra capture the main DD-peak structure and the spectral shape on the high-energy side at the source-spectrum level. The remaining low-energy-side differences are mainly associated with diagnostic-chain effects and residual source-modelling limitations.
title_zh: 基于 HL-3 托卡马克任意快离子分布的方向分辨合成 DD 中子谱
abstract_zh: 粒子轨道追踪代码 (PTC) 中实现了用于计算聚变反应速率和合成中子能谱的空间分辨和方向分辨框架。该模型接受任意离子速度分布，并明确分离热、束-热和束-束贡献，从而能够计算指定观察几何形状的局部聚变源和线积分中子能谱。该方法适用于中性束注入的 HL-3 托卡马克等离子体。对于核心离子温度，体积积分DD中子产生速率以束热反应为主，约占总数的70%~80%。增加束注入能量增强了束热对中子产生速率的贡献，并导致更高的能量和更宽的中子谱。中子谱形状在很大程度上取决于观察几何形状：中平面径向视线 (LOS) 表现出清晰的双峰束热谱，而中平面弦 LOS 则产生更平滑的单峰谱。 PTC预测的体积积分DD中子产率略高于TRANSP结果，与归一化至PTC值时的相对差异。与#6002 和#12260 中的展开的 HL-3 DD 中子能谱相比，LOS 积分合成能谱在源能谱水平上捕获了主要 DD 峰结构和高能侧的能谱形状。剩余的低能量侧差异主要与诊断链效应和剩余源建模极限有关

title: Hybrid simulations of fishbones with high order harmonics in EAST Tokamak
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: The linear stability and nonlinear dynamics of fishbones with high order harmonics have been investigated by the global kinetic-magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) code M3D-K in the Experimental Advanced Superconducting Tokamak (EAST). Based on EAST discharge parameters with neutral beam injection (NBI) heating, linear simulations show that the modes with different toroidal mode numbers are primarily driven by trapped energetic particles (EPs) through toroidal precession resonance. The mode is the typical fishbone, while there exists a transition for mode from fishbone-like mode to energetic particle mode (EPM) when the EP pressure exceeds a critical value. For the mode, the mode frequency remains almost unchanged with different EP pressure. Nonlinear simulations show that with weak EP drive, the mode is driven by the MHD nonlinear coupling of the fundamental mode. In this regime, the frequency of the harmonic is twice that of the mode, with both modes exhibiting downward frequency chirping. With strong EP drive, beta-induced Alfvén eigenmodes (BAEs) with higher mode frequencies emerge for both and components, and the component is driven unstable with frequency chirping up. These simulation results highlight that nonlinear MHD coupling and fast ion redistribution are critical for understanding the dynamics of fishbones with high order harmonics.
title_zh: EAST 托卡马克中高次谐波鱼骨的混合模拟
abstract_zh: 高次谐波鱼骨的线性稳定性和非线性动力学已通过实验先进超导托卡马克（EAST）中的全局动磁流体动力学（MHD）代码M3D-K进行了研究。基于采用中性束注入 (NBI) 加热的 EAST 放电参数，线性模拟表明，具有不同环形模数的模式主要由捕获的高能粒子 (EP) 通过环形进动共振驱动。该模态是典型的鱼骨模，而当EP压力超过临界值时，存在从鱼骨模到高能粒子模(EPM)的模态转变。对于模态，模态频率在不同的EP压力下几乎保持不变。非线性仿真表明，在弱 EP 驱动下，该模式是由基模的 MHD 非线性耦合驱动的。在这种情况下，谐波的频率是模式的两倍，两种模式都表现出向下频率的啁啾。在强 EP 驱动下， 和 组件都会出现具有更高模式频率的 β 诱发阿尔文本征模 (BAE)，并且组件会因频率啁啾而驱动不稳定。这些仿真结果强调，非线性 MHD 耦合和快速离子重新分布对于理解高次谐波鱼骨动力学至关重要。

title: Alpha particle velocity- and orbit-space sensitivity of gamma-ray spectroscopy diagnostics based on the ...
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: A key challenge on the path towards burning plasmas is the measurement of the alpha particle phase space. Among the few experimental options available, gamma-ray spectroscopy (GRS) is a key method. Previous demonstrations at Joint European Torus were based on reactions between alpha particles and beryllium as the target impurity, but this is no longer applicable, neither at ITER with a tungsten-based first wall, nor in other forthcoming burning plasma experiments. On the other hand, owing to the use of boron injection for plasma operations in tungsten devices, gamma-ray reactions between the alpha particles and boron impurities have been proposed as an alternative. This work presents the first numerical evaluation of the velocity-space and orbit-space sensitivity of boron-based GRS to the alpha particle phase space, focusing on the reaction. Depending on the emission peak, we find that measurements can be separately sensitive to selected super- and sub-Alfvenic velocities, with an enhanced sensitivity towards particles on trapped and potato orbits, for the case of radial lines of sight. Information on co- and counter-going alphas may be accessed only by more refined spectral shape analysis or if a tangential line of sight is deployed. The results are relevant to establish a bridge between the indirect GRS measurements and the alpha particle phase space. They furthermore provide a quantitative input to determine which wave-alpha particle resonant interactions may (or may not) be measurable with boron based GRS, depending on the observation geometry.
title_zh: 基于...的伽马射线能谱诊断的阿尔法粒子速度和轨道空间灵敏度
abstract_zh: 燃烧等离子体道路上的一个关键挑战是阿尔法粒子相空间的测量。在可用的少数实验选项中，伽马射线光谱（GRS）是一种关键方法。之前在欧洲联合圆环上的演示是基于α粒子和作为目标杂质的铍之间的反应，但这不再适用，无论是在具有钨基第一壁的国际热核实验堆上，还是在其他即将进行的燃烧等离子体实验中。另一方面，由于在钨器件中使用硼注入进行等离子体操作，阿尔法粒子和硼杂质之间的伽马射线反应已被提议作为替代方案。这项工作首次对硼基 GRS 对 α 粒子相空间的速度空间和轨道空间敏感性进行数值评估，重点关注反应。根据发射峰值，我们发现测量可以分别对选定的超阿尔芬速度和亚芬速度敏感，对于径向视线的情况，对捕获轨道和马铃薯轨道上的粒子的灵敏度增强。有关同向和反向阿尔法的信息只能通过更精细的光谱形状分析或部署切向视线才能访问。结果与在间接 GRS 测量和 α 粒子相空间之间建立桥梁相关。它们还提供定量输入，以确定哪些波-α粒子共振相互作用可以（或不能）用基于硼的 GRS 测量，具体取决于观测几何形状。

title: Modeling the effects of carbon impurity transport and E×B drift on detachment cliff in the HL-3 open X-divertor by SOLPS-ITER
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: This work employs the SOLPS-ITER code package to investigate the effects of carbon impurity transport and E × B drift on the detachment cliff in the HL-3 open X-divertor configuration (OXD), and elucidates the physical mechanism behind the experimental observation that divertor detachment in the HL-3 OXD requires a higher upstream separatrix density (ne,sep) to occur than in the standard single null divertor configuration (SN). In this work, we find that: (1) the E × B drift more strongly suppresses divertor detachment in the HL-3 OXD under low ne,sep than in the SN; (2) a detachment cliff is observed in the HL-3 OXD with/without E × B drift. The open structure and large poloidal magnetic flux expansion of the HL-3 OXD lead to a detachment cliff at the outer strike point under low ne,sep conditions without drifts, resulting in an inhomogeneous divertor state (strike point detached, far SOL high-recycling). With drifts included, the inhomogeneous state drives poloidal and radial E × B flows that together transport carbon impurities away from the outer strike point, making the HL-3 OXD harder to detach—consistent with experiments. Besides, we find that the fundamental cause of the detachment cliff in the HL-3 OXD with/without drifts: as ne,sep rises above a certain threshold, the abrupt reversal of carbon impurity transport direction and the resulting positive−feedback loop in the divertor region. The difference lies in what drives the carbon impurity transport reversal: without drifts, it is driven by competition between thermal and frictional forces on carbon ions; with drifts, by changes in the poloidal E × B drift flow near the separatrix. These findings indicate that the open divertor structure of the HL-3 OXD is the primary reason for its difficulty in achieving detachment. Enhancing its closure can significantly improve its detachment capability, providing a reference for the application of the X−divertor in future devices (ITER/CFETR).
title_zh: 通过 SOLPS-ITER 模拟碳杂质传输和 E×B 漂移对 HL-3 开放式 X 偏滤器中脱离悬崖的影响
abstract_zh: 这项工作采用 SOLPS-ITER 代码包来研究碳杂质输运和 E × B 漂移对 HL-3 开放 X 偏滤器配置 (OXD) 中分离悬崖的影响，并阐明了实验观察背后的物理机制，即 HL-3 OXD 中的偏滤器分离需要比标准单零偏滤器配置 (SN) 更高的上游分界密度 (ne,sep) 才能发生。在这项工作中，我们发现：（1）在低ne,sep下，E×B漂移对HL-3 OXD中偏滤器脱离的抑制比SN中更强； (2) 在有/无 E × B 漂移的 HL-3 OXD 中观察到脱离悬崖。 HL-3 OXD的开放结构和大的极向磁通量膨胀导致在低ne,sep条件下在没有漂移的情况下在外冲击点处出现脱离悬崖，导致不均匀的偏滤器状态（冲击点脱离，远SOL高回收）。考虑到漂移，不均匀状态驱动极向和径向 E × B 流，这些流共同将碳杂质从外部撞击点输送出去，使 HL-3 OXD 更难分离——与实验一致。此外，我们发现HL-3 OXD中带/不带漂移的脱离悬崖的根本原因是：当ne,sep上升到某个阈值以上时，碳杂质传输方向突然逆转，并在偏滤器区域产生正反馈回路。区别在于驱动碳杂质输运逆转的因素：没有漂移，它是由碳离子上的热力和摩擦力之间的竞争驱动的；没有漂移，它是由碳离子上的热力和摩擦力之间的竞争驱动的。与德里

title: Exploiting ICRH to maximise the neutron yield in VNS
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: While ITER will demonstrate that long duration pulses producing significant fusion power is possible in a fusion reactor relevant environment, the aim of the volumetric neutron source (VNS) tokamak is to offer a testbed for studying the impact of long-time fusion neutron exposure to the plasma facing components. Presently, the auxiliary heating schemes foreseen for the VNS are electron cyclotron and neutral beam injection (NBI) heating while the main fusion power generation is intended to result from beam-target reactions between the fast deuterium NBI ions and the thermal Tritium ions in the plasma. The present paper discusses the potential of only using wave heating to maximise the fusion yield in modest scale fusion reactors. We focus here on ion cyclotron resonance heating (ICRH or IC) while electron cyclotron heating (ECRH or EC) provides the basic target plasma the IC waves couple to. More in particular, we exploit the idea that permitted the fusion performance to be boosted beyond what NBI alone could achieve in the JET DTE2 and DTE3 campaigns. Adopting IC heating at the fundamental cyclotron frequency allows to create a moderately fast ion tail that has a large fraction of particles of a high concentration minority tail near the energy where the cross section peaks, similar to the NBI beam-target fusion scheme. Rather than adopting balanced and concentrations and count on fusion reactions produced by 2 thermal fuel ion thermal populations, the steepness of the cross section curve is exploited to boost the nuclear reactions between a thermal population and an IC created fast particle ‘beam’. In the present wave-only exploratory study it is estimated that of fusion power can be achieved when adopting the 2025 reference parameters for the VNS device. A more comprehensive study (not just focusing on heating) is, however, needed to assess the potential in more detail.
title_zh: 利用 ICRH 最大化 VNS 中的中子产额
abstract_zh: 虽然 ITER 将证明在聚变反应堆相关环境中产生显着聚变功率的长持续时间脉冲是可能的，但体积中子源 (VNS) 托卡马克的目的是提供一个测试平台，用于研究长时间聚变中子暴露对面向等离子体的组件的影响。目前，VNS预计的辅助加热方案是电子回旋加速器和中性束注入（NBI）加热，而主要聚变发电则由快速氘NBI离子和等离子体中的热氚离子之间的束靶反应产生。本文讨论了在中等规模的聚变反应堆中仅使用波加热来最大化聚变产率的潜力。我们在这里重点关注离子回旋加速器共振加热（IC​​RH 或 IC），而电子回旋加速器加热（ECRH 或 EC）提供 IC 波耦合的基本目标等离子体。更具体地说，我们利用了这样的想法：在 JET DTE2 和 DTE3 活动中，融合性能的提升超出了仅 NBI 所能达到的水平。采用基本回旋加速器频率的 IC 加热可以产生中等速度的离子尾部，该尾部在截面峰值能量附近具有大部分高浓度少数尾部的粒子，类似于 NBI 束-目标融合方案。不是采用平衡和浓度以及由 2 个热燃料离子热粒子产生的聚变反应，而是利用横截面曲线的陡度来促进热粒子和 IC 产生之间的核反应。

title: Physics-augmented surrogate model for linear instability analysis of high- n toroidal Alf...
source: Nuclear Fusion - latest papers
abstract: We propose the physics-augmented surrogate model for linear instability analysis of high- toroidal Alfvén eigenmodes (TAEs) in tokamaks. The database for high- TAE linear instabilities is generated by the global initial-value simulations by Gyrokinetic magnetohydrodynamic Energetic-particle Code (GMEC), and also the local eigenvalue code Energetic-particle TAE Eigenvalue Code (ETEC). The equations solved by ETEC are much simplified from the first-principle equations solved by GMEC, with high- ballooning representation. The local solutions from ETEC exhibit a strong correlation with the global solutions from GMEC. The multi-layer perceptron based surrogate models are trained, taking local normalized equilibrium parameters as inputs, and the real frequency and growth rate of TAEs obtained from GMEC as outputs. Our results indicate that incorporating ETEC results as prior physical information into the inputs leads to a substantial improvement in the generalization performance of the surrogate model.
title_zh: 用于高 n 环形 Alf 线性不稳定性分析的物理增强代理模型
abstract_zh: 我们提出了物理增强替代模型，用于托卡马克中高环形阿尔文本征模（TAE）的线性不稳定性分析。高 TAE 线性不稳定性的数据库是通过回旋磁流体动力能量粒子代码 (GMEC) 的全局初始值模拟以及局部特征值代码能量粒子 TAE 特征值代码 (ETEC) 生成的。 ETEC 求解的方程比 GMEC 求解的第一原理方程大大简化，具有高膨胀表示。 ETEC 的本地解决方案与 GMEC 的全球解决方案具有很强的相关性。以局部归一化平衡参数为输入，以从 GMEC 获得的 TAE 的真实频率和增长率作为输出，训练基于多层感知器的代理模型。我们的结果表明，将 ETEC 结果作为先验物理信息合并到输入中可以显着提高替代模型的泛化性能。

title: Overriding Intrinsic Site-Selectivity in Nickel(II)-Catalyzed Enantioselective Methylene C(sp3)–H Alkynylation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract The site- and enantioselective functionalization of aliphatic C–H bonds is a pivotal challenge in organic synthesis. While directed enantioselective methyl C(sp3)–H activation is well-established, achieving analogous reactivity at methylene sites─which would enable the direct editing of molecular scaffolds─remains a formidable goal, particularly with earth-abundant 3d metals. Here, we report the first nickel(II)-catalyzed enantioselective alkynylation of β-methylene C(sp3)–H bonds. This transformation is enabled by an air-stable Ni(II) salt and a bulky chiral phosphoric acid ligand, (R)-TCYP, delivering a broad range of β-alkynylated amides in up to 98% yield and 99% ee. Notably, this system achieves preferential methylene C–H activation in the presence of methyl groups, overcoming the intrinsic selectivity of directed C(sp3)–H activation. Mechanistic studies, including the isolation and full characterization of a chiral Ni(II)-metallacyclic intermediate via X-ray diffraction, reveal that the C–H cleavage step is both the rate- and enantio-determining step.
title_zh: 镍 (II) 催化的对映选择性亚甲基 C(sp3)–H 炔基化反应中重要的固有位点选择性
abstract_zh: 摘要 脂肪族 C-H 键的位点和对映选择性官能化是有机合成中的关键挑战。虽然定向对映选择性甲基 C(sp3)–H 激活已得到充分证实，但在亚甲基位点实现类似的反应性（这将能够直接编辑分子支架）仍然是一个艰巨的目标，特别是对于地球上丰富的 3d 金属。在这里，我们报道了第一个镍(II)催化的β-亚甲基C(sp3)-H键的对映选择性炔基化反应。这种转化是通过空气稳定的 Ni(II) 盐和庞大的手性磷酸配体 (R)-TCYP 实现的，可提供多种 β-炔基化酰胺，产率高达 98%，ee 高达 99%。值得注意的是，该系统在甲基存在的情况下实现了亚甲基C-H优先活化，克服了定向C(sp3)-H活化的固有选择性。机理研究，包括通过 X 射线衍射分离和全面表征手性 Ni(II)-金属环中间体，表明 C-H 裂解步骤既是速率决定步骤，也是对映体决定步骤。

title: Alternating Copolymerization of Cyclobutenes and Norbornenes by a Dual-Site Grubbs Catalyst
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Catalytic alternating copolymerization is an appealing yet challenging sequential synthetic strategy that requires catalysts to have uninterrupted alternating recognition capabilities for different monomers. Chemists usually utilize monomers that are difficult to self-polymerize, ensuring that the rate of alternating copolymerization is far higher than the rate of homopolymerization of each monomer. However, reports of alternating copolymerization between highly self-polymerizable monomers are exceedingly uncommon. This work employs a sterically demanding chiral Grubbs catalyst featuring an electron-donating C–Ru bond, which facilitates the alternation of each productive metathesis to occur on both sides. Therefore, by leveraging the steric differences on its right and left sides, the catalyst can effectively distinguish between two cycloalkenes that both demonstrate high ring-opening metathesis polymerization (ROMP) reactivity, albeit with slightly different steric hindrances. Efficient alternating copolymerization of cyclobutene and norbornene was achieved at a 1:1 monomer feed ratio, providing the resultant polymers with high molecular weights and low dispersity. In contrast to random copolymers or polynorbornenes, these alternating copolymers exhibit notably improved mechanical properties, characterized by high strength and high toughness without sacrificing elasticity. This study illustrates the wide range of potential uses for chiral catalysts in precision polymer synthesis.
title_zh: 双位点格拉布斯催化剂环丁烯和降冰片烯的交替共聚
abstract_zh: 摘要 催化交替共聚是一种有吸引力但具有挑战性的顺序合成策略，要求催化剂对不同单体具有不间断的交替识别能力。化学家通常使用难以自聚合的单体，确保交替共聚的速率远高于各单体的均聚的速率。然而，高度自聚合单体之间交替共聚的报道极其罕见。这项工作采用了空间要求高的手性格拉布斯催化剂，该催化剂具有供电子 C-Ru 键，有利于每个有效复分解在两侧发生。因此，通过利用其右侧和左侧的空间差异，该催化剂可以有效地区分两种都表现出高开环复分解聚合（ROMP）反应活性的环烯烃，尽管空间位阻略有不同。以1:1的单体投料比实现了环丁烯和降冰片烯的高效交替共聚，所得聚合物具有高分子量和低分散性。与无规共聚物或聚降冰片烯相比，这些交替共聚物表现出显着改善的机械性能，其特征在于高强度和高韧性而不牺牲弹性。这项研究说明了手性催化剂在精密聚合物合成中的广泛潜在用途。

title: Universal Metal-Free Deborylation–Deuteration via Redox-Decoupled Tandem Flow Electrosynthesis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Flow electrochemical synthesis is a promising platform for constructing value-added targets such as d-labeled compounds. However, its efficiency and broader application are limited by the unproductive or kinetically mismatched counter half-reactions and architectural constraints of conventional flow cell architectures. Here, we report a redox-decoupled strategy within a single-cell tandem flow reactor that separates a classical substitutive deborylation–deuteration into sequential electrochemical steps. This approach enables the universal, metal-free deuteration of diverse organoboron species, including boronic acids, borate esters, and borates, across alkyl, (heterocyclic) aryl, alkenyl, and other derivatives (>100 examples). Using D2O as a cost-effective d-source, the system achieves excellent yields, d-incorporation, tolerance to the labile functional groups, and significantly improved Faradaic efficiency. The platform demonstrates industrial-grade durability with continuous operation for over 1200 h and enables scalable, unprotected synthesis of deuterated drug d-mexiletine. Overall, this strategy significantly expands the design space of flow electrochemistry, paving an exciting path toward green, economic, and efficient electrosynthesis.
title_zh: 通过氧化还原解耦串联流电合成进行通用无金属脱硼-氘化
abstract_zh: 摘要 流动电化学合成是构建 d 标记化合物等增值靶标的有前景的平台。然而，其效率和更广泛的应用受到低效或动力学不匹配的反半反应以及传统流通池架构的架构限制的限制。在这里，我们报告了单池串联流反应器内的氧化还原解耦策略，该策略将经典的替代脱硼化-氘化分离为连续的电化学步骤。这种方法能够对各种有机硼物质进行通用、无金属的氘化，包括硼酸、硼酸酯和硼酸盐、烷基、（杂环）芳基、烯基和其他衍生物（> 100 个例子）。使用 D2O 作为经济高效的 d-源，该系统实现了优异的产率、d-掺入、对不稳定官能团的耐受性，并显着提高了法拉第效率。该平台展示了工业级的耐用性，可连续运行超过 1200 小时，并能够大规模、无保护地合成氘代药物 d-美西律。总体而言，该策略显着扩展了流式电化学的设计空间，为绿色、经济和高效的电合成铺平了一条令人兴奋的道路。

title: Hexaphenylbenzene Nodes Reshape Hydroxide Transport Energetics in Rigid Microporous Membranes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Rigid microporous anion exchange membranes (AEMs) can create continuous hydroxide transport pathways while suppressing swelling, but geometric percolation alone does not ensure rapid ion migration in chemically confined pores. Here we show that hydroxide transport in rigid microporous ionomers can be accelerated through topological ionic nodes that regulate local transport energetics. Incorporation of hexaphenylbenzene (HPB) into an ether-free poly(aryl piperidinium) framework simultaneously generates interconnected microporosity and spatially correlates multiple cationic sites within pore walls. Density functional theory and free-energy analysis show that HPB weakens hydroxide binding and lowers intersite hopping barriers by smoothing the local energetic landscape under confinement. The optimized membrane reaches 168.6 mS cm–1 at 90 °C, exhibits an apparent activation energy of 12.7 kJ mol–1, and swells by only 12.1% despite 75.6% water uptake. It retains 97.4% of its conductivity after 2000 h in 2 M KOH at 90 °C. These advantages translate into a peak fuel cell power density of 2.50 W cm–2 and an electrolyzer current density of 8.05 A cm–2 at 2.0 V, with stable operation over 2500 h. Spatially correlated ionic nodes therefore provide a molecular strategy to regulate hydroxide transport energetics in rigid microporous ionomers.
title_zh: 六苯基苯节点重塑刚性微孔膜中的氢氧化物传输能量
abstract_zh: 摘要：刚性微孔阴离子交换膜（AEM）可以在抑制膨胀的同时创建连续的氢氧化物传输路径，但仅靠几何渗滤并不能确保化学限制孔中离子的快速迁移。在这里，我们表明，刚性微孔离聚物中的氢氧化物传输可以通过调节局部传输能量的拓扑离子节点来加速。将六苯基苯（HPB）掺入无醚的聚（芳基哌啶鎓）框架中，同时产生互连的微孔并在孔壁内空间关联多个阳离子位点。密度泛函理论和自由能分析表明，HPB 通过平滑限制下的局部能量景观来削弱氢氧根结合并降低位点间跳跃势垒。优化后的膜在 90 °C 时达到 168.6 mS cm–1，表现出 12.7 kJ mol–1 的表观活化能，尽管吸水率为 75.6%，但仅膨胀 12.1%。在 90 °C 的 2 M KOH 中放置 2000 小时后，它仍保留 97.4% 的电导率。这些优势转化为 2.0 V 电压下燃料电池峰值功率密度为 2.50 W cm-2 和电解槽电流密度为 8.05 A cm-2，可稳定运行超过 2500 小时。因此，空间相关的离子节点提供了调节刚性微孔离聚物中氢氧根传输能量的分子策略。

title: Dynamic Covalent Functionalization of DNA Origami via Iminoboronate Chemistry
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Reversible functionalization of DNA nanostructures is essential for their integration into dynamic biological constructs and biomedical applications. Current strategies typically rely on strand displacement or stimuli-responsive sequences, while approaches based on dynamic covalent chemistry remain largely unexplored. Yet, dynamic covalent bonds combine covalent stability with reversible exchange under mild conditions, offering adaptable and biologically compatible routes to modulate DNA nanostructures. Here, we report iminoboronate conjugation as a strategy for the reversible functionalization of DNA origami. Polyethylene glycol and cholesterol moieties bearing 2-formylphenylboronic acid are efficiently conjugated to DNA origami displaying α-effect amines, while conjugate displacement can be triggered by a small-molecule competitor. We further demonstrate the reversible anchoring of DNA origami to lipid bilayer systems, including both large and giant unilamellar vesicles. These findings establish iminoboronate chemistry as a robust, stimuli-responsive platform for interfacing DNA origami with functional moieties, paving the way for programmable nanodevices and adaptive biomimetic materials.
title_zh: 通过亚氨基硼酸盐化学对 DNA Origami 进行动态共价功能化
abstract_zh: 摘要 DNA 纳米结构的可逆功能化对于将其整合到动态生物结构和生物医学应用中至关重要。目前的策略通常依赖于链置换或刺激响应序列，而基于动态共价化学的方法在很大程度上仍未被探索。然而，动态共价键将共价稳定性与温和条件下的可逆交换结合起来，为调节 DNA 纳米结构提供了适应性强且生物相容的途径。在这里，我们报告亚氨基硼酸缀合作为 DNA 折纸可逆功能化的策略。带有 2-甲酰基苯基硼酸的聚乙二醇和胆固醇部分可有效地与展示 α 效应胺的 DNA 折纸缀合，而缀合物置换可由小分子竞争剂触发。我们进一步证明了 DNA 折纸与脂质双层系统（包括大型和巨型单层囊泡）的可逆锚定。这些发现将亚氨基硼酸盐化学确立为一个强大的刺激响应平台，用于将 DNA 折纸与功能部分连接起来，为可编程纳米器件和自适应仿生材料铺平了道路。

title: A Bioorthogonal Desilylation System Potentiates mRNA Therapeutics in Tumors
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Lipid nanoparticle (LNP)-mediated mRNA delivery has emerged as a powerful therapeutic modality, yet its clinical translation in oncology remains constrained by inherent hepatic tropism and inefficient endosomal escape. These limitations necessitate high-dose administration, which triggers lipid-associated toxicity and off-target protein expression in the liver. To overcome these barriers, we report a cleavable silyl-ether-based bioorthogonally activatable LNP platform, termed SiLNP, that enables tumor-specific activation and cytosolic mRNA release. We engineered ionizable lipids incorporating silyl ether structural fuses that respond to a phenylalanine trifluoroborate (Phe-BF3) trigger. This system leverages the upregulated transporter LAT-1 to actively import Phe-BF3 into tumor cells, where it triggers lipid desilylation and rapid cargo release. In vitro, SiLNPs demonstrated controllable external control over mRNA expression, achieving a 44-fold enhancement in mRNA expression compared to standard SM-102 LNPs with a 10-fold activation-to-silent ratio. In immunologically “cold” B16–F10 melanoma models, SiLNPs encoding the N-terminal domain of gasdermin D (GDNT) induced tumor-specific pyroptosis, resulting in tumor growth inhibition without detectable systemic toxicity. Furthermore, this platform demonstrated versatility by delivering immunomodulatory mRNAs, including IL-2 and Cxcl9. Taken together, this work presents a metabolically targeted, bioorthogonal-activated delivery strategy to address the selectivity and efficiency limitations of current mRNA medicines, providing a promising platform for precision oncology.
title_zh: 生物正交脱甲硅烷基化系统增强肿瘤 mRNA 治疗
abstract_zh: 摘要：脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）介导的 mRNA 递送已成为一种强大的治疗方式，但其在肿瘤学中的临床转化仍然受到固有的肝向性和低效的内体逃逸的限制。这些限制使得高剂量给药成为必要，这会引发脂质相关毒性和肝脏中的脱靶蛋白表达。为了克服这些障碍，我们报告了一种基于可裂解甲硅烷基醚的生物正交可激活LNP平台，称为SiLNP，它能够实现肿瘤特异性激活和胞质mRNA释放。我们设计了包含硅醚结构熔丝的可电离脂质，可响应苯丙氨酸三氟硼酸盐 (Phe-BF3) 触发器。该系统利用上调的转运蛋白 LAT-1 主动将 Phe-BF3 导入肿瘤细胞，从而触发脂质脱甲硅烷基化和快速释放货物。在体外，SiLNP 表现出对 mRNA 表达的可控外部控制，与标准 SM-102 LNP 相比，mRNA 表达提高了 44 倍，激活与沉默比率提高了 10 倍。在免疫学“冷”B16-F10 黑色素瘤模型中，编码 Gasdermin D N 末端结构域 (GDNT) 的 SiLNP 诱导肿瘤特异性细胞焦亡，从而抑制肿瘤生长，且没有可检测到的全身毒性。此外，该平台通过提供免疫调节 mRNA（包括 IL-2 和 Cxcl9）而展示了多功能性。总而言之，这项工作提出了一种代谢靶向、生物正交激活的递送策略，以解决当前 mRNA 药物的选择性和效率限制，

title: Endowing Centrosymmetric Oxides with Effective Piezoelectricity via Oxygen Vacancy Engineering and Single-Atom Anchoring for Multicatalytic Sono-Immunotherapy
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Due to piezopotential-driven energy band tilting and the promotion of charge carrier separation, sonopiezoelectric therapy (SPT) holds promise in overcoming the limitations of band structure. However, the dependence of the piezoelectric effect on noncentrosymmetric crystal structures severely restricts the range of material selection. Herein, the intrinsic centrosymmetry of indium oxide (In2O3) nanocrystals was broken through oxygen vacancy (OV) engineering and single-atom anchoring strategies, resulting in copper single-atom-anchored OV-rich In2O3-x (CuSA-In2O3-x) with effective piezoelectricity. Through sonopiezoelectric catalysis, CuSA-In2O3-x can generate diverse reactive oxygen species, oxygen, and carbon monoxide and consume lactic acid and glutathione. Meanwhile, CuSA-In2O3-x also exhibits multiple enzyme-like activities, including catalase, peroxidase, glutathione oxidase, and nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (phosphate) (NAD(P)H) oxidase mimicking. Benefiting from the synergistic effect of multicatalytic performance, CuSA-In2O3-x under ultrasonic irradiation effectively disrupts the redox and energy metabolic homeostasis of tumor cells, thereby inducing apoptosis and ferroptosis and initiating immunogenic cell death to enhance the immune response. CuSA-In2O3-x combined with ultrasound not only significantly inhibits tumor growth but also promotes dendritic cell maturation, CD8+ T-cell infiltration, and memory T-cell differentiation, thereby activating immune protection and preventing tumor recurrence. As a representative application of centrosymmetric oxides in SPT, this work will expand the selection of piezoelectric sonocatalysts and provide valuable insights into sono-immunotherapy.
title_zh: 通过氧空位工程和单原子锚定赋予中心对称氧化物有效的压电效应，用于多催化声免疫治疗
abstract_zh: 摘要 由于压电势驱动的能带倾斜和促进载流子分离，超声压电疗法（SPT）有望克服能带结构的局限性。然而，压电效应对非中心对称晶体结构的依赖性严重限制了材料选择的范围。在此，通过氧空位（OV）工程和单原子锚定策略打破了氧化铟（In2O3）纳米晶体的固有中心对称性，产生了具有有效压电性的铜单原子锚定富含OV的In2O3-x（CuSA-In2O3-x）。通过超声压电催化，CuSA-In2O3-x可以产生多种活性氧、氧气和一氧化碳，并消耗乳酸和谷胱甘肽。同时，CuSA-In2O3-x还表现出多种酶样活性，包括过氧化氢酶、过氧化物酶、谷胱甘肽氧化酶和烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（磷酸）（NAD（P）H）氧化酶模拟。受益于多催化性能的协同效应，CuSA-In2O3-x在超声波照射下有效破坏肿瘤细胞的氧化还原和能量代谢稳态，从而诱导细胞凋亡和铁死亡，启动免疫原性细胞死亡，增强免疫反应。 CuSA-In2O3-x联合超声不仅能显着抑制肿瘤生长，还能促进树突状细胞成熟、CD8+T细胞浸润和记忆T细胞分化，从而激活免疫保护并预防肿瘤复发。作为中心对称氧的代表性应用

title: De Novo-Designed Bifunctional Proteins for Targeted Protein Degradation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract In targeted protein degradation (TPD), specific subcellular proteins are removed by routing them to the ubiquitin-proteasome, autophagy, or lysosome machinery. For instance, proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) are synthetic heterobifunctional small molecules that simultaneously bind the target and an E3 ubiquitin ligase to drive ubiquitination and degradation by the proteasome. Despite considerable success, designing such molecules is challenging, and the number of currently addressable ubiquitin E3 ligases is limited. Here, we design a heterobifunctional de novo protein to trigger the degradation of a common cancer target, resulting in a desired phenotypic output. First, we developed a highly stable and adaptable helix–turn–helix scaffold for presenting multiple binding sites. Next, we use computational protein design to incorporate and embellish hot-spot-binding sites to target the antiapoptotic mediators BCL-xL and MCL-1. We show a 75% success rate for creating submicromolar binders against these targets. Crystal structures of the complexes confirmed the designed binding poses. Then, we designed short linear motifs (SLiMs) into the loop of the scaffold to recruit KLHL20 and the ubiquitin ligase machinery. These designs have low micromolar affinity for KLHL20 comparable to that of the natural SLiMs. Moreover, the bifunctionalized proteins degrade BCL-xL in cells, leading to apoptosis.
title_zh: 用于靶向蛋白质降解的从头设计的双功能蛋白质
abstract_zh: 摘要 在靶向蛋白降解 (TPD) 中，特定的亚细胞蛋白通过泛素蛋白酶体、自噬或溶酶体机制被去除。例如，蛋白水解靶向嵌合体 (PROTAC) 是合成的异双功能小分子，可同时结合靶标和 E3 泛素连接酶，以驱动蛋白酶体泛素化和降解。尽管取得了相当大的成功，但设计此类分子仍具有挑战性，而且目前可寻址的泛素 E3 连接酶的数量有限。在这里，我们设计了一种异双功能从头蛋白质来触发常见癌症靶标的降解，从而产生所需的表型输出。首先，我们开发了一种高度稳定且适应性强的螺旋-转角-螺旋支架，用于呈现多个结合位点。接下来，我们使用计算蛋白质设计来整合和修饰热点结合位点，以靶向抗凋亡介质 BCL-xL 和 MCL-1。我们展示了针对这些目标创建亚微摩尔粘合剂的成功率为 75%。复合物的晶体结构证实了设计的结合姿势。然后，我们将短线性基序 (SLiM) 设计到支架环中以招募 KLHL20 和泛素连接酶机制。这些设计对 KLHL20 的微摩尔亲和力与天然 SLiM 相当。此外，双功能化蛋白会降解细胞中的 BCL-xL，导致细胞凋亡。

title: An Ortho -B−π–B-Fused All-Six-Membered BN[7]Helicene for Narrowband Circularly Polarized Luminescence with Robust Configurational Stability
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Circularly polarized organic light-emitting diodes (CP-OLEDs) directly generate circularly polarized electroluminescence (CPEL), enabling high-quality optical output with reduced reliance on external polarizing components for advanced display technologies and emerging chiral optoelectronic applications. Helicene-based circularly polarized multiple resonance thermally activated delayed fluorescence (CP-MR-TADF) emitters combine intrinsic chirality with narrowband emission, but extending their emission to longer wavelengths is often accompanied by significant spectral broadening and a loss of configurational stability. Here, we introduce a BN[7]helicene framework that addresses these issues. Using an ortho-B−π–B topology, we construct an all-six-membered-ring-fused structure whose enantiomeric solid powders retain configurational stability and CPL performance after continuous heating at 250 °C for 6 days. The enantiomers ( P / M )-DBN- cp ICz exhibit yellow emission at 558 nm with a full-width at half-maximum (FWHM) of 23 nm, photoluminescence dissymmetry factors of +2.2/–1.9 × 10–3 and an energy barrier of racemization of 48.28 kcal mol–1. CP-OLEDs based on ( P / M )-DBN- cp ICz achieve narrowband CPEL at 572 nm, with FWHM’s of 29–30 nm and dissymmetry factors of +2.1/–2.3 × 10–3. This work establishes a viable route toward long-wavelength, high-color-purity circularly polarized luminescence with enhanced configurational stability for robust chiral MR optoelectronic materials.
title_zh: 邻-B−π–B-稠合全六元BN[7]Helicene，用于具有鲁棒构型稳定性的窄带圆偏振发光
abstract_zh: 摘要 圆偏振有机发光二极管（CP-OLED）直接产生圆偏振电致发光（CPEL），可实现高质量的光学输出，同时减少对先进显示技术和新兴手性光电应用的外部偏振元件的依赖。基于螺旋烯的圆偏振多重共振热激活延迟荧光（CP-MR-TADF）发射器将固有手性与窄带发射相结合，但将其发射扩展到更长的波长通常会伴随着显着的光谱展宽和构型稳定性的损失。在这里，我们介绍了解决这些问题的 BN[7]helicene 框架。利用邻B−π–B拓扑结构，我们构建了一种全六元环稠合结构，其对映体固体粉末在250°C连续加热6天后仍保持构型稳定性和CPL性能。对映体 ( P / M )-DBN- cp ICz 在 558 nm 处呈现黄色发射，半峰全宽 (FWHM) 为 23 nm，光致发光不对称因子为 +2.2/–1.9 × 10–3，外消旋化能垒为 48.28 kcal mol–1。基于 ( P / M )-DBN- cp ICz 的 CP-OLED 在 572 nm 处实现窄带 CPEL，半高宽为 29–30 nm，不对称因子为 +2.1/–2.3 × 10–3。这项工作为长波长、高颜色纯度的圆偏振发光建立了一条可行的途径，并增强了鲁棒手性MR光电材料的构型稳定性。

title: Iron-Catalyzed Dealkenylative Borylation of Alkenes via Ozonolysis
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Given the exceptional versatility of boronic esters as synthetic linchpins, strategies that directly transform naturally abundant motifs such as alkenes into boron-containing intermediates offer substantial value. Herein, we report the development of a dealkenylative borylation transformation that converts C(sp3)–C(sp2) bonds into C(sp3)–B bonds via ozonolysis and iron catalysis. This protocol proceeds efficiently while tolerating a broad range of functional groups. Mechanistic studies indicate that the borylation reagent bis(catecholato)diborane (B2cat2) serves a dual purpose as both the boron source and the stoichiometric reductant. We demonstrate synthetic utility by applying this dealkenylative borylation reaction directly to naturally occurring steroids, terpenes, and terpenoids, as well as to the synthesis of natural products. Finally, the potential of our alkene-to-boron transformation to rapidly access structurally diverse analogues from feedstock compounds is highlighted through the divergent functionalization of the alkene-containing natural product betulinic acid.
title_zh: 铁催化臭氧分解烯烃脱烯基硼化反应
abstract_zh: 摘要 鉴于硼酸酯作为合成关键的特殊多功能性，直接将天然丰富的基序（例如烯烃）转化为含硼中间体的策略提供了巨大的价值。 Herein, we report the development of a dealkenylative borylation transformation that converts C(sp3)–C(sp2) bonds into C(sp3)–B bonds via ozonolysis and iron catalysis.该协议有效地进行，同时容忍广泛的功能组。机理研究表明，硼化试剂双（儿茶酚）乙硼烷 (B2cat2) 具有双重用途，即硼源和化学计量还原剂。我们通过将这种脱烯基硼化反应直接应用于天然存在的类固醇、萜烯和萜类化合物以及天然产物的合成来展示合成实用性。最后，通过含烯烃的天然产物桦木酸的不同官能化，凸显了我们的烯烃到硼的转化从原料化合物中快速获得结构多样的类似物的潜力。

title: Spectroscopic Tracking of Size Selectivity in Crown Ethers: A Unified Molecular Picture of Encapsulation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Crown ethers exhibit pronounced ion selectivity and have long provided an excellent platform in supramolecular chemistry. This selectivity has been rationalized by a match between the ionic radius and the nominal cavity size of the crown ether, largely driven by the success of the K+18-crown-6 system. However, this concept omits the role of conformational flexibility of the crown ethers and fails to directly connect binding structures with ion selectivity. To gain molecular-level insight into the intrinsic binding structures of crown ethers with alkali metal ions, we present a systematic study of crown ethers with varying ring sizes using cryogenic gas-phase infrared spectroscopy in conjunction with anharmonic analysis of the CH stretch region. The CH stretch region serves as a sensitive probe of ion-binding structures and interactions, enabling definitive structural assignments of Li+–Cs+ complexes across different crown ethers. Our results reveal that the intrinsic binding structures vary systematically with both ionic radius and crown ring size. It appears that successful selectivity for a specific ion-crown ether system depends on two factors: the ability of the crown ether to encapsulate the ion, and having a configuration where the ion is equidistant from the oxygen atoms within a plane formed by the etheric oxygens. While encapsulation of Li+, Na+ and K+ is achieved by 18-crown-6, only K+18-crown-6 has the oxygen distances uniformly positioned about this plane, resulting in truly selective encapsulation. For 12-crown-4 and 15-crown-5, the most favorable structures, involving Li+ and Na+, respectively, are unable to achieve selective encapsulation, as the ions are positioned at varying distances with respect to the plane of the etheric oxygens. These distinctions can be traced to the differing conformational flexibility of the crown ethers.
title_zh: 冠醚尺寸选择性的光谱追踪：封装的统一分子图
abstract_zh: 摘要 冠醚表现出显着的离子选择性，长期以来为超分子化学提供了良好的平台。这种选择性通过冠醚的离子半径和标称空腔尺寸之间的匹配而合理化，这在很大程度上是由 K+18-crown-6 系统的成功推动的。然而，这个概念忽略了冠醚构象灵活性的作用，并且未能将结合结构与离子选择性直接连接起来。为了在分子水平上深入了解冠醚与碱金属离子的内在结合结构，我们利用低温气相红外光谱结合 CH 拉伸区域的非谐波分析，对不同环尺寸的冠醚进行了系统研究。 CH拉伸区作为离子结合结构和相互作用的敏感探针，能够对不同冠醚中的Li+-Cs+复合物进行明确的结构分配。 Our results reveal that the intrinsic binding structures vary systematically with both ionic radius and crown ring size.似乎特定离子-冠醚系统的成功选择性取决于两个因素：冠醚封装离子的能力，以及具有离子与醚氧形成的平面内的氧原子等距的构型。虽然 Li+、Na+ 和 K+ 的封装是通过 18-crown-6 实现的，但只有 K+18-crown-6 的氧距离均匀分布在该平面周围，从而实现真正的选择性封装。 For 12-crown-4 and 15-crown-5, the most favorable stru

title: Nickel(I) in an All-Ferric NiFeS Cluster
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Anaerobic carbon monoxide dehydrogenase (CODH) enzymes interconvert CO2 and CO under mild conditions and with near perfect selectivity. The CODH active site, termed the C-cluster, is a [NiFe3S4]-Feu cluster that can reside in several different oxidation states. Despite decades of research, the electronic structure of the C-cluster remains unresolved, and the metal oxidation states are ambiguous. In this study, we interrogate a series of synthetic clusters with [NiFe3S4]3+/2+/1+ cores in multiple oxidation states as models of the C-cluster cubane core. Each cluster is characterized using crystallography, spectroscopy, magnetism, and computations. The most oxidized cluster, [NiFe3S4]3+, is best described as having Ni2+ and three Fe3+ sites. Remarkably, X-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS) data show that reduction to the [NiFe3S4]2+ state results in reduction of nickel to Ni1+, even though nearby Fe3+ sites are present. The fully oxidized Fe3+3 subsite can be reduced only after nickel has reached the Ni1+ state. These results demonstrate that Ni1+ is a readily accessible oxidation state in FeS clusters that are topologically relevant to the CODH C-cluster.
title_zh: 全铁 NiFeS 簇中的镍 (I)
abstract_zh: 摘要 厌氧一氧化碳脱氢酶 (CODH) 在温和条件下以近乎完美的选择性相互转化 CO2 和 CO。 CODH 活性位点称为 C 簇，是一个 [NiFe3S4]-Feu 簇，可以存在几种不同的氧化态。尽管经过数十年的研究，C 团簇的电子结构仍未得到解决，金属氧化态也不清楚。在本研究中，我们研究了一系列具有多种氧化态 [NiFe3S4]3+/2+/1+ 核心的合成团簇，作为 C 团簇立方烷核心的模型。每个簇都通过晶体学、光谱学、磁性和计算来表征。最氧化的簇，[NiFe3S4]3+，最好描述为具有 Ni2+ 和三个 Fe3+ 位点。值得注意的是，X 射线吸收光谱 (XAS) 数据表明，即使附近存在 Fe3+ 位点，还原至 [NiFe3S4]2+ 态也会导致镍还原为 Ni1+。只有当镍达到Ni1+状态后，完全氧化的Fe3+3亚位点才能被还原。这些结果表明 Ni1+ 是 FeS 簇中易于接近的氧化态，其拓扑与 CODH C 簇相关。

title: Tunable Chiral D4-Symmetric Phthalocyanines with Rationally Designed Aggregation for Near-Infrared Circularly Polarized Luminescence
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Chiral phthalocyanines hold significant promise for chiroptical and supramolecular materials; however, reported examples remain sporadic, and no general synthetic platform has been available to systematically control their structural and functional properties. Here, we report a practical and general synthesis of D4-symmetric chiral phthalocyanines from commercially available H8-BINOL. This modular route provides direct access to a broad palette of chiral architectures, enabling systematic investigation of how substituents govern supramolecular assembly. We found that aggregation behavior can be predictably tuned through simple structural modifications. Single-crystal X-ray diffraction analysis guided the design of tailored noncovalent interactions that promote spontaneous and selective J-type aggregation into well-defined chiral helices. The resulting supramolecular structures display narrowband near-infrared fluorescence (fwhm = 15 nm) and pronounced circularly polarized luminescence (CPL), with dissymmetry factors (glum) of up to 0.01. Notably, the CPL signal of the aggregates remains detectable at nanomolar concentrations down to 500 nM, demonstrating the high chiroptical efficiency of these materials and their potential for low concentration applications.
title_zh: 具有合理设计聚集体的可调谐手性 D4 对称酞菁用于近红外圆偏振发光
abstract_zh: 摘要 手性酞菁在手性光学和超分子材料方面具有重要前景。然而，报道的例子仍然是零星的，并且没有通用的合成平台可以系统地控制它们的结构和功能特性。在这里，我们报告了从市售 H8-BINOL 合成 D4-对称手性酞菁的实用且通用的方法。这种模块化路线提供了直接访问广泛的手性结构的途径，从而能够系统地研究取代基如何控制超分子组装。我们发现聚合行为可以通过简单的结构修改进行可预测的调整。单晶 X 射线衍射分析指导了定制非共价相互作用的设计，促进自发和选择性 J 型聚集成明确的手性螺旋。所得的超分子结构显示出窄带近红外荧光（fwhm = 15 nm）和明显的圆偏振发光（CPL），不对称因子（glum）高达0.01。值得注意的是，聚集体的 CPL 信号在低至 500 nM 的纳摩尔浓度下仍然可检测到，这证明了这些材料的高手性光学效率及其低浓度应用的潜力。

title: Synergistic Copper-Organoboron Activation of Aspartic Acid Enabled Peptide Cyclization and Conjugation
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Few advances have effectively addressed the challenge of selectively activating aspartic acid (Asp) side chains. The β-carboxyl group of Asp remains underutilized as a reactive handle due to its limited reactivity under biocompatible conditions, its susceptibility to competing aspartimide formation, and the difficulty of achieving site-selectivity among chemically indistinguishable carboxyl groups on glutamic acid (Glu) side chains and the C-terminus. Here, we report a copper/organoboron synergistic system that enables direct and selective activation of the Asp side chain within Asp-His motifs, forming Lys-Asp isopeptide bonds under neutral aqueous conditions and exhibiting broad compatibility with unprotected peptides containing all canonical amino acids, including Glu and Asp residues outside the recognition motif. The method is applied to the synthesis of cyclic peptides (14- to 38-membered rings), bicyclic architectures, and diverse bioactive sequences, including the RGD peptide. The utility of this Asp activation strategy extends to protein engineering, as demonstrated by the head-to-tail cyclization of the de novo-designed protein ABLE and protein–protein ligation mediated by a heterodimeric coiled-coil. Beyond cyclization, we identified a -DAGGDHLP- tag that exploits the activated Asp residue for site-specific peptide conjugation with small-molecule amines. This dual-reagent activation strategy provides an enzyme-free solution for Asp side-chain chemistry, expanding the synthetic toolkit for peptide and protein engineering.
title_zh: 铜-有机硼协同活化天冬氨酸使肽环化和缀合
abstract_zh: 摘要 很少有进展能够有效解决选择性激活天冬氨酸 (Asp) 侧链的挑战。 Asp 的 β-羧基作为反应手柄仍未得到充分利用，因为其在生物相容性条件下的反应性有限、对竞争性天冬酰亚胺形成的敏感性以及在谷氨酸 (Glu) 侧链和 C 末端上化学上无法区分的羧基之间实现位点选择性的困难。在此，我们报道了一种铜/有机硼协同系统，该系统能够直接选择性地激活天冬氨酸-组氨酸基序中的天冬氨酸侧链，在中性水条件下形成赖氨酸-天冬氨酸异肽键，并与含有所有规范氨基酸（包括识别基序之外的谷氨酸和天冬氨酸残基）的未受保护的肽表现出广泛的相容性。该方法适用于环肽（14 至 38 元环）、双环结构和多种生物活性序列（包括 RGD 肽）的合成。这种 Asp 激活策略的实用性扩展到蛋白质工程，从头设计的蛋白质 ABLE 的头尾环化和异二聚体卷曲螺旋介导的蛋白质-蛋白质连接就证明了这一点。除了环化之外，我们还鉴定了一个 -DAGGDHLP- 标签，该标签利用活化的天冬氨酸残基与小分子胺进行位点特异性肽缀合。这种双试剂激活策略为 Asp 侧链化学提供了无酶解决方案，扩展了肽和蛋白质工程的合成工具包。

title: Stereoselectivity of Galactosylation Reactions In Vacuo
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Controlling the stereoselective outcome of glycosidic bond formation remains a major challenge in chemical synthesis. This process typically proceeds along a complex SN1-SN2 mechanistic continuum. In solution, the key contributions to these mechanisms are difficult to determine due to influence by structural and environmental variables, such as solvents, counterions or temperature. To isolate the intrinsic factors driving steroselectivity in glycosylations, we investigate the reactions for the monosaccharide galactose in the gas phase. We perform ion–molecule galactosylation reactions in complete isolation inside an ion trap of a mass spectrometer and directly probe the stereochemistry of the formed products using mass-resolved ultraviolet cold ion spectroscopy. The results show that α-selectivity is significantly weaker in the gas phase than in solution, and that the product stereochemistry might be influenced by the nucleophile’s electron density rather than its overall nucleophilic strength.
title_zh: 真空中半乳糖基化反应的立体选择性
abstract_zh: 摘要 控制糖苷键形成的立体选择性结果仍然是化学合成中的主要挑战。该过程通常沿着复杂的 SN1-SN2 机械连续体进行。在溶液中，由于结构和环境变量（例如溶剂、反离子或温度）的影响，这些机制的关键贡献很难确定。为了分离驱动糖基化立体选择性的内在因素，我们研究了单糖半乳糖在气相中的反应。我们在质谱仪的离子阱内完全隔离地进行离子-分子半乳糖基化反应，并使用质量分辨紫外冷离子光谱直接探测所形成产物的立体化学。结果表明，气相中的 α-选择性明显弱于溶液中，并且产物的立体化学可能受到亲核试剂的电子密度而不是其整体亲核强度的影响。

title: Upcycling of polyvinyl chloride into polyalphaolefin lubricants
source: Nature
abstract: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) is a thermoplastic used ubiquitously in households and industry owing to its light weight, mechanical strength, durability, low cost and ultraviolet and fire resistance1,2. With a production volume of about 60 million tonnes annually2, post-consumer and post-industrial PVC waste pose marked environmental challenges, such as leaching chlorohydrocarbons and additives, which contaminate groundwater and soil1-4. To address the formidable challenge of recycling PVC and achieving carbon circularity, valorization into high-value products is essential to mitigate the associated costs and offer high financial incentives for reusing plastic waste5-14. Here we report a method for upcycling PVC into high-value lubricants with controllable viscosities. Using AlCl3 at a mild temperature of 70 °C, PVC undergoes dechlorination, alkylation and chain scission, producing vinyl-derived polyalphaolefins (vPAO). PVC serves as an effective template for the alkylation of α-olefins of various chain lengths, producing vPAO with limited short branches in the backbone without the need for metallocene catalysts essential to current PAO technology. The PVC-derived lubricants exhibit tunable molar masses, kinematic viscosities at 100 °C (KV100 ≈ 14.9-26.3 centistokes), a low coefficient of friction (COF ≈ 0.08-0.15) and a high viscosity index (VI up to 130). This work highlights an economical approach to using PVC as a low-cost feedstock to synthesize high-value lubricants with superior tribological properties, meeting the demand for sustainability in both the plastic and lubricant industries.
title_zh: 将聚氯乙烯升级改造为聚 α 烯烃润滑剂
abstract_zh: 聚氯乙烯 (PVC) 是一种在家庭和工业中广泛使用的热塑性塑料，因为它重量轻、机械强度高、耐用、成本低、耐紫外线和耐火1,2。消费后和工业后 PVC 废物的年产量约为 6000 万吨2，带来了显着的环境挑战，例如浸出的氯代烃和添加剂，污染地下水和土壤1-4。为了应对回收 PVC 和实现碳循环的艰巨挑战，高价值产品的增值对于降低相关成本并为重复利用塑料废物提供高额财政激励至关重要5-14。在这里，我们报告了一种将 PVC 升级为粘度可控的高价值润滑剂的方法。使用 AlCl3 在 70°C 的温和温度下，PVC 发生脱氯、烷基化和断链，生成乙烯基衍生的聚 α 烯烃 (vPAO)。 PVC 可作为各种链长的 α-烯烃烷基化的有效模板，生产主链中具有有限短支链的 vPAO，而不需要当前 PAO 技术所必需的茂金属催化剂。 PVC 衍生润滑剂具有可调的摩尔质量、100°C 下的运动粘度 (KV100   14.9-26.3 厘沱)、低摩擦系数 (COF   0.08-0.15) 和高粘度指数 (VI 高达 130)。这项工作强调了一种使用 PVC 作为低成本原料来合成具有优异摩擦学性能的高价值润滑剂的经济方法，满足塑料和润滑油的可持续性需求

title: Water Oxidation by Molecular Catalyst Bilayers Self-Assembled on Bismuth Vanadium Oxide (BVO) Photoelectrodes
source: Journal of the American Chemical Society: Latest Articles (ACS Publications)
abstract: Abstract Sunlight-driven water splitting stands out as one of the viable strategies for the generation of a sustainable fuel. For this purpose, the coupling of proton reduction and water oxidation catalysis, with light absorbing materials is crucial. Here we develop a strategy that integrates a powerful molecular water-oxidation catalyst, based on oligomeric Ru-tda complexes (tda2– is [2,2′:6′,2″-terpyridine]-6,6″-dicarboxylate), with a light absorbing BiVO4 material through self-assembly and formation of a bilayer. The self-assembly process also allows for the integration of a redox mediator, Ru-bpy (bpy is 2,2′-bipyridine), that was found to accelerate hole-transfer from the BiVO4 to the molecular catalyst leading to more efficient catalysis, as measured by transient absorption and intensity modulated photocurrent (IMPS) spectroscopies. With an applied potential of 0.82 V vs NHE (1.23 vs RHE) at pH 7 and 1 sun irradiation, photocatalytic water oxidation was observed with current densities of ca. 2 mA cm–2 and Faradaic efficiencies of 98%. This corresponds to turnover of over 23,500 per Ru unit (280,000 per Ru oligomer), ranking among the best reported at neutral pH. This new strategy yields photoelectrodes with enhanced stability and with very low catalyst loadings, that are expected to be versatile and easily implemented with other catalysts and semiconducting materials.
title_zh: 氧化铋钒 (BVO) 光电极上自组装分子催化剂双层的水氧化
abstract_zh: 摘要 阳光驱动的水分解是生产可持续燃料的可行策略之一。为此，质子还原和水氧化催化与光吸收材料的耦合至关重要。在这里，我们开发了一种策略，通过自组装和形成双层，将基于低聚 Ru-tda 络合物（tda2- 为 [2,2':6',2"-三联吡啶]-6,6"-二羧酸酯）的强大分子水氧化催化剂与光吸收 BiVO4 材料集成在一起。自组装过程还允许整合氧化还原介体 Ru-bpy（bpy 是 2,2'-联吡啶），通过瞬态吸收和强度调制光电流 (IMPS) 光谱测量，Ru-bpy 可以加速空穴从 BiVO4 到分子催化剂的转移，从而实现更有效的催化作用。在 pH 7 和 1 个太阳照射下，施加 0.82 V vs NHE（1.23 vs RHE）的电势，在电流密度约为 1 的情况下观察到光催化水氧化。 2 mA cm–2 和法拉第效率为 98%。这相当于每 Ru 单位超过 23,500 的营业额（每 Ru 低聚物 280,000），在中性 pH 值下排名最佳。这种新策略产生的光电极具有增强的稳定性和极低的催化剂负载量，预计将具有多种用途，并且易于与其他催化剂和半导体材料一起实施。

title: In situ particle-to-fibre transformation of hydrogels for 3D printing
source: Nature
abstract: Structural anisotropy is ubiquitous in nature and governs orientation-dependent properties and functions1,2. Recreating biomimetic anisotropy in hydrogels-water-rich soft materials widely used in biomedicine-has proven challenging3. Here we report a phenomenon termed shear-extensional in situ particle-to-fibre transformation (SHIFT) and demonstrate the SHIFT printing of highly aligned hydrogel microfibres (5-30 μm in diameter). In SHIFT, particle-embedded hydrogel is extruded in a controlled manner, in which the discrete particles and surrounding matrix experience opposite phase transitions, concurrently transforming particles into well-aligned subvoxel microfibres. SHIFT establishes a methodology for creating anisotropy from droplets, which is dominated by extensional flow of sol-gel two-phase systems. It constitutes a versatile upstream manufacturing approach that can be readily adapted into three-dimensional printing and microfibre spinning scenarios in a highly accessible manner. The pronounced structural anisotropy enables the formation of exceptionally long myotubes in vitro and accelerates regeneration in volumetric muscle loss. By implementing an in situ subvoxel manufacturing process within flow, SHIFT expands the ability to process soft materials.
title_zh: 用于 3D 打印的水凝胶原位颗粒到纤维的转化
abstract_zh: 结构各向异性在自然界中普遍存在，并控制着方向相关的属性和功能1,2。事实证明，在水凝胶（生物医学中广泛使用的富含水的软材料）中重现仿生各向异性具有挑战性3。 Here we report a phenomenon termed shear-extensional in situ particle-to-fibre transformation (SHIFT) and demonstrate the SHIFT printing of highly aligned hydrogel microfibres (5-30 μm in diameter).在 SHIFT 中，颗粒嵌入的水凝胶以受控方式挤出，其中离散颗粒和周围基质经历相反的相变，同时将颗粒转变为排列良好的亚体素微纤维。 SHIFT 建立了一种从液滴中产生各向异性的方法，该方法以溶胶-凝胶两相系统的拉伸流动为主。它构成了一种多功能的上游制造方法，可以以高度可访问的方式轻松适应三维打印和微纤维纺丝场景。明显的结构各向异性使得能够在体外形成异常长的肌管，并加速体积肌肉损失的再生。通过在流程中实施原位亚体素制造工艺，SHIFT 扩展了加工软材料的能力。

title: ZFP36L2 orchestrates stress-adaptive plasticity in regeneration and cancer
source: Nature
abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Phenotypic plasticity is a hallmark of cancer
                    1
                    ; however the molecular switches required for cell-fate reprogramming are poorly understood. During intestinal wound-healing and colorectal cancer (CRC) metastasis, differentiated cells can dynamically dedifferentiate into an intestinal stem cell (ISC) state to drive epithelial regeneration and metastatic outgrowth
                    2–10
                    . Here we show that the RNA-binding protein ZFP36L2, which is mutated in 5–10% of CRC
                    11–15
                    , is a pivotal stress-responsive orchestrator of dynamic dedifferentiation. In mouse colon regeneration models, ZFP36L2 ablation inhibits dedifferentiation, ISC gene expression and function and impairs intestinal regeneration. In human CRC, loss of ZFP36L2 function abrogates metastatic seeding and the outgrowth of LGR5
                    +
                    canonical metastases while promoting lineage plasticity and non-canonical differentiation into heterogeneous cell states. Mechanistically, ZFP36L2 binds to stress-associated mRNAs that contain AU-rich 3′ untranslated regions, which induces the formation of dynamic biomolecular condensates associated with mRNA degradation and termination of the stress response. Together, these data show that ZFP36L2 acts as an important molecular switch that couples stress sensing with phenotypic plasticity. This in turn drives cellular dedifferentiation essential for re-establishing the ISC state during wound healing and metastasis. In ZFP36L2-deficient CRC, the inability to re-enter the LGR5
                    +
                    state during metastatic outgrowth promotes non-canonical lineage plasticity, which is associated with poor clinical outcomes.
title_zh: ZFP36L2 协调再生和癌症中的压力适应性可塑性
abstract_zh:
摘要
                  
                    表型可塑性是癌症的标志
                    1
                    ;然而，人们对细胞命运重编程所需的分子开关知之甚少。在肠道伤口愈合和结直肠癌（CRC）转移过程中，分化细胞可以动态去分化为肠道干细胞（ISC）状态，以驱动上皮再生和转移生长
                    2–10
                    。在这里，我们展示了 RNA 结合蛋白 ZFP36L2，它在 5-10% 的 CRC 中发生突变
                    11–15
                    ，是动态去分化的关键压力反应协调器。在小鼠结肠再生模型中，ZFP36L2 消融会抑制去分化、ISC 基因表达和功能，并损害肠道再生。在人类结直肠癌中，ZFP36L2 功能的丧失会消除转移性播种和 LGR5 的生长
                    +
                    典型转移，同时促进谱系可塑性和非典型分化为异质细胞状态。从机制上讲，ZFP36L2 与含有富含 AU 3′非翻译区的应激相关 mRNA 结合，诱导与 mRNA 降解和应激反应终止相关的动态生物分子缩合物的形成。总之，这些数据表明 ZFP36L2 充当重要的分子开关，将压力传感与表型可塑性结合起来。这反过来又驱动细胞去分化，这对于伤口愈合过程中重建 ISC 状态至关重要

title: A dependency map enhanced with next-generation 3D cancer models
source: Nature
abstract: Despite advances in precision oncology, effective personalized treatments are still lacking for most patients with cancer1. The Cancer Dependency Map (DepMap) accelerates this field by systematically identifying cancer vulnerabilities in diverse preclinical models. Data from over 1,300 cell lines have led to the discovery of new therapeutic strategies across multiple tumour types2. However, mapping cancer vulnerabilities using traditional cell lines has limitations, including insufficient cancer subtype representation and the impact of culture conditions on perturbation responses. Here we perform 147 genome-scale CRISPR screens and multi-omic characterizations of next-generation (NextGen) cancer models (organoids and spheroids) across 10 cancer types. This strategy enables the expansion of DepMap to cover new genomic and molecular subtypes and to identify new biomarker-associated vulnerabilities. These new models also preserve transcriptional programs that are silenced in traditional cell lines and facilitate the discovery of specific gene dependencies associated with these programs. Comparisons of traditional and NextGen cancer models enable further identification of distinct effects of growth format and culture medium on gene essentiality. The integrated dataset combines data from both model types to offer a valuable, expansive resource for exploring cancer vulnerabilities and is accessible via the DepMap portal. Integration of genome-scale CRISPR screening data from traditional cell lines and next-generation cancer models expands the representation of tumour subtypes and genomic alterations in The Cancer Dependency Map.
title_zh: 下一代 3D 癌症模型增强的依赖性图
abstract_zh: 尽管精准肿瘤学取得了进步，但大多数癌症患者仍然缺乏有效的个性化治疗1。癌症依赖性图 (DepMap) 通过系统地识别不同临床前模型中的癌症脆弱性，加速了这一领域的发展。来自 1,300 多个细胞系的数据帮助我们发现了针对多种肿瘤类型的新治疗策略2。然而，使用传统细胞系绘制癌症脆弱性具有局限性，包括癌症亚型代表性不足以及培养条件对扰动反应的影响。在这里，我们对 10 种癌症类型的下一代 (NextGen) 癌症模型（类器官和球体）进行了 147 次基因组规模的 CRISPR 筛选和多组学表征。该策略使 DepMap 能够扩展，以涵盖新的基因组和分子亚型，并识别新的生物标志物相关漏洞。这些新模型还保留了传统细胞系中沉默的转录程序，并有助于发现与这些程序相关的特定基因依赖性。传统癌症模型和下一代癌症模型的比较可以进一步确定生长方式和培养基对基因必要性的不同影响。集成数据集结合了两种模型类型的数据，为探索癌症脆弱性提供了宝贵的、广泛的资源，并且可以通过 DepMap 门户访问。来自传统细胞系和下一代癌症模型的基因组规模 CRISPR 筛选数据的整合扩大了肿瘤亚型的代表性，

title: An entangling gate for dual-rail erasure qubits
source: Nature
abstract: Quantum error correction (QEC) will likely be required to realize the full potential of quantum computing, but comes with daunting hardware overheads and demands low gate errors on the physical qubits1, 2, 3–4. These requirements can be eased by engineering qubits with a strong error hierarchy, in which the most common noise channels are also the easiest to correct. Erasure qubits can achieve this when detectable leakage errors out of the computational subspace dominate over the residual Pauli errors5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10–11, resulting in higher thresholds and improved scaling with code distance5,12,13. In practice, these advantages come to fruition only if the error hierarchy is preserved as much as possible throughout all gates and operations. Here we design and realize a two-qubit entangling gate for dual-rail cavity qubits, a type of erasure qubit encoded in a pair of superconducting microwave cavities7. Our experimental demonstration confirms that the error hierarchy is largely preserved during the gate. The gate is fast (about 500 ns duration) and shows low erasure rates of approximately 0.5% per gate, remaining Pauli errors below 0.1%, and a strong bias towards dephasing errors, in which bit-flips are practically non-existent at the 10−6 level. These results enable a faster path to error-corrected systems that rapidly suppress errors as they scale; a claim we support with our detailed surface code simulations. A fast, low-error entangling gate for dual-rail cavity erasure qubits preserves a strong error hierarchy, advancing scalable quantum error correction with substantially improved fault-tolerant performance.
title_zh: 双轨擦除量子位的纠缠门
abstract_zh: 为了充分发挥量子计算的潜力，可能需要量子纠错 (QEC)，但它会带来令人畏惧的硬件开销，并且要求物理量子位 1、2、3-4 上的门错误较低。通过设计具有强大错误层次结构的量子位可以缓解这些要求，其中最常见的噪声通道也是最容易纠正的。当计算子空间外的可检测泄漏错误主导剩余泡利错误5、6、7、8、9、10-11时，擦除量子位可以实现这一点，从而导致更高的阈值并改善代码距离的缩放5、12、13。在实践中，只有在所有门和操作中尽可能保留错误层次结构，这些优势才能实现。在这里，我们设计并实现了用于双轨腔量子位的双量子位纠缠门，这是一种在一对超导微波腔中编码的擦除量子位。我们的实验演示证实，错误层次结构在门控过程中很大程度上得到了保留。该门速度很快（大约 500 ns 持续时间），并且显示出每个门大约 0.5% 的低擦除率，剩余泡利误差低于 0.1%，并且对相移误差有很强的偏差，其中位翻转在 10−6 级别实际上不存在。这些结果为错误纠正系统提供了一条更快的途径，可以在错误扩展时快速抑制错误；我们通过详细的表面代码模拟来支持这一主张。用于双轨腔擦除量子位的快速、低错误纠缠门保留了强大的错误层次结构，大大推进了可扩展的量子纠错

title: Encapsulation epitaxy of air-stable 2D superconductors for quantum circuits
source: Nature
abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) superconductors are emerging platforms supporting both strongly correlated physics and quantum information science1,2. Their reduced dimensionality, atomically flat interfaces and high crystallinity are particularly attractive for realizing compact lumped-element devices in superconducting circuits3-5. However, large-scale synthesis of monolayer 2D superconductors remains challenging as they are easily oxidized in air6. Here we report an 'encapsulation epitaxy' mechanism that enables the growth of large-area (more than 1 inch), air-stable, monolayer niobium diselenide (NbSe2) films (1L-NbSe2) and explore their potential for superconducting quantum circuits. This work represents a distinct growth phenomenon in which a 2D encapsulation layer, such as graphene or hexagonal boron nitride, pre-deposited on a 3D substrate (for example, SiO2 or Si3N4) simultaneously serves as a template for the epitaxial growth of 1L-NbSe2 underneath it at the encapsulation-substrate interface and as a protective capping layer against ambient degradation. The as-grown 1L-graphene/NbSe2 heterostructures exhibit robust superconductivity (superconducting transition temperature Tc ≈ 1 K) and enhanced charge density waves (CDWs; CDW transition temperature TCDW ≈ 177 K). We further demonstrate the integration of 1L-NbSe2 into superconducting circuits by developing oxidation-free transfer and superconducting edge-contact techniques. The 1L-NbSe2 in these circuits feature a measured kinetic inductance LK ≈ 0.7 nH □-1, making it suitable for quantum circuits requiring elements with high kinetic inductance. This encapsulation-epitaxy methodology enables the production of air-stable 2D superconductors and van der Waals heterostructures, holding promise for wafer-scale, monolithic fabrication of superconducting quantum circuitry.
title_zh: 用于量子电路的空气稳定二维超导体的封装外延
abstract_zh: 二维 (2D) 超导体是支持强相关物理和量子信息科学的新兴平台1,2。它们的降维、原子级平坦的界面和高结晶度对于在超导电路中实现紧凑的集总元件器件特别有吸引力3-5。然而，单层二维超导体的大规模合成仍然具有挑战性，因为它们在空气中很容易被氧化。在这里，我们报告了一种“封装外延”机制，该机制能够生长大面积（超过 1 英寸）、空气稳定的单层二硒化铌 (NbSe2) 薄膜 (1L-NbSe2)，并探索其在超导量子电路中的潜力。这项工作代表了一种独特的生长现象，其中预沉积在 3D 基板（例如 SiO2 或 Si3N4）上的 2D 封装层（例如石墨烯或六方氮化硼）同时充当其下方封装基板界面处的 1L-NbSe2 外延生长的模板，并作为防止环境退化的保护覆盖层。生长的1L-石墨烯/NbSe2异质结构表现出强大的超导性（超导转变温度Tc ≈ 1 K）和增强的电荷密度波（CDW；CDW转变温度TCDW   177 K）。我们通过开发无氧化转移和超导边缘接触技术进一步证明了 1L-NbSe2 与超导电路的集成。这些电路中的 1L-NbSe2 具有测量的动感电感 LK ≈ 0.7 nH □-1，使其适用于需要高电阻元件的量子电路。
